三次搜索、三次抓取已覆盖全部四个组件（PyTorch、CUDA toolkit、cuDNN、驱动）的官方配套关系，可以给出最终答案。

<answer>

## 一、先查清你当前环境的实际版本

```bash
# 1. PyTorch 版本 + 它编译时绑定的 CUDA 版本（最重要！）
python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__); print(torch.version.cuda)"

# 2. PyTorch 自带的 cuDNN 版本（不是系统装的 cuDNN）
python -c "import torch; print(torch.backends.cudnn.version())"
# 输出例如 90600，即 cuDNN 9.6.0

# 3. CUDA 是否真的可用
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available()); print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))"

# 4. 显卡驱动版本（右上角 Driver Version）
nvidia-smi
# 注意：nvidia-smi 右上角的 "CUDA Version" 是该驱动【最高支持】的 CUDA 版本，
# 不是你已安装的 toolkit 版本，也不是 PyTorch 用的版本！

# 5. 本地 CUDA toolkit 版本（仅编译扩展时才重要）
nvcc --version
# 或 cat /usr/local/cuda/version.json
```

关键认知：**PyTorch 的 pip/conda 包自带 CUDA runtime 和 cuDNN**，运行 PyTorch 不依赖系统装的 toolkit 和 cuDNN。所以"对不上"时先看 `torch.version.cuda`，而不是 `nvcc --version`。

## 二、四者配套关系（官方对照）

### 1. PyTorch ↔ CUDA（选 wheel 变体）

来源：https://pytorch.org/get-started/previous-versions/

| PyTorch | 可选 CUDA 变体 |
|---|---|
| 2.13.0 / 2.12.x | cu126, cu130, cu132 |
| 2.9 – 2.11 | cu126, cu128, cu130 |
| 2.8.0 | cu126, cu128, cu129 |
| 2.7.x | cu118, cu126, cu128 |
| 2.6.0 | cu118, cu124, cu126 |
| 2.4 – 2.5 | cu118, cu121, cu124 |
| 2.1 – 2.3 | cu118, cu121 |

安装命令（以 2.13.0 + CUDA 12.6 为例）：

```bash
pip install torch==2.13.0 torchvision==0.28.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126
```

`cu126` 即表示该 wheel 按 CUDA 12.6 构建。官方页面**不列出**每个 wheel 内置的 cuDNN 具体版本（页面无此信息），需用 `torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 实测。

### 2. cuDNN ↔ CUDA ↔ 最低驱动

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/reference/support-matrix.html

- **cuDNN 9.26.0 for CUDA 12.x**：支持 CUDA 12.0 – 12.9；Linux 驱动 ≥ 525.60.13，Windows 驱动 ≥ 527.41
- **cuDNN 9.26.0 for CUDA 13.x**：支持 CUDA 13.0 – 13.4；Linux 驱动 ≥ 615.71.09（Windows N/A）
- cuDNN 的 CUDA 12.x 动态构建兼容**所有** CUDA 12.x 小版本（官方脚注[1]）
- Blackwell/Blackwell-Ultra 架构 GPU 需要 CUDA ≥ 12.8 且 Linux 驱动 ≥ 570.26（脚注[3]）

### 3. CUDA toolkit ↔ 最低驱动（部分关键行）

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html

| CUDA Toolkit | Linux 最低驱动 | Windows 最低驱动 |
|---|---|---|
| 13.0 | ≥ 580（13.4 新特性需 R615+） | — |
| 12.9 | ≥ 575.51.03 | ≥ 576.02 |
| 12.8 | ≥ 570.26 | ≥ 570.65 |
| 12.6 | ≥ 560.28.03 | ≥ 560.76 |
| 12.4 | ≥ 550.54.14 | ≥ 551.61 |
| 12.1 | ≥ 530.30.02 | ≥ 531.14 |
| 12.0 | ≥ 525.60.13 | ≥ 527.41 |
| 11.8 | ≥ 520.61.05 | ≥ 520.06 |

### 4. 次版本兼容（Minor Version Compatibility）

同上 CUDA Release Notes Table 3：

| CTK | 驱动范围 |
|---|---|
| 13.x | ≥ 580 |
| 12.x | ≥ 525 且 < 580 |
| 11.x | ≥ 450 且 < 525 |

即：**同一大版本内，旧一点的驱动也能跑新 toolkit 构建的应用**（11.x 家族需 Linux ≥ 450.80.02 / Windows ≥ 452.39）。

## 三、排错决策流程

1. `torch.cuda.is_available()` 为 False → 先查驱动：`nvidia-smi` 能否运行、驱动版本是否满足上表（例如跑 cu126 构建需 Linux 驱动 ≥ 525.60.13 即可，因次版本兼容）
2. 运行报 `CUDA driver version is insufficient` → 升级显卡驱动（驱动向下兼容，直接升到最新即可，不必动 PyTorch）
3. `torch.version.cuda` 与你想用的本地 toolkit 不一致 → 正常现象；**只有编译自定义 CUDA 扩展**（`pip install -e .`、flash-attn 等源码包）时才要求本地 toolkit 大版本与 `torch.version.cuda` 匹配
4. 想换 CUDA 组合 → 按第一张表用对应 `--index-url` 重装，不要自己拼装 cuDNN
5. 驱动选择：只需满足"≥ PyTorch 构建所用 CUDA 的最低要求"，`nvidia-smi` 里的 CUDA Version 高于 `torch.version.cuda` 完全没问题

## 无法核实处

- PyTorch 官方未公开各 wheel 内置 cuDNN 的具体版本号（previous-versions 页面无此信息），只能装好后用 `torch.backends.cudnn.version()` 实测
- 本次未实测任何命令（本机为 macOS/ARM，无 NVIDIA GPU），以上命令均来自官方文档与社区惯例，未运行验证
- 检查命令（`torch.version.cuda` 等）未在 pytorch.org 官方页面检索到专门文档，仅有社区来源（juejin/cnblogs/CSDN）佐证

</answer>

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识的回答：

在 Ubuntu 上从零安装 CUDA toolkit（例如官方 runfile 安装到默认路径 /usr/local/cuda-12.x，并创建 /usr/local/cuda 符号链接），装完后按 NVIDIA 官方 Post-installation Actions 的建议需要配置两个环境变量（以 bash、CUDA 12.x 为例）：

```bash
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.x/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.x/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
```

通常写入 ~/.bashrc 或 /etc/profile.d/cuda.sh。使用 /usr/local/cuda 符号链接写 PATH 可以在升级时免改配置；但 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 若通过符号链接指向，升级新版后旧库路径会失效，官方示例使用带版本号的绝对路径。

补充：若通过 apt 安装（deb 包），NVIDIA 的包会把 nvcc 等装入 /usr/bin（通过 alternatives），PATH 通常无需手动配置；发行版自带的 nvidia 打包驱动与官方 .run 驱动的库路径也可能不同。部分构建工具（如部分 Python 包编译脚本）还会识别 CUDA_HOME/CUDA_ROOT 指向 /usr/local/cuda，但这不是运行所必需。

不确定处：
1. CUDA 13.x 时代官方文档的推荐写法是否有变化（例如是否已改用 /etc/profile.d 脚本或其他机制）。
2. 官方文档当前确切版本号与 URL（docs.nvidia.com/cuda/.../installation-guide-linux/ 的 post-installation-actions 页面是否仍是该路径）。
3. apt（deb 网络仓库）安装方式下官方对 PATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH 的确切说法。
4. 是否还有官方建议的其他变量（如对 WSL 或 aarch64 的特殊说明）。

以上细节需要检索官方安装指南核实。

# CUDA 13.4 环境设置提取 — PATH & LD_LIBRARY_PATH

## 总结

在**CUDA Quick Start Guide 13.4** 文档中，相同的 “Set up the development environment”（设置开发环境）步骤——包含相同的两个 `export` 命令——在 **12 个 Linux 安装章节**中逐字出现。Ubuntu 专属的章节是 **§4.1.9.1 (Debian Installer)** 和 **§4.1.9.2 (Runfile Installer)**。所有提取内容均在下方逐字重现，并带有明确的 START/END（开始/结束）标记。

---

## 1. Ubuntu — Debian Installer (§4.1.9.1)

**[VERBATIM START — Section 4.1.9.1 "Debian Installer", steps 3–5]**

3. 重启系统以加载 NVIDIA 驱动程序：
   
   ```
   sudo reboot
   ```
4. 通过修改 PATH 和 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 变量来设置开发环境：
   
   ```
   export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}
   export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64\
                            ${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
   ```
5. 从 https://github.com/nvidia/cuda-samples 安装示例的可写副本，然后按照 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-samples/tree/master/Samples/5_Domain_Specific/nbody 中的 Linux 说明构建并运行 nbody 示例。
   
   注意：
   
   请通过导航到可执行文件所在的位置来运行示例，否则它将无法找到依赖资源。

**[VERBATIM END]**

此外，在**同一章节的第 1 步中强制要求**（逐字）：

> "Starting with CUDA 13.4, the NVIDIA Linux driver is no longer bundled with the CUDA Toolkit and must be installed separately. Install the driver by following the instructions in the [NVIDIA Driver Installation Guide](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/index.html)."（“从 CUDA 13.4 开始，NVIDIA Linux 驱动程序不再与 CUDA Toolkit 捆绑在一起，必须单独安装。请按照 NVIDIA 驱动程序安装指南中的说明安装驱动程序。”）

---

## 2. Ubuntu — Runfile Installer (§4.1.9.2)

**[VERBATIM START — Section 4.1.9.2 "Runfile Installer", steps 5–7]**

5. 重启系统以加载图形界面：
   
   ```
   sudo reboot
   ```
6. 通过修改 PATH 和 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 变量来设置开发环境：
   
   ```
   export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}
   export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64\
                            ${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
   ```
7. 从 https://github.com/nvidia/cuda-samples 安装示例的可写副本，然后按照 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuda-samples/tree/master/Samples/5_Domain_Specific/nbody 中的 Linux 说明构建并运行 nbody 示例。
   
   注意：
   
   请通过导航到可执行文件所在的位置来运行示例，否则它将无法找到依赖资源。

**[VERBATIM END]**

Ubuntu Runfile 方法还要求**首先禁用 Nouveau 驱动程序**（§4.1.9.2，第 1 步，逐字）：在 `/etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau.conf` 处创建一个文件，内容如下：

```
blacklist nouveau
options nouveau modeset=0
```

然后运行 `sudo update-initramfs -u`。

---

## 3. Canonical Export Block（所有 12 个 Linux 章节中逐字出现）

```
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64\
                         ${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
```

**出现位置（章节 → 步骤编号）：**

| 章节 | 平台 / 安装程序 | 导出步骤 |
|---|---|---|
| 4.1.1.1 | Redhat/CentOS — RPM | 第 6 步 |
| 4.1.1.2 | Redhat/CentOS — Runfile | 第 6 步 |
| 4.1.2.1 | Fedora — RPM | 第 5 步 |
| 4.1.2.2 | Fedora — Runfile | 第 6 步 |
| 4.1.3.1 | SUSE Linux Enterprise Server — RPM | 第 5 步 |
| 4.1.3.2 | SUSE Linux Enterprise Server — Runfile | 第 5 步 |
| 4.1.4.1 | OpenSUSE — RPM | 第 5 步 |
| 4.1.4.2 | OpenSUSE — Runfile | 第 6 步 |
| **4.1.9.1** | **Ubuntu — Debian** | **第 4 步** |
| **4.1.9.2** | **Ubuntu — Runfile** | **第 6 步** |
| 4.1.10.1 | Debian — Debian | 第 4 步 |
| 4.1.10.2 | Debian — Runfile | 第 6 步 |

---

## 4. 其他强制注意事项

- **驱动程序分离（CUDA 13.4 的新特性）：** “Starting with CUDA 13.4, the NVIDIA Linux driver is no longer bundled with the CUDA Toolkit and must be installed separately.”（从 CUDA 13.4 开始，NVIDIA Linux 驱动程序不再与 CUDA Toolkit 捆绑在一起，必须单独安装。）—— 出现在所有基于软件包的安装程序章节（§4.1.1.1、§4.1.2.1、§4.1.3.1、§4.1.4.1、§4.1.9.1、§4.1.10.1）的第 1 步中。
- **必须在每次安装后重启**（对于 Runfile 安装程序，需在 Nouveau 禁用 + 安装 + `nvidia-xconfig` 之后执行 `sudo reboot`）。
- **示例运行警告（在每个章节中重复出现）：** “Run samples by navigating to the executable's location, otherwise it will fail to locate dependent resources.”（请通过导航到可执行文件所在的位置来运行示例，否则它将无法找到依赖资源。）
- **SLES 额外步骤 (§4.1.3.1 和 §4.1.4.1)：** 将用户添加到 video 用户组 — `sudo usermod -a -G video <username>`。
- **WSL (§4.1.8，基于 Ubuntu) — 关键逐字注释：**
  > "Do not install a Linux NVIDIA driver inside the WSL environment. In WSL, the GPU driver is provided by the Windows host, and installing a Linux driver inside the WSL distribution will overwrite the driver provided by Windows and break CUDA."（“请勿在 WSL 环境中安装 Linux NVIDIA 驱动程序。在 WSL 中，GPU 驱动程序由 Windows 主机提供，在 WSL 发行版中安装 Linux 驱动程序将覆盖 Windows 提供的驱动程序并破坏 CUDA。”）

  WSL 仅通过 `sudo apt-get update` / `sudo apt-get install cuda-toolkit` 安装 toolkit，并且**不**包含上述导出步骤。

---

## 5. 格式说明

- 第二个 `export` 行末尾的 **`\`** 是 shell 的换行续行符；缩进的延续行仅为外观格式。在 §4.1.4.2 (OpenSUSE Runfile) 中，相同的代码块显示时，续行缩进略有减少——功能完全相同。

<answer>

## Ubuntu 从零安装 CUDA toolkit 后需配置的环境变量

### 官方推荐配置（NVIDIA CUDA 13.4 Quick Start Guide，Ubuntu 章节 §4.1.9.1 Debian Installer / §4.1.9.2 Runfile Installer 逐字）

```bash
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64\
                         ${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
```

（`\` 是 shell 换行续行符，可写成单行。路径中 `cuda-13.4` 为版本号，需按实际安装版本调整，如 `cuda-12.4`。）

### 说明与要点

1. **两个变量即可**：官方 Quick Start Guide 在 Ubuntu 的 deb 和 runfile 两种安装方式的步骤中，均只要求设置 `PATH`（指向 `bin`，使 `nvcc` 等工具可被找到）和 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`（指向 `lib64`，使运行时能链接 `libcudart` 等库）。该导出块在全部 12 个 Linux 安装章节中逐字一致（Ubuntu deb 为第 4 步、runfile 为第 6 步）。

2. **持久化**：export 只对当前 shell 生效，建议写入 `~/.bashrc` 或 `/etc/profile.d/cuda.sh`（官方文档本身未强制指定写入位置）。

3. **版本路径与符号链接**：CUDA Installation Guide for Linux（13.4 版，§6.2 Runfile Installation）说明：工具包默认安装到 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4`，安装器会创建 `/usr/local/cuda` 符号链接指向该目录——"This link allows projects to use the latest CUDA Toolkit without any configuration file update"。实践中可用 `/usr/local/cuda/bin`、`/usr/local/cuda/lib64` 写 PATH 以免升级改配置；但官方示例命令使用带版本号的绝对路径，升级新版后需更新版本号（否则 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 经符号链接会指向新版本库）。

4. **CUDA 13.4 的重要变化**：官方文档原文——"Starting with CUDA 13.4, the NVIDIA Linux driver is no longer bundled with the CUDA Toolkit and must be installed separately."（从 CUDA 13.4 起，NVIDIA Linux 驱动不再随 CUDA Toolkit 捆绑，须按 NVIDIA Driver Installation Guide 单独安装。）安装后需 `sudo reboot` 加载驱动。

5. **runfile 方式的前置步骤**：安装前需禁用 Nouveau——创建 `/etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau.conf`，内容为：
   ```
   blacklist nouveau
   options nouveau modeset=0
   ```
   然后执行 `sudo update-initramfs -u`。

6. **验证**：配置后可用 `nvcc --version` 验证编译器，并按官方指引从 https://github.com/nvidia/cuda-samples 获取示例构建运行 nbody（注意须 cd 到可执行文件所在目录运行，否则找不到依赖资源）。

7. **WSL（Ubuntu on Windows）特殊情形**：官方原文——"Do not install a Linux NVIDIA driver inside the WSL environment."（WSL 中驱动由 Windows 宿主提供，在 WSL 内安装 Linux 驱动会破坏 CUDA。）WSL 下仅安装 toolkit（`sudo apt-get install cuda-toolkit`），官方 WSL 章节不含上述导出步骤。

8. **非必需变量**：`CUDA_HOME`/`CUDA_ROOT`（指向 `/usr/local/cuda`）被部分第三方构建脚本（如一些 Python 包的编译脚本）识别，但不是 NVIDIA 官方要求的运行环境变量。

### 来源

- NVIDIA CUDA Quick Start Guide 13.4（官方，正文含逐字导出命令）：https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-quick-start-guide/index.html
- NVIDIA CUDA Installation Guide for Linux 13.4（官方，默认路径与 `/usr/local/cuda` 符号链接、驱动解绑说明）：https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-installation-guide-linux/
- 二手参考（CSDN 教程，仅作交叉存在性参考，未逐字核验）：https://blog.csdn.net/m0_57409671/article/details/154279396

### 无法核实处

- CUDA Installation Guide for Linux（docs.nvidia.com 文档中心版及 12.4.0 归档版）的 "Post-installation Actions" 章节正文：多次抓取均在文档中部被截断（同一页面重复于同一位置截断，原因未确定），未能取得该章节的 deb/rpm 与 runfile 差异原文。本答案的 deb/rpm 部分依据 Quick Start Guide 中 Ubuntu Debian Installer 章节补足。

- 安装过程未实际运行验证。

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识，我可以这样回答：

1. 安装完成后，CANN toolkit 提供环境设置脚本 set_env.sh，通常位于安装目录下，一般路径形如 `/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh`（run 包安装默认 `/usr/local/Ascend`，latest 链接指向最新版本，例如 `/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/x86_64-linux/set_env.sh` 或直接 `/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/set_env.sh`）。
2. 使用方式：`source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh`。
3. 该脚本主要设置的环境变量（凭记忆）：
   - `PATH`：追加 `arch` 目录（如 `$HOME/ascend-toolkit/latest/x86_64-linux/bin` 或 `/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/x86_64-linux/bin`）
   - `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`：追加 `lib64` 目录
   - `ASCEND_HOME_PATH`：指向 toolkit 安装根（如 `/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest`）
   - `ASCEND_AICPU_PATH`（部分版本）
   - `ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME`（新版本 6.x+ 用它替代/补充 ASCEND_HOME_PATH）
   - `PYTHONPATH`：指向 `python/site-packages` 或 `torch` 相关路径（视版本而定）
4. 持久化：把 source 命令写入 `~/.bashrc`。
5. 前提：已安装 NPU 驱动/固件（`.run` 驱动包），且 `npu-smi info` 能看到设备；toolkit 包（`Ascend-cann-toolkit_*.run`）已 chmod +x 后 `./Ascend-cann-toolkit_*.run --install`（或 apt/yum 仓库方式）。

不确定之处：
- set_env.sh 的确切层级路径（是 `ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh` 还是 `ascend-toolkit/latest/set_env.sh`，x86_64-linux 子目录是否在路径中）随版本变化，我记不确切。
- 具体环境变量清单在不同 CANN 版本（5.x/6.x/7.x/8.x）间有差异，特别是 `ASCEND_HOME_PATH` 与 `ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME` 的并存关系。
- Ubuntu 上 .deb 仓库安装（apt 方式）与 .run 包安装的路径是否一致。
- 是否需要额外 source `~/.bashrc` 以外的脚本（如 python env 脚本）。

以下用真实检索核实。

### [](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#%E5%89%8D%E7%BD%AE%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6)前置条件

已在环境上部署昇腾AI软件栈，请参见[Link](https://gitee.com/link?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hiascend.com%2Fdocument)中对应版本的CANN安装指南。

### [](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E9%A1%BB%E7%9F%A5)安装须知

开发环境及运行环境说明如下：

- **运行环境：** 运行环境指可运行算子、推理或训练等程序的环境，运行环境必须带昇腾AI处理器的设备。
- **开发环境：** 可用于代码开发、调试、编译等开发活动。该环境可以是带昇腾AI处理器的设备，也可以是其他满足CANN软件安装的环境。

开发环境和运行环境可以合设在同一台服务器上，也可以分设，分设场景下，开发环境下编译出来的可执行文件，在运行环境下执行时，若开发环境和运行环境上的操作系统架构不同，则需要在开发环境中执行交叉编译。

### [](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E6%AD%A5%E9%AA%A4)操作步骤

1. 以运行用户登录安装CANN软件的环境。
2. 配置CANN基础环境变量。
   
   1. （可选）查看set_env.sh脚本中涉及哪些环境变量。
      
      根据环境上安装的软件包，到对应的安装目录下，查看set_env.sh脚本。此处以普通用户的默认安装路径为例:
      
      - 若环境上安装的是Ascend-cann-toolkit软件包，则在$HOME/Ascend/ascend-toolkit目录下查看set_env.sh脚本；
      - 若环境上安装的是Ascend-cann-nnrt软件包，则在$HOME/Ascend/nnrt目录下查看set_env.sh脚本。
   2. （可选）执行以下命令查看查看环境变量的值是否正确。
      
      例如，set_env.sh脚本中有ASCEND_HOME_PATH环境变量，则执行“echo $ASCEND_HOME_PATH”命令，查看当前环境中该环境变量的值与set_env.sh脚本中的环境变量值是否一致，若一致，则跳至[配置Python环境变量](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#li001)；若不一致，则跳至[设置CANN基础环境变量](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#li002)后，再继续检查Python环境变量。
   3. 设置CANN基础环境变量。[](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md)
      
      当前昇腾CANN环境中已提供进程级环境变量设置脚本，供用户在进程中引用，以自动完成环境变量设置。用户进程结束后自动失效。示例如下（普通用户的默认安装路径为例）：
      
      - 安装Ascend-cann-toolkit包时配置
        
        ```
        . $HOME/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
        ```
      - 安装Ascend-cann-nnrt包时配置
        
        ```
        . $HOME/Ascend/nnrt/set_env.sh
        ```
      
      用户也可以通过修改 **~/.bashrc** 文件方式设置永久环境变量，操作如下：
      
      （1）以运行用户在任意目录下执行 **vi ~/.bashrc** 命令，打开.bashrc文件，在文件最后一行后面添加上述内容。
      
      （2）执行 **:wq!** 命令保存文件并退出。
      
      （3）执行 **source ~/.bashrc** 命令使其立即生效。
3. 配置Python环境变量（以Python3.7.5版本的默认安装路径为例）。[](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md)
   
   1. （可选）执行 **echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH** 命令，若返回的环境变量值中包含对应Python版本的lib库配置（例如，/usr/local/python3.7.5/lib），则Python版本的lib库配置正确；否则，跳至[设置Python环境变量](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#li0003)。
   2. （可选）执行 **echo $PATH** 命令，若返回的环境变量值中包含对应Python版本的bin配置（例如，/usr/local/python3.7.5/bin），则Python版本的bin配置正确；否则，跳至[设置Python环境变量](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md#li0003)。
   3. 设置Python环境变量。[](https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md)
      
      ```
      #用于设置python3.7.5库文件路径
      export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/python3.7.5/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
      #如果用户环境存在多个python3版本，则指定使用python3.7.5版本
      export PATH=/usr/local/python3.7.5/bin:$PATH
      ```

````
# Ascend DMI 环境配置

## 前提条件

| 软件包 | 说明 | 必选 |
|--------|------|------|
| npu-driver | NPU 驱动程序 | 是 |
| npu-firmware | NPU 固件 | 是 |
| CANN 开发套件包 | 性能测试和诊断依赖 | 是 |
| Ascend-cann-ops | 算子库（CANN 8.5.0 前为 Ascend-cann-kernels） | 训练场景必选 |

---

## ToolBox 环境配置

ascend-dmi 包含在 MindCluster ToolBox 中。

### 配置流程

```bash
# 1. 检查 ascend-dmi 是否可用
which ascend-dmi

# 2. 如不可用，source ToolBox 环境
source /usr/local/Ascend/toolbox/set_env.sh

# 3. 验证
which ascend-dmi && ascend-dmi -v
```

### 如果仍不可用：安装 MindCluster ToolBox

```bash
# 下载（以 7.3.0 / aarch64 为例，按实际版本和架构调整）
wget https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/MindX/MindX%207.3.0/Ascend-mindx-toolbox_7.3.0_linux-aarch64.run

# 安装（需要 root 权限）
chmod u+x Ascend-mindx-toolbox_*.run
./Ascend-mindx-toolbox_*.run --check    # 校验完整性
./Ascend-mindx-toolbox_*.run --install  # 安装

# 配置环境变量
source /usr/local/Ascend/toolbox/set_env.sh
```

安装成功标志：`[INFO] xxx install success`

---

## CANN 环境配置

多数 ascend-dmi 功能依赖 CANN。检查方法：

```bash
python -c "import acl; print(acl.get_soc_name())"
```

### 如果 CANN 不可用

**步骤 1：询问用户 CANN 路径**
- 直接问："CANN 安装在哪个路径？"
- 用户提供路径后：`source <路径>/set_env.sh`
- 必须获得用户同意后才能 source

**步骤 2：如用户不知道路径，征得同意后自动查找**

CANN 8.5.0+ 目录名为 `cann`，8.5.0 前为 `ascend-toolkit`。按优先级查找：

```bash
# 8.5.0+ 版本
ls /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh 2>/dev/null
ls /home/miniconda3/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh 2>/dev/null
find /home -path "*/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh" 2>/dev/null

# 8.5.0 前版本
ls /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh 2>/dev/null
find /home -path "*/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh" 2>/dev/null
```

**步骤 3：找到后确认并 source**
- 告知用户找到的路径，获得同意后 source
- source 后验证：`python -c "import acl; print(acl.get_soc_name())"`
- 如验证失败，继续查找下一个位置（不要执着于修复当前目录）

**步骤 4：全部失败时**
- 不要无限循环查找
- 告知用户："自动查找 CANN 失败，请提供准确的 CANN 安装路径"

---

## 环境检查清单

```bash
# 驱动
npu-smi info

# ascend-dmi
which ascend-dmi && ascend-dmi -v

# CANN
python -c "import acl; print(acl.get_soc_name())"

# 环境变量（可选）
echo $ASCEND_TOOLBOX_PATH
```

---

## 故障排查

### ascend-dmi 命令未找到

1. 检查是否已安装：`ls /usr/local/Ascend/toolbox/latest/Ascend-DMI/bin/ascend-dmi`
2. 已安装但未找到：`source /usr/local/Ascend/toolbox/set_env.sh`
3. 未安装：按上方步骤安装 MindCluster ToolBox

### CANN 不可用

按上方「CANN 环境配置」步骤处理。如果 source 后仍报错，检查驱动和固件是否安装：`npu-smi info`
````

# 安装后自动配置环境变量

描述CANN软件安装完成后，系统通过“set_env.sh”脚本默认配置的程序编译、执行相关的基础环境变量，以及后续程序编译执行时，需要手工配置的与安装包相关的环境变量。

CANN软件安装完成后，默认会自动配置程序编译、执行所依赖的基础环境变量，但用户进程结束后相关环境变量自动失效，您也可以通过如下环境变量脚本一键式配置。

```
# root用户安装时环境变量配置示例：
# 安装Toolkit包时
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
# 安装NNAL包的ATB加速库时
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
# 安装NNAL包的SiP加速库时
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/asdsip/set_env.sh
```

```
# 非root用户安装时环境变量配置示例：
source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh 
source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
source ${HOME}/Ascend/nnal/asdsip/set_env.sh
```

用户也可以通过修改~/.bashrc文件方式设置永久环境变量，操作如下：

1. 以运行用户在任意目录下执行vi ~/.bashrc命令，打开.bashrc文件，在文件最后一行后面添加上述内容。
2. 执行:wq!命令保存文件并退出。
3. 执行source ~/.bashrc命令使其立即生效。

详细环境变量说明如下表所示。

**表1** 环境变量说明

展开

软件包

环境变量名称

环境变量说明

开发套件包（Toolkit）

PATH

可执行文件查找路径。

LD_LIBRARY_PATH

动态库的查找路径。

PYTHONPATH

Python搜索路径。

ASCEND_OPP_PATH

算子库根目录。

ASCEND_AICPU_PATH

AI CPU组件的安装路径。

TOOLCHAIN_HOME

工具链安装路径。

ASCEND_HOME_PATH

同ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME，代表Toolkit软件安装后文件存储路径。

ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME

Toolkit软件包安装后文件存储路径。

CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH

CMAKE的内置环境变量，用于指定CMake库配置文件路径，供 'find_package()'等命令检索。

神经网络加速库（NNAL）中ATB加速库

ATB_HOME_PATH

ATB软件包安装后文件存储路径。

LD_LIBRARY_PATH

Linux系统中加载动态库时的搜寻路径列表。

PATH

将ATB软件包bin目录的路径添加到系统PATH环境变量中，推荐使用默认路径。

ATB_STREAM_SYNC_EVERY_KERNEL_ENABLE

用于问题定位，确定报错所在的kernel。当变量配置为1时，每个Kernel的Execute结束时就做流同步。

ATB_STREAM_SYNC_EVERY_RUNNER_ENABLE

用于问题定位，确定报错所在的runner。当变量配置为1时，每个Runner的Execute时就做流同步。

ATB_STREAM_SYNC_EVERY_OPERATION_ENABLE

用于问题定位，确定报错所在的Operation。当变量配置为1时，每个Operation的Execute时就做同步。

ATB_OPSRUNNER_KERNEL_CACHE_LOCAL_COUNT

本地kernelCache的槽位数。

- 槽位数增加时：增加cache命中率，但降低检索效率。
- 槽位数减少时：提高检索效率，但降低cache命中率。

ATB_OPSRUNNER_KERNEL_CACHE_GLOBAL_COUNT

全局kernelCache的槽位数。

- 槽位数增加：增加cache命中率，但降低检索效率。
- 槽位数减少：提高检索效率，但降低cache命中率。

ATB_WORKSPACE_MEM_ALLOC_ALG_TYPE

workspace内存分配算法选择。根据环境变量配置不同，ATB会选择不同的算法去计算workspace大小与workspace分配，用户可通过选择不同算法自行测试workspace分配情况。

ATB_COMPARE_TILING_EVERY_KERNEL

每个Kernel运行后，比较运行前和后的NPU上tiling内容是否变化，一般用于检查是否发生tiling内存踩踏。

ATB_SHARE_MEMORY_NAME_SUFFIX

共享内存命名后缀，多用户同时使用通信算子时，需通过设置该值进行共享内存的区分。

ATB_MATMUL_SHUFFLE_K_ENABLE

Shuffle-K使能，矩阵乘的结果矩阵不同位置计算时的累加序一致/不一致。会影响matmul算子内部累加序。

LCCL_DETERMINISTIC

LCCL确定性AllReduce（保序加）是否开启。需注意，开启功能在rankSize<=8时生效。

开启后会有如下影响：

- 影响部分通信算子性能。
- 影响lccl通信算子的累加序。

LCCL_PARALLEL

该功能和确定性计算无法同时开启，"LCCL_DETERMINISTIC"需要为0或者false。

多通信域并行功能使用结束后，LCCL_PARALLEL需要设置回false，否则会导致基础场景性能下降。不支持在运行过程中修改。

该环境变量只支持allReduce多线程并发场景使用，仅支持Atlas A2 训练系列产品/Atlas A2 推理系列产品8卡且数据量小于100MB。

神经网络加速库（NNAL）中SiP加速库

ASDSIP_HOME_PATH

SiP软件包安装后文件存储路径。

LD_LIBRARY_PATH

Linux系统中加载动态库时的搜索路径列表。

**标题**: CANN训练营环境搭建实战：Ubuntu系统安装全记录_cann-kernel 安装-CSDN博客
**发布时间**: 最新推荐文章于 2026-02-26 00:06:35 发布
2025-10-27 20:16:34

# CANN训练营环境搭建实战：Ubuntu系统安装全记录 原创

### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)训练营简介

2025年昇腾CANN训练营第二季，基于CANN开源开放全场景，推出0基础入门系列、码力全开特辑、开发者案例等专题课程，助力不同阶段开发者快速提升算子开发技能。获得Ascend C算子中级认证，即可领取精美证书，完成社区任务更有机会赢取华为手机、平板、开发板等大奖。

### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)环境准备：打好基础是关键

在开始安装CANN之前，充分的准备工作能避免后续很多不必要的问题。根据官方文档要求，我需要确保系统具备Python环境及pip3，当前CANN支持的**Python版本为3.7.x至3.11.4**。

我使用的是Ubuntu 20.04 LTS，首先检查Python版本：

```bash
python3 --version
pip3 --version

1212
```

当我第一次尝试安装时，遇到了"pip3: command not found"错误。通过查阅文档，发现这是因为环境变量未正确配置。解决方案是指定Python路径并配置环境变量：

```bash
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/python3.7.5/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export PATH=/usr/local/python3.7.5/bin:$PATH

1212
```

对于使用容器的同学，可能会遇到"Cannot fork"错误。这是因为/bin/sh链接到了dash，需要将其修改为bash：

```bash
ls -l /bin/sh
ln -sf bash /bin/sh  # 如果回显为dash，执行此命令

1212
```

### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)安装CANN软件包：步步为营

#### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)配置昇腾源

首先需要配置昇腾源，否则无法安装：

```bash
sudo curl https://repo.oepkgs.net/ascend/cann/ascend.repo -o /etc/yum.repos.d/ascend.repo && yum makecache

11
```

#### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)安装Toolkit开发套件包

CANN Toolkit开发套件包在训练、推理和开发调试场景下都需要安装，主要用于训练和推理业务、模型转换、算子/应用/模型的开发和编译。

安装前请确保安装目录可用空间**大于10G**：

```bash
sudo yum install -y Ascend-cann-toolkit-8.2.RC1

11
```

安装完成后，配置环境变量：

```bash
source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh

11
```

**注意**：上述环境变量配置只在当前窗口生效，可以按需将命令写入~/.bashrc文件。

#### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)安装其他必要组件

根据你的使用场景，可能还需要安装：

- **NNAE深度学习引擎包**：主要用于训练和推理业务
- **NNRT离线推理引擎包**：在边缘推理场景下安装，仅支持离线推理
- **Kernels算子包**：包括单算子API执行动态库/静态库文件，以及kernel二进制文件

安装Kernels算子包前，需已安装配套版本的Toolkit并配置环境变量。

### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)实战问题与解决方案

#### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)1. 安装过程中的依赖问题

第一次安装CANN软件包时，我遇到了依赖缺失的问题。特别是当系统中有多个Python版本时，很容易出现兼容性问题。

**解决方案**：使用虚拟环境隔离不同项目的依赖，或者明确指定Python版本路径。确保环境变量配置正确。

#### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)2. 环境变量配置混乱

在安装多个CANN组件后，环境变量配置容易变得混乱，导致版本冲突。

**解决方案**：在~/.bashrc中清晰注释每个环境变量的作用，并只保留当前使用的组件环境变量。可以使用以下命令检查环境变量：

```bash
echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH
echo $PYTHONPATH

1212
```

#### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)3. 模型转换问题

在使用ATC工具进行模型转换时，经常会遇到算子不支持或格式不匹配的问题。

**解决方案**：仔细检查模型输入输出格式，使用ATC工具的日志调试功能。对于不支持的算子，可以考虑使用自定义算子开发。

### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)验证安装：运行第一个样例

安装完成后，最好的验证方法就是运行一个简单样例。我选择了目标检测的样例进行测试。

首先需要安装第三方依赖，包括OpenCV和Python-acllite：

```bash
# 安装opencv
sudo apt-get install python3-opencv

# 安装python-acllite依赖
sudo apt-get install -y libavformat-dev libavcodec-dev libavdevice-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev
pip3 install av numpy Pillow

123456123456
```

设置环境变量：

```bash
export CPU_ARCH=`arch`
export THIRDPART_PATH=${HOME}/Ascend/thirdpart/${CPU_ARCH}
export PYTHONPATH=${THIRDPART_PATH}/acllite:$PYTHONPATH
export INSTALL_DIR=${HOME}/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest

12341234
```

下载样例代码：

```bash
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/samples.git

11
```

在运行样例时，我遇到了"acl调用出错"的问题，通过重新配置环境变量并确保所有依赖安装完整，最终解决了这个问题。

### [](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)[](https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447)学习心得与下一步计划

通过这次CANN环境搭建实践，我深刻体会到：

1. **文档是关键**：昇腾社区提供了详细的安装指南，遇到问题时首先应该查阅官方文档。
2. **环境隔离很重要**：使用虚拟环境或容器技术可以避免依赖冲突。
3. **循序渐进**：先从简单的样例开始，逐步深入理解CANN的架构和使用方法。
4. **社区资源丰富**：昇腾社区提供了丰富的在线视频课程和代码样例，善于利用这些资源能加速学习进程。

在环境搭建过程中，最耗时的往往不是安装本身，而是解决环境依赖和兼容性问题。记录下每次遇到的问题和解决方案，形成自己的知识库，对长期发展极为有益。

下一步，我计划继续深入学习CANN的模型转换工具ATC和推理接口AscendCL，争取早日完成第一个完整的模型部署项目。同时，我也会关注CANN训练营的后续课程，系统提升算子开发技能。

## Ubuntu 从零安装 CANN toolkit 后的环境变量配置

### 1. 先决条件（从零安装的前提）

- 已安装 NPU 驱动与固件，可用 `npu-smi info` 验证设备可见。
- Python 支持 3.7.x–3.11.4（CANN 8.x 训练营版本实测）。
- 安装 Toolkit 前安装目录可用空间需大于 10G。

安装方式（Ubuntu，以 CANN 8.2.RC1 为例，apt 仓库方式）：

```bash
# 配置昇腾软件源后（Ubuntu 用 apt 源，yum 为 CentOS 用法）
sudo apt install -y Ascend-cann-toolkit-8.2.RC1
# 或 .run 包方式：
chmod u+x Ascend-cann-toolkit_*.run
./Ascend-cann-toolkit_*.run --install
```

### 2. source 哪个 set_env.sh（注意版本差异）

**关键版本差异：CANN 8.5.0 起安装目录名由 `ascend-toolkit` 改为 `cann`。**

CANN 8.5.0 及以后（含 9.x，如 CANN 9.1.0）：

```bash
# root 用户安装（默认 /usr/local/Ascend）：
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh

# 非 root 用户安装（默认 $HOME/Ascend）：
source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
```

CANN 8.5.0 之前（如 8.2.RC1、7.x、6.x）：

```bash
# root 用户安装：
source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh

# 非 root 用户安装：
source ${HOME}/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
# 官方 samples 文档中的等价写法：. $HOME/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
```

若装的是 nnrt 推理包而非 toolkit：`. $HOME/Ascend/nnrt/set_env.sh`。
若装了 NNAL ATB 加速库（root）：`source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh`；SiP 加速库：`source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/asdsip/set_env.sh`。

### 3. set_env.sh 自动配置的环境变量（Toolkit 包）

官方"安装后自动配置环境变量"页（CANN 9.x 文档）给出的 Toolkit 环境变量表：

| 环境变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | 可执行文件查找路径（追加 `.../bin`、`arch` 目录） |
| `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` | 动态库查找路径（追加 `lib64`） |
| `PYTHONPATH` | Python 搜索路径 |
| `ASCEND_OPP_PATH` | 算子库根目录 |
| `ASCEND_AICPU_PATH` | AI CPU 组件安装路径 |
| `TOOLCHAIN_HOME` | 工具链安装路径 |
| `ASCEND_HOME_PATH` | 同 ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME，Toolkit 安装后文件存储路径 |
| `ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME` | Toolkit 软件包安装后文件存储路径 |
| `CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH` | CMake 库配置文件路径，供 `find_package()` 检索 |

这些变量是**进程级**的：脚本安装完成后会自动配置一次，但用户进程结束后失效，所以每个新 shell 都要重新 source。

### 4. 持久化（写入 ~/.bashrc）

```bash
vi ~/.bashrc   # 最后一行添加 source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
# :wq! 保存退出
source ~/.bashrc
```

### 5. 验证

```bash
echo $ASCEND_HOME_PATH     # 应指向 set_env.sh 中设定的安装路径
echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH
echo $PYTHONPATH
npu-smi info               # 驱动正常
python3 -c "import acl; print(acl.get_soc_name())"  # CANN 可用性
```

### 来源

- 官方（昇腾社区文档，SPA 页面，其中 910 版环境变量参考页返回了直接正文）：
  - https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/910/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0003.html （set_env.sh 路径、root/非 root 命令、Toolkit 环境变量表、~/.bashrc 持久化）
  - https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/900/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0003.html （同页 9.0 版，抓取仅返回标题/导航，未取得正文）
  - https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/83RC1alpha001/softwareinst/instg/instg_quick.html （快速安装，抓取仅返回页面外壳，正文未取得——原因未确定，疑似动态渲染）
- 官方仓库（Gitee/GitHub 昇腾 samples，均取得直接完整正文）：
  - https://gitee.com/ascend/samples/blob/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ascend/samples/master/cplusplus/environment/environment_variable_configuration_CN.md （`. $HOME/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh`、nnrt 路径、~/.bashrc 步骤、echo 验证）
- 第三方（辅助交叉印证）：
  - https://github.com/ascend-ai-coding/awesome-ascend-skills/blob/main/skills/base/ascend-dmi/references/environment-setup.md （CANN 8.5.0+ 目录名 `cann`、8.5.0 前 `ascend-toolkit`、查找与验证命令）
  - https://blog.csdn.net/aasd23/article/details/153980447 （Ubuntu 20.04 + CANN 8.2.RC1 实战：`source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh`、Python 3.7.x–3.11.4、10G 空间、写入 .bashrc）

### 无法核实处

- hiascend 快速安装页正文未能抓回（SPA 只返回外壳），Ubuntu 上 apt 源的精确配置命令（该文章给出的是 yum 写法 `sudo curl https://repo.oepkgs.net/ascend/cann/ascend.repo ...`）未在官方可抓取正文中直接核实。
- `ASCEND_OPP_PATH` 等变量的具体默认取值（指向哪个子目录）官方页为表格只给说明，未给出具体路径示例；如需精确值建议装后直接 `cat /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh` 查看（官方 samples 文档也建议此做法）。
- 各环境变量清单随 CANN 大版本有增减（如 5.x/6.x 的 `ASCEND_DEVICE_ID` 等），本答案以 9.x 官方表为准。

question: 怎么用昇腾官方镜像 / Ascend docker 跑一个带 NPU 的 PyTorch 容器？要挂哪些 `/dev` 设备、用 ascend-docker-runtime 吗？
criteria: 怎么用昇腾官方镜像 / Ascend docker 跑一个带 NPU 的 PyTorch 容器？要挂哪些 `/dev` 设备、用 ascend-docker-runtime 吗？

M4.scope: Ascend容器镜像、容器运行时与宿主环境

M9.scope: Ascend容器镜像、容器运行时与宿主环境

M10.scope: 原题要求的操作；概念解释不强制代码

applicability.other_metrics: M1/M2/M3/M5/M6/M7依实际证据状态；M8依派发计数。没有第三方资料时M6=N/A，不把未查到写成不适用。

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识可以这样回答：

1. **镜像来源**：华为 Ascend 官方镜像仓库（Ascend Hub，ascendhub.huawei.com，后来也在 swr 区域提供），里面有 CANN 镜像和 PyTorch 镜像，比如 `ascendhub/ascend-runtime`、`ascendhub/ascend-cann-pytorch`、matrix 镜像等。具体仓库域名和当前 tag 命名我不完全确定（是否已迁移到 swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com、具体版本 tag 格式）。

2. **设备挂载**：不装 ascend-docker-runtime 时，通常需要挂：
   - `--device /dev/davinci0`（按卡号，多卡挂多个）
   - `--device /dev/davinci_manager`
   - `--device /dev/devmm_svm`
   - `--device /dev/hisi_hdc`
   另外 `-v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver` 复用宿主机驱动。这个设备清单我记得比较牢，但具体是否还有 `/dev/davinci0` 之外新增设备（新版本芯片）不确定。

3. **ascend-docker-runtime**：Ascend 提供了 ascend-docker-runtime，安装并配置 `/etc/docker/daemon.json` 里 `"runtimes": {"ascend": ...}` 后，用 `docker run --runtime=ascend` 即可自动挂载 NPU 设备和驱动，无需手动 `--device`。是否还能用 `ASCEND_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 环境变量控制挂哪几张卡，我记得有这个机制但细节不确定。

不确定处：当前官方镜像的确切 URL 与最新 tag；aarch64/x86_64 镜像差异；ascend-docker-runtime 的确切安装步骤与配置文件位置；是否必须挂宿主机 driver 目录。

# 安装Ascend Docker Runtime

MindCluster Ascend Docker Runtime（容器引擎插件）为训推任务提供容器化支持，自动挂载所需文件和设备依赖。

本节将提供快速安装Ascend Docker Runtime的步骤，用以后续部署容器镜像，更多使用方法请参考《MindCluster 集群调度用户指南》的“安装 > 安装部署 > 手动安装 > [Ascend Docker Runtime](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindcluster/71RC1/clustersched/dlug/dlug_installation_017.html)”章节。

#### 获取软件包

软件类型

软件包名称

获取链接

Ascend Docker Runtime容器引擎插件

Ascend-docker-runtime_*<version>*_linux-*<arch>*.run

[获取链接](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/mind-cluster/releases/v7.1.RC1)

#### 安装步骤

1. 以**root**用户登录服务器，将软件包Ascend-docker-runtime_*<version>*_linux-*<arch>*.run上传到服务器任意目录（如“/home”）。
2. 增加对软件包的可执行权限，校验软件包安装文件的一致性和完整性。
   
   ```
   chmod +x Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
   ./Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --check
   ```
   
   校验完成的回显如下：
   
   ```
   1
   2
   3
   4
   5
   ```
   
   ```
   [WARNING]: --check is meaningless for Ascend-docker-runtime and will be discarded in the future
   Verifying archive integrity... ./Ascend-docker-runtime_
   <version>_linux-<arch>.run does not contain an embedded SHA256 checksum.
   ...
    All good.
   ```
3. 执行以下命令安装软件。
   
   ```
   ./Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --install
   ```
   
   安装完成后，若显示类似如下信息，则说明软件安装成功：
   
   ```
   1
   2
   3
   4
   ```
   
   ```
   Uncompressing ascend-docker-runtime  100%
   [INFO]: installing ascend docker runtime
   ...
   [INFO] Ascend Docker Runtime install success
   ```
4. 执行如下命令，使容器引擎插件在docker配置文件中添加的内容生效。
   
   ```
   1
   ```
   
   ```
   systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart docker
   ```

<answer>

## 用 Ascend 官方镜像跑带 NPU 的 PyTorch 容器

### 1. 镜像选择

官方 PyTorch-NPU 镜像为 Docker Hub 上的 `ascendai/pytorch`（昇腾开源文档给出的示例镜像），另有昇腾社区镜像仓库 Ascend Hub（https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub）提供各版本 CANN/框架镜像（该站点为动态页，本文未能抓到正文，具体 tag 需到页面查询）。

版本配套关系（来源：昇腾开源官方文档 install.html）：
- PyTorch 2.3.1 ↔ torch-npu 2.3.1 ↔ CANN 8.0.RC2，支持 x86-64 / aarch64
- 前提：宿主机已安装与该 CANN 版本匹配的 NPU 驱动和固件（容器内无需装驱动）

### 2. 不装 ascend-docker-runtime：手动挂载设备（官方文档原文命令）

来源：昇腾开源文档 PyTorch 安装指南（https://ascend.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/sources/pytorch/install.html）

```bash
docker run \
    --name cann_container \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -e DRIVER_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
    -it ascendai/pytorch:2.3.1 bash
```

必须挂的 4 类设备（CANN 商用版官方文档 https://www.hiascend.com/doc_center/source/zh/canncommercial/601/envdeployment/instg/instg_000115.html）：
- `/dev/davinci*X*`：NPU 设备，X 是卡号（如 davinci0，多卡挂多个）
- `/dev/davinci_manager`：davinci 管理设备
- `/dev/devmm_svm`：内存管理设备
- `/dev/hisi_hdc`：hdc 通信管理设备

该官方文档还说明：Atlas 300I Pro / 300V Pro / 300V / 300I Duo 等训练/推理卡要把驱动库拆成两个目录挂载（`/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/common` 和 `/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/driver`）；CentOS/BC-linux 宿主机训练场景需加 `--pids-limit 409600`；Atlas 200I SoC A1 是另一套设备/挂载清单（含 `/dev/xsmem_dev`、`/dev/event_sched`、`/dev/svm0`、`/dev/vdec` 等，详见上表）。

### 3. 推荐：用 ascend-docker-runtime（自动挂载设备，免手动 --device）

来源：CANN 社区版官方文档“安装Ascend Docker Runtime”（https://www.hiascend.com/doc_center/source/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/83RC1alpha003/softwareinst/instg/instg_0020.html）

MindCluster Ascend Docker Runtime 容器引擎插件会**自动挂载所需文件和设备依赖**。安装步骤（官方原文）：

```bash
# 1. 从 https://gitcode.com/Ascend/mind-cluster/releases/v7.1.RC1 下载
#    Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run，root 上传服务器

./Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --check
./Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --install
# 2. 生效
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart docker
```

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识，我会这样回答：

1. 概念澄清：`nvidia-docker` 是 1.0 时代的老项目（通过 volume 挂载驱动 + docker 包装器实现），已被淘汰；现在的标准方案是 **NVIDIA Container Toolkit**（提供 `nvidia-container-runtime` / CDI 集成），直接作为 Docker 的原生 runtime hook 使用。
2. 宿主机前提：Linux + NVIDIA GPU + 已安装 GPU 驱动（容器内不需要也不应该装驱动，toolkit 会把宿主驱动挂进容器）+ Docker（或 Podman/containerd/cri-o）。
3. 安装 toolkit：Ubuntu 上大致是添加 `nvidia-container-toolkit` 的 apt 源（`nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container`），然后 `sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit`，再 `sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker` 并 `sudo systemctl restart docker`。老版本命令是 `nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker` 之前可能要手动改 `/etc/docker/daemon.json` 加 `nvidia` runtime。
4. 运行：`docker run --gpus all ...` 或 `--runtime=nvidia`（+ 环境变量 `NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all`）。`--gpus` 需要 Docker 19.03+ 且 toolkit 已配置。可以 `--gpus 2`、`--gpus '"device=0,1"'` 或 `--gpus 'capabilities=compute,utility'`。
5. NGC 镜像：`docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3`（如 `24.01-py3`），需要先 `docker login nvcr.io`（用户名 `$oauthtoken`，密码为 NGC API key，公开镜像其实也可以匿名拉取）。运行示例：`docker run --gpus all -it --rm nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:24.01-py3 bash`。容器内 `python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"` 验证。NGC PyTorch 镜像内置 CUDA、cuDNN、NCCL 和 PyTorch，无需再装。

不确定处：
- toolkit apt/yum 源的最新具体 URL 和密钥命令（我记得是 `curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg`，但 repositories 配置文件的具体路径如 `.list` / `sources.list.d` 细节可能过时）。
- NGC PyTorch 镜像 tag 的最新命名规范（`xx.xx-py3` 是否仍是当前格式，是否出现了 `-pytorch` 变体）。
- 是否要求 Docker 19.03+ 的准确下限，以及 CDI 是否已成为默认推荐路径。
- WSL2 特殊说明未展开。

**标题**: Installing the NVIDIA Container Toolkit — NVIDIA Container Toolkit

Back to top

# Installing the NVIDIA Container Toolkit[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#installing-the-nvidia-container-toolkit "Permalink to this headline")

## Installation[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#installation "Permalink to this headline")

### Prerequisites[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#prerequisites "Permalink to this headline")

1. Review the [platform support documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/supported-platforms.html).
2. Install the NVIDIA GPU driver for your Linux distribution. NVIDIA recommends installing the driver by using the package manager for your distribution. For information about installing the driver with a package manager, refer to the [*NVIDIA Driver Installation Quickstart Guide*](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/tesla-installation-notes/index.html). Alternatively, you can install the driver by [downloading](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/) a `.run` installer.

Note

There is a [known issue](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/troubleshooting.html#containers-losing-access-to-gpus-with-error-failed-to-initialize-nvml-unknown-error) on systems where `systemd` cgroup drivers are used that cause containers to lose access to requested GPUs when `systemctl daemon reload` is run. Refer to the troubleshooting documentation for more information.

### With `apt`: Ubuntu, Debian[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#with-apt-ubuntu-debian "Permalink to this headline")

Note

These instructions [should work](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/supported-platforms.html) for any Debian-derived distribution.

1. Install the prerequisites for the instructions below:
   
   ```
   $ sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates \
      curl \
      gnupg2
   ```
2. Configure the production repository:
   
   ```
   $ curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg \
     && curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | \
       sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | \
       sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list
   ```
   
   Optionally, configure the repository to use experimental packages:
   
   ```
   $ sudo sed -i -e '/experimental/ s/^#//g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list
   ```
3. Update the packages list from the repository:
   
   ```
   $ sudo apt-get update
   ```
4. Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit packages:
   
   ```
   $ export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
     sudo apt-get install -y \
         nvidia-container-toolkit=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-base=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container-tools=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container1=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
   ```

### With `dnf`: RHEL/CentOS, Fedora, Amazon Linux[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#with-dnf-rhel-centos-fedora-amazon-linux "Permalink to this headline")

Note

These instructions [should work](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/supported-platforms.html) for many RPM-based distributions.

1. Install the prerequisites for the instructions below:
   
   ```
   $ sudo dnf install -y \
      curl
   ```
2. Configure the production repository:
   
   ```
   $ curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo | \
     sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo
   ```
   
   Optionally, configure the repository to use experimental packages:
   
   ```
   $ sudo dnf config-manager --enable nvidia-container-toolkit-experimental
   ```
3. Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit packages:
   
   ```
   $ export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
     sudo dnf install -y \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-base-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container-tools-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container1-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
   ```

### With `zypper`: OpenSUSE, SLE[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#with-zypper-opensuse-sle "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the production repository:
   
   ```
   $ sudo zypper ar https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo
   ```
   
   Optionally, configure the repository to use experimental packages:
   
   ```
   $ sudo zypper modifyrepo --enable nvidia-container-toolkit-experimental
   ```
2. Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit packages:
   
   ```
   $  export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
      sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys install -y \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-base-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container-tools-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container1-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
   ```

## Configuration[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuration "Permalink to this headline")

### Prerequisites[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#id1 "Permalink to this headline")

- You installed a supported container engine (Docker, Containerd, CRI-O, Podman).
- You installed the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

### Managing `config.toml`[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#managing-config-toml "Permalink to this headline")

The `nvidia-ctk config` command reads `/etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml` by default. Without `--in-place` or `--output`, the command writes the updated configuration to standard output and does not change the source file.

Preview a change before you write it to the host:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.log-level=debug
```

Review the output. Then, add `--in-place` to update the source file:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config --in-place \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.log-level=debug
```

You can specify `--set` more than once. The following command configures a log level and a log file in one update:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config --in-place \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.log-level=debug \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.debug=/var/log/nvidia-container-runtime.log
```

For a list setting, separate elements with a colon. The following command makes `crun` the first low-level runtime candidate and retains `runc` as a fallback:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config --in-place \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.runtimes=crun:runc
```

When the same key appears more than once, the last value takes effect. The command preserves existing settings when you change a different setting. Review the preview before every production update, especially when you use a custom file with `--config-file`.

### Configuring Docker[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-docker "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker
   ```
   
   The `nvidia-ctk` command modifies the `/etc/docker/daemon.json` file on the host. The file is updated so that Docker can use the NVIDIA Container Runtime.
2. Restart the Docker daemon:
   
   ```
   $ sudo systemctl restart docker
   ```

#### Rootless Mode[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#rootless-mode "Permalink to this headline")

To configure the container runtime for Docker running in [Rootless mode](https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/rootless/), follow these steps:

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker --config=$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json
   ```
2. Restart the Rootless Docker daemon:
   
   ```
   $ systemctl --user restart docker
   ```
3. Configure `/etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml` by using the `sudo nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk config --set nvidia-container-cli.no-cgroups --in-place
   ```

### Configuring containerd (for Kubernetes)[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-containerd-for-kubernetes "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=containerd
   ```
   
   By default, the `nvidia-ctk` command creates a `/etc/containerd/conf.d/99-nvidia.toml` drop-in config file and modifies (or creates) the `/etc/containerd/config.toml` file to ensure that the `imports` config option is updated accordingly. The drop-in file ensures that containerd can use the NVIDIA Container Runtime.
2. Restart containerd:
   
   ```
   $ sudo systemctl restart containerd
   ```

### Configuring containerd (for nerdctl)[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-containerd-for-nerdctl "Permalink to this headline")

No additional configuration is needed. You can run `nerdctl run --gpus=all`, with or without root. You do not need to run the `nvidia-ctk` command mentioned above for Kubernetes.

Refer to the [nerdctl documentation](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/blob/main/docs/gpu.md) for more information.

### Configuring CRI-O[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-cri-o "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=crio
   ```
   
   By default, the `nvidia-ctk` command creates a `/etc/crio/conf.d/99-nvidia.toml` drop-in config file. The drop-in file ensures that CRI-O can use the NVIDIA Container Runtime.
2. Restart the CRI-O daemon:
   
   ```
   $ sudo systemctl restart crio
   ```

### Configuring Podman[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-podman "Permalink to this headline")

For Podman, NVIDIA recommends using [CDI](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/cdi-support.html) for accessing NVIDIA devices in containers.

## Next Steps[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#next-steps "Permalink to this headline")

- [Running a Sample Workload](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/sample-workload.html)

### Running PyTorch Using Docker

To run a container, issue the appropriate command as explained in the Running A Container chapter in the *NVIDIA Containers For Deep Learning Frameworks User’s Guide* and specify the registry, repository, and tags. For more information about using NGC, refer to the NGC Container User Guide.

```
docker run --gpus all -it --rm nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3
```

If you have Docker 19.02 or earlier, a typical command to launch the container is:

```
nvidia-docker run -it --rm -v nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3
```

Where:

- `xx.xx` is the container version. For example, `22.01`.

PyTorch is run by importing it as a Python module:

```
$ python
>>> import torch
>>> print(torch.cuda.is_available())
True
```

See **`/workspace/README.md`** inside the container for information on getting started and customizing your PyTorch image.

You might want to pull in data and model descriptions from locations outside the container for use by PyTorch. To accomplish this, the easiest method is to mount one or more host directories as Docker bind mounts. For example:

```
docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v local_dir:container_dir nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3
```

2. 已安装 Docker（或其他受支持的容器引擎：containerd、CRI-O、Podman）

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html（Prerequisites 一节）

## 安装 NVIDIA Container Toolkit（以 Ubuntu/Debian 为例）

```bash
# 1. 安装前置工具
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl gnupg2

# 2. 配置官方生产仓库
curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg \
  && curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | \
    sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | \
    sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list

# 3. 更新并安装（官方文档示例固定 1.20.1-1，也可不固定版本直接装最新）
sudo apt-get update
export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
sudo apt-get install -y \
    nvidia-container-toolkit=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
    nvidia-container-toolkit-base=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
    libnvidia-container-tools=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
    libnvidia-container1=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}

RHEL/CentOS/Fedora 用 `dnf`（repo 文件 `https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo`），SUSE 用 `zypper`，命令见同一官方安装指南。

## 配置 Docker 运行时并重启

```bash
sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker   # 会修改 /etc/docker/daemon.json
sudo systemctl restart docker
```

（Rootless Docker 场景：`nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker --config=$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json` + `systemctl --user restart docker` + `sudo nvidia-ctk config --set nvidia-container-cli.no-cgroups --in-place`。）

```bash
docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.08-py3      # 当前最新 tag（26.08-py3）

# 交互式运行
docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v local_dir:container_dir nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.08-py3

# 非交互式运行
docker run --gpus all --rm -v local_dir:container_dir nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.08-py3

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识，我会这样回答：

1. **先做逐元素统计比对**：用 `torch.testing.assert_close(got, expected, rtol=..., atol=...)`（旧版 `torch.allclose`），先算最大绝对误差、相对误差分布（`abs(a-b).max()`、`(a-b).abs().mean()`），看误差是集中在特定元素还是整体偏移。
2. **检查常见根因**：half/bf16 输入下 kernel 内部累加未用 fp32（`float acc=0.f` 累加 half 会有明显漂移）；fast math（`-use_fast_math`、`__expf`、`__fdividef` 等）造成的精度损失；未初始化内存、race condition（用 `compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck/racecheck`、`CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1`）；grid/block 映射错位导致写错位置。
3. **逐层比对（针对组合算子）**：把 kernel 拆成阶段，每阶段写回中间 tensor，与 CPU 参考的对应中间结果比；或用小的 `torch.autograd.gradcheck`（double 精度）验证梯度算子。
4. **控制随机性**：固定 `torch.manual_seed`，禁用 TF32（`torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False`），确认 CPU/GPU 参考在同一 dtype 下。
5. **降低输入规模二分定位**：构造最小复现（如 size=1 或单行），逐步放大。

不确定处：
- `torch.testing.assert_close` 的确切参数名（`rtol/atol/equal_nan/msg`）与不同 PyTorch 版本的行为差异；
- PyTorch 官方关于 double 累加/TF32 的推荐设置原文；
- CUDA Math API 文档中关于 fast math 内建函数精度（ulp 误差）的官方数值；
- compute-sanitizer 的官方获取与具体子工具选项名。

**标题**: torch.testing — PyTorch 2.14 documentation

# torch.testing#

# torch.testing#
Created On: May 07, 2021 | Last Updated On: Jun 10, 2025

torch.testing.assert_close(*actual*, *expected*, ***, *allow_subclasses=True*, *rtol=None*, *atol=None*, *equal_nan=False*, *check_device=True*, *check_dtype=True*, *check_layout=True*, *check_stride=False*, *msg=None*)[[source]](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/v2.14.0/torch/testing/_comparison.py#L1415)#

Asserts that `actual` and `expected` are close.

If `actual` and `expected` are strided, non-quantized, real-valued, and finite, they are considered close if

∣actual−expected∣≤atol+rtol⋅∣expected∣\lvert \text{actual} - \text{expected} \rvert \le \texttt{atol} + \texttt{rtol} \cdot \lvert \text{expected} \rvert

Non-finite values (`-inf` and `inf`) are only considered close if and only if they are equal. `NaN`’s are only considered equal to each other if `equal_nan` is `True`.

In addition, they are only considered close if they have the same

- `device` (if `check_device` is `True`),
- `dtype` (if `check_dtype` is `True`),
- `layout` (if `check_layout` is `True`), and
- stride (if `check_stride` is `True`).

If either `actual` or `expected` is a meta tensor, only the attribute checks will be performed.

If `actual` and `expected` are sparse (either having COO, CSR, CSC, BSR, or BSC layout), their strided members are checked individually. Indices, namely `indices` for COO, `crow_indices` and `col_indices` for CSR and BSR, or `ccol_indices` and `row_indices` for CSC and BSC layouts, respectively, are always checked for equality whereas the values are checked for closeness according to the definition above.

# torch.testing#
If `actual` and `expected` are quantized, they are considered close if they have the same `qscheme()` and the result of `dequantize()` is close according to the definition above.

`actual` and `expected` can be `Tensor`’s or any tensor-or-scalar-likes from which `torch.Tensor`’s can be constructed with `torch.as_tensor()`. Except for Python scalars the input types have to be directly related. In addition, `actual` and `expected` can be `Sequence`")’s or `Mapping`")’s in which case they are considered close if their structure matches and all their elements are considered close according to the above definition.

Note

Python scalars are an exception to the type relation requirement, because their `type()`, i.e. `int`"), `float`"), and `complex`"), is equivalent to the `dtype` of a tensor-like. Thus, Python scalars of different types can be checked, but require `check_dtype=False`.

Parameters:

# torch.testing#
- **actual** (*Any*) – Actual input.
- **expected** (*Any*) – Expected input.
- **allow_subclasses** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default) and except for Python scalars, inputs of directly related types are allowed. Otherwise type equality is required.
- **rtol** (*Optional*[*float*")*]*) – Relative tolerance. If specified `atol` must also be specified. If omitted, default values based on the `dtype` are selected with the below table.
- **atol** (*Optional*[*float*")*]*) – Absolute tolerance. If specified `rtol` must also be specified. If omitted, default values based on the `dtype` are selected with the below table.
- **equal_nan** (*Union*[*bool*")*,* *str*")*]*) – If `True`, two `NaN` values will be considered equal.
- **check_device** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default), asserts that corresponding tensors are on the same `device`. If this check is disabled, tensors on different `device`’s are moved to the CPU before being compared.

# torch.testing#
- **check_dtype** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default), asserts that corresponding tensors have the same `dtype`. If this check is disabled, tensors with different `dtype`’s are promoted to a common `dtype` (according to `torch.promote_types()`) before being compared.
- **check_layout** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default), asserts that corresponding tensors have the same `layout`. If this check is disabled, tensors with different `layout`’s are converted to strided tensors before being compared.
- **check_stride** (*bool*")) – If `True` and corresponding tensors are strided, asserts that they have the same stride.
- **msg** (*OptionalUnion[*[*str*")*, Callable[*[*str*")*],* *str*")*]]]*) – Optional error message to use in case a failure occurs during the comparison. Can also passed as callable in which case it will be called with the generated message and should return the new message.

- **ValueError**") – If no `torch.Tensor` can be constructed from an input.
- **ValueError**") – If only `rtol` or `atol` is specified.
- **AssertionError**") – If corresponding inputs are not Python scalars and are not directly related.
- **AssertionError**") – If `allow_subclasses` is `False`, but corresponding inputs are not Python scalars and have different types.
- **AssertionError**") – If the inputs are `Sequence`")’s, but their length does not match.
- **AssertionError**") – If the inputs are `Mapping`")’s, but their set of keys do not match.
- **AssertionError**") – If corresponding tensors do not have the same `shape`.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_layout` is `True`, but corresponding tensors do not have the same `layout`.

- **AssertionError**") – If corresponding tensors are quantized, but have different `qscheme()`’s.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_device` is `True`, but corresponding tensors are not on the same `device`.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_dtype` is `True`, but corresponding tensors do not have the same `dtype`.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_stride` is `True`, but corresponding strided tensors do not have the same stride.
- **AssertionError**") – If the values of corresponding tensors are not close according to the definition above.

`assert_close()` is highly configurable with strict default settings. Users are encouraged to `partial()`") it to fit their use case. For example, if an equality check is needed, one might define an `assert_equal` that uses zero tolerances for every `dtype` by default:

Expected 1e-10 but got 1e-09.

Relative difference: 9.0

**标题**: Reproducibility — PyTorch 2.14 documentation
**发布时间**: Created On: May 14, 2026 | Last Updated On: May 14, 2026

Back to top

# Reproducibility[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#reproducibility "Link to this heading")

Completely reproducible results are not guaranteed across PyTorch releases, individual commits, or different platforms. Furthermore, results may not be reproducible between CPU and GPU executions, even when using identical seeds.

However, there are some steps you can take to limit the number of sources of nondeterministic behavior for a specific platform, device, and PyTorch release. First, you can control sources of randomness that can cause multiple executions of your application to behave differently. Second, you can configure PyTorch to avoid using nondeterministic algorithms for some operations, so that multiple calls to those operations, given the same inputs, will produce the same result.

Warning

Deterministic operations are often slower than nondeterministic operations, so single-run performance may decrease for your model. However, determinism may save time in development by facilitating experimentation, debugging, and regression testing.

## Controlling sources of randomness[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#controlling-sources-of-randomness "Link to this heading")

### PyTorch random number generator[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#pytorch-random-number-generator "Link to this heading")

You can use [`torch.manual_seed()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.manual_seed.html#torch.manual_seed "torch.manual_seed") to seed the RNG for all devices (both CPU and CUDA):

```
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)
```

Some PyTorch operations may use random numbers internally. [`torch.svd_lowrank()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.svd_lowrank.html#torch.svd_lowrank "torch.svd_lowrank") does this, for instance. Consequently, calling it multiple times back-to-back with the same input arguments may give different results. However, as long as [`torch.manual_seed()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.manual_seed.html#torch.manual_seed "torch.manual_seed") is set to a constant at the beginning of an application and all other sources of nondeterminism have been eliminated, the same series of random numbers will be generated each time the application is run in the same environment.

It is also possible to obtain identical results from an operation that uses random numbers by setting [`torch.manual_seed()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.manual_seed.html#torch.manual_seed "torch.manual_seed") to the same value between subsequent calls.

### Python[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#python "Link to this heading")

For custom operators, you might need to set python seed as well:

```
import random
random.seed(0)
```

### Random number generators in other libraries[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#random-number-generators-in-other-libraries "Link to this heading")

If you or any of the libraries you are using rely on NumPy, you can seed the global NumPy RNG with:

```
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(0)
```

However, some applications and libraries may use NumPy Random Generator objects, not the global RNG ([https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/random/generator.html](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/random/generator.html)), and those will need to be seeded consistently as well.

If you are using any other libraries that use random number generators, refer to the documentation for those libraries to see how to set consistent seeds for them.

### CUDA convolution benchmarking[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#cuda-convolution-benchmarking "Link to this heading")

The cuDNN library, used by CUDA convolution operations, can be a source of nondeterminism across multiple executions of an application. When a cuDNN convolution is called with a new set of size parameters, an optional feature can run multiple convolution algorithms, benchmarking them to find the fastest one. Then, the fastest algorithm will be used consistently during the rest of the process for the corresponding set of size parameters. Due to benchmarking noise and different hardware, the benchmark may select different algorithms on subsequent runs, even on the same machine.

Disabling the benchmarking feature with `torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False` causes cuDNN to deterministically select an algorithm, possibly at the cost of reduced performance.

However, if you do not need reproducibility across multiple executions of your application, then performance might improve if the benchmarking feature is enabled with `torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True`.

Note that this setting is different from the `torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic` setting discussed below.

## Avoiding nondeterministic algorithms[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#avoiding-nondeterministic-algorithms "Link to this heading")

[`torch.use_deterministic_algorithms()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.use_deterministic_algorithms.html#torch.use_deterministic_algorithms "torch.use_deterministic_algorithms") lets you configure PyTorch to use deterministic algorithms instead of nondeterministic ones where available, and to throw an error if an operation is known to be nondeterministic (and without a deterministic alternative).

Please check the documentation for [`torch.use_deterministic_algorithms()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.use_deterministic_algorithms.html#torch.use_deterministic_algorithms "torch.use_deterministic_algorithms") for a full list of affected operations. If an operation does not act correctly according to the documentation, or if you need a deterministic implementation of an operation that does not have one, please submit an issue: [https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues?q=label:”module: determinism”](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues?q=label%3A%22module%3A%20determinism%22)

For example, running the nondeterministic CUDA implementation of [`torch.Tensor.index_add_()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.Tensor.index_add_.html#torch.Tensor.index_add_ "torch.Tensor.index_add_") will throw an error:

```
>>> import torch
>>> torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
>>> torch.randn(2, 2).cuda().index_add_(0, torch.tensor([0, 1]), torch.randn(2, 2))
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
RuntimeError: index_add_cuda_ does not have a deterministic implementation, but you set
'torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)'. ...
```

When [`torch.bmm()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.bmm.html#torch.bmm "torch.bmm") is called with sparse-dense CUDA tensors it typically uses a nondeterministic algorithm, but when the deterministic flag is turned on, its alternate deterministic implementation will be used:

```
>>> import torch
>>> torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
>>> torch.bmm(torch.randn(2, 2, 2).to_sparse().cuda(), torch.randn(2, 2, 2).cuda())
tensor([[[ 1.1900, -2.3409],
         [ 0.4796,  0.8003]],
        [[ 0.1509,  1.8027],
         [ 0.0333, -1.1444]]], device='cuda:0')
```

### CUDA convolution determinism[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#cuda-convolution-determinism "Link to this heading")

While disabling CUDA convolution benchmarking (discussed above) ensures that CUDA selects the same algorithm each time an application is run, that algorithm itself may be nondeterministic, unless either `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)` or `torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True` is set. The latter setting controls only this behavior, unlike [`torch.use_deterministic_algorithms()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.use_deterministic_algorithms.html#torch.use_deterministic_algorithms "torch.use_deterministic_algorithms") which will make other PyTorch operations behave deterministically, too.

### CUDA Scaled Dot Product Attention[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#cuda-scaled-dot-product-attention "Link to this heading")

[`torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.html#torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention "torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention") (SDPA) dispatches to multiple backends at runtime. Each backend has different determinism characteristics, summarized in the table below:

Backend

Forward

Backward

Notes

`SDPBackend.MATH`

Deterministic

Deterministic

Uses standard PyTorch operators (`matmul`, `softmax`). Deterministic when [`torch.use_deterministic_algorithms()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.use_deterministic_algorithms.html#torch.use_deterministic_algorithms "torch.use_deterministic_algorithms") is enabled.

`SDPBackend.FLASH_ATTENTION`

Deterministic

Non-deterministic

The backward pass uses non-deterministic atomic operations by default. Setting `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False)` enables a deterministic backward implementation.

`SDPBackend.EFFICIENT_ATTENTION`

Deterministic

Non-deterministic

The backward pass may split work across keys (`num_splits_key > 1`) for performance, which is non-deterministic. Setting `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False)` forces `num_splits_key = 1`, making the backward pass deterministic.

`SDPBackend.CUDNN_ATTENTION`

Deterministic

Non-deterministic

cuDNN provides an opt-in deterministic backward for `float16` starting in [cuDNN 9.18](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/release-notes.html#cudnn-9-18-0) (via [set_deterministic_algorithm](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/frontend/latest/operations/Attention.html#sdpa-fp16-bf16-backward)), but this has not yet been integrated into PyTorch. This backend is **disabled** when `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False)` is set, regardless of whether inputs require gradients or the call is inside a `torch.no_grad()` context.

When `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True)` is set, the fused backends (Flash, Efficient, and cuDNN) emit a one-time warning but still use their default non-deterministic code paths. To actually enforce determinism, pass `warn_only=False`.

**Low-precision dtypes and numerical reproducibility**

Bitwise matching numerics across different SDPA backends are **not guaranteed**, even for the same inputs and dtype. Each backend performs floating-point accumulation in a different order, and because floating-point addition is not associative, the results will differ between backends.

The Math backend by default accumulates in `float32` even when given `float16` or `bfloat16` inputs. The function [`torch.backends.cuda.allow_fp16_bf16_reduction_math_sdp()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/backends.html#torch.backends.cuda.allow_fp16_bf16_reduction_math_sdp "torch.backends.cuda.allow_fp16_bf16_reduction_math_sdp") can enable reduced-precision accumulation for higher performance at the cost of different numerical results.

**Selecting a specific backend**

Use the [`torch.nn.attention.sdpa_kernel()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.attention.sdpa_kernel.html#torch.nn.attention.sdpa_kernel "torch.nn.attention.sdpa_kernel") context manager to restrict which backends SDPA may use. For example, to guarantee deterministic behavior regardless of hardware:

```
import torch
from torch.nn.attention import sdpa_kernel, SDPBackend

torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)

# Option 1: Use only the Math backend (always deterministic)
with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH):
    out = torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)

# Option 2: Allow Flash and Efficient (deterministic with the flag above)
with sdpa_kernel([SDPBackend.FLASH_ATTENTION, SDPBackend.EFFICIENT_ATTENTION]):
    out = torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
```

### CUDA RNN and LSTM[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#cuda-rnn-and-lstm "Link to this heading")

In some versions of CUDA, RNNs and LSTM networks may have non-deterministic behavior. See [`torch.nn.RNN()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.RNN.html#torch.nn.RNN "torch.nn.RNN") and [`torch.nn.LSTM()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.LSTM.html#torch.nn.LSTM "torch.nn.LSTM") for details and workarounds.

### Filling uninitialized memory[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#filling-uninitialized-memory "Link to this heading")

Operations like [`torch.empty()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.empty.html#torch.empty "torch.empty") and [`torch.Tensor.resize_()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.Tensor.resize_.html#torch.Tensor.resize_ "torch.Tensor.resize_") can return tensors with uninitialized memory that contain undefined values. Using such a tensor as an input to another operation is invalid if determinism is required, because the output will be nondeterministic. But there is nothing to actually prevent such invalid code from being run. So for safety, [`torch.utils.deterministic.fill_uninitialized_memory`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/deterministic.html#torch.utils.deterministic.fill_uninitialized_memory "torch.utils.deterministic.fill_uninitialized_memory") is set to `True` by default, which will fill the uninitialized memory with a known value if `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)` is set. This will prevent the possibility of this kind of nondeterministic behavior.

However, filling uninitialized memory is detrimental to performance. So if your program is valid and does not use uninitialized memory as the input to an operation, then this setting can be turned off for better performance.

## DataLoader[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/randomness.html#dataloader "Link to this heading")

DataLoader will reseed workers following the [Randomness in multi-process data loading](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/data.html#data-loading-randomness) algorithm. Use `worker_init_fn()` and `generator` to preserve reproducibility:

```
def seed_worker(worker_id):
    worker_seed = torch.initial_seed() % 2**32
    numpy.random.seed(worker_seed)
    random.seed(worker_seed)

g = torch.Generator()
g.manual_seed(0)

DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size,
    num_workers=num_workers,
    worker_init_fn=seed_worker,
    generator=g,
)
```

**标题**: Compute Sanitizer :: CUDA Toolkit Documentation

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/compute-sanitizer/index.html)

## [Compute Sanitizer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/compute-sanitizer/index.html#abstract)

The user guide for Compute Sanitizer.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/compute-sanitizer/index.html)

## [Overview](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/compute-sanitizer/index.html#compute-sanitizer-overview)

Compute Sanitizer is a functional correctness checking suite included in the CUDA toolkit. This suite contains multiple tools that can perform different type of checks. The memcheck tool is capable of precisely detecting and attributing out of bounds and misaligned memory access errors in CUDA applications. The tool can also report hardware exceptions encountered by the GPU. The racecheck tool can report shared memory data access hazards that can cause data races. The initcheck tool can report cases where the GPU performs uninitialized accesses to global memory. The synccheck tool can report cases where the application is attempting invalid usages of synchronization primitives. This document describes the usage of these tools.

The Compute Sanitizer is delivered on supported platforms. See [Compute Sanitizer documentation.](https://docs.nvidia.com/compute-sanitizer/index.html)

* * *
