## 2. 内存层级与搬运路径（优化的对象）

搬运指令队列分 MTE1/MTE2/MTE3，与 Vector（V）、Cube（M）、Scalar（S）队列相互独立、可并行——这正是 double buffer 的基石（官方原文）。
- GM→Local（UB/L1）：MTE2
- L1→L0A/L0B：MTE1
- UB→GM：MTE3
- 计算：Vector 队列（V）、Cube 队列（M）

Cube 相关缓冲区复用（第三方，数值**未核实**）：L0A/L0B 约 **64K**、L1 约 **504K**；ND 格式矩阵需经 L1 预留约 64KB，故约 **440KB** 以下才可全载入 L1；L2 约 **176MB** 可做数据复用。来源：知乎《昇腾算子性能优化方法》
https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2059685082563139137
> 这些具体容量未在本次取得的官方正文中核对到，属待核实项。

---

## 3. 优化手段

### 3.1 double buffer（提高 Vector/Cube 利用率，首要手段）
官方原文（CANN 8.0.RC2.alpha002，ascendcbestP）：
https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC2alpha002/devguide/opdevg/ascendcbestP/atlas_ascendc_best_practices_10_0024.html

原理：CopyIn/CopyOut 用 MTE2/MTE3，Compute 用 Vector 队列，两队列独立可并行。未开 double buffer 时串行，若三阶段各耗 t，则 Vector 利用率仅 **1/3**；开启后把数据一分为二（Tensor1/Tensor2），计算 Tensor1 时搬 Tensor2、计算 Tensor2 时搬出 Tensor1，隐藏大部分搬运时间。

实现：队列申请内存块个数设为 2
```cpp
pipe.InitBuffer(inQueueX, 2, 256);   // 官方示例
```
官方正/反例（要点）：
```cpp
// 反例：不开 double buffer，空间 1*size，需 round*2 次循环
pipe.InitBuffer(inQueueSrc0, 1, sizeSrc0 * sizeof(half));
pipe.InitBuffer(inQueueSrc1, 1, sizeSrc1 * sizeof(half));
pipe.InitBuffer(outQueueDst, 1, sizeDst0 * sizeof(half));
for (uint32_t index = 0; index < round * 2; ++index) { CopyIn(index); Compute(); CopyOut(index); }

// 正例：开 double buffer，空间 2*size，循环 round 次（前提：循环次数 >= 2）
pipe.InitBuffer(inQueueSrc0, 2, sizeSrc0 * sizeof(half));
pipe.InitBuffer(inQueueSrc1, 2, sizeSrc1 * sizeof(half));
pipe.InitBuffer(outQueueDst, 2, sizeDst0 * sizeof(half));
for (uint32_t index = 0; index < round; ++index) { CopyIn(index); Compute(); CopyOut(index); }
```

官方**注意事项（别盲目开）**：
- 搬运时间短、Vector 计算显著长时，收益偏小；
- 原始数据小、Vector 可一次性算完时，强开 double buffer 会**降低 Vector 利用率**，适得其反；
- 需综合考虑 Vector 算力、数据量、搬运与计算时间占比。

华为云社区（官方厂商社区）给出编程范式要点与收益量级：“核内流水线并行通常能将算子性能提升 20%-40%”，且 `BUFFER_NUM=2`（该百分比为第三方/社区表述，未在官方正文核对）：
https://bbs.huaweicloud.com/blogs/433234
```cpp
TPipe pipe;
TQue<VecIn, 1> queIn;
TQue<VecOut, 1> queOut;
pipe.InitBuffer(queIn, 2, 1024);   // 开启 double buffer
for(...){ /* CopyIn: AllocTensor/DataCopy/EnQue; Compute: DeQue/Abs/FreeTensor/EnQue; CopyOut: DeQue/DataCopy/FreeTensor */ }
```

### 3.2 Matrix 场景：使能 Iterate 异步接口，避免 AIC/AIV 同步依赖
官方社区原文：Mix 模式下 `Matmul` 的 `Iterate/IterateAll` 默认同步会每次发消息；用 `Iterate<false>`/`IterateAll<false>` 仅第一次发消息，减少 Cube 与 Vector 核间通信开销。
```cpp
while(mm.template Iterate<false>()){
    auto cInUB = qVecIn.AllocTensor<float>();
    mm.GetTensorC(cInUB);
    qVecIn.EnQue(cInUB);
    cInUB = qVecIn.Deque<float>();
    auto cOutUB = qVecOut.AllocTensor<float>();
    Muls(cOutUB, cInUB, scalar, baseM*baseN);
    qVecIn.FreeTensor(cInUB);
    ...
}
```

### 3.3 Tiling / 切分（配合 double buffer 与资源占用）
（知乎，第三方：https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2059685082563139137）
- 按并行计算单元个数切分，负载均衡，避免忙闲不均；
- 尽量用满可用资源；
- 核内切块要按 double buffer 预留（TQue 缓冲分配 2 块）；
- 核内切块尽量大：减少 scalar 压力（循环次数少）、利于 SIMD、降低指令启动开销；
- 多核切分尽量避免多核同步（会中断流水线）；若必须，启动核数要小于实际可运行核数，否则死锁。

### 3.4 Scalar / ICache 优化（避免标量阻塞流水）
- 外提循环变量、消减计算强度（`i*offset` → 加法）；
- 能板外计算的放到 tiling 传入；
- 用大块切分减少循环次数；
- 小函数 inline；
- 避免让标量单元直接参与向量计算（会在队列间来回切换）；
- ICache miss 时减少代码段、优先执行高频分支（或拆成两个二进制）。

### 3.5 内存/UB 使用优化
- 合理用 `TBuf` 申请 TMP Buffer 并保存为成员变量复用，避免反复申请释放；
- 合并相同生命周期的变量：如 `Z=X+Y`，X/Y 生命周期相同，可只申请一个 TQue/缓冲区，用 `xLocal+offset` 取 Y；
- 访问对齐（32B 对齐）与向量化/大块搬运，避免小包离散访问浪费带宽。

### 3.6 Cube/矩阵计算资源利用
- 小矩阵能放入 L0A/B（约 64K）则全量载入，另一矩阵只需进 L0 一次；
- 能放入 L1（约 504K，ND 格式约 440K 以下）则全载 L1，减少 L1/L0 反复搬运；
- 否则对 A 或 B 做切分，实现 L1/L0 数据复用，并利用 L2 做多核复用。

**概念层面能给出的内容：**
1. **Nsight Compute 整体用法**：`ncu` 命令行可对 kernel 做逐 kernel 的 profiling，常用：
   - `ncu --set full ./app`（全套 section，重）
   - `ncu --set detailed ./app`
   - `ncu --kernel-name regex:<name> --launch-skip N --launch-count M ./app`
   - `ncu --list-sections` / `ncu --list-sets`
   - `ncu -o report.ncu-rep ./app` 保存，再用 `ncu-ui report.ncu-rep` 打开
   - `--cache-control none`（默认 all 会 flush cache，影响 memory 指标）、`--clock-control none`
2. **occupancy 分析**：关注 `Occupancy` / `Launch Statistics` / `Scheduler Statistics` section。理论 occupancy 受 registers/thread、shared memory/block、block size、以及架构上限限制；achieved occupancy 指标约为 `sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_active`。UI 的 Occupancy section 会列 "Block Limit Registers / Block Limit Shared Mem / Block Limit Warps" 等限制因素。
3. **occupancy calculator**：概念上指给定 block size、registers/thread、smem/block 后计算 max active blocks/SM。CUDA runtime 提供 `cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor()` API；Nsight Compute UI 里有 Occupancy 计算视图。
4. **memory coalescing 分析**：Memory Workload Analysis section；关键指标是每请求的 sector 数，例如 `l1tex__average_t_sectors_per_request_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld.ratio`，理想值 ~4（32 线程 * 4B = 128B = 4 sectors）。DRAM throughput 峰值占比看 `dram__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed`。
5. **shared memory / bank conflict**：32 个 bank、4B 宽；指标如 `l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu_mem_shared_op_ld.sum`。优化手段：padding（加 1 列）、改变访问 stride、向量化 4B/8B 访问、把 warp 内访问错开。
6. **memory-bound 优化思路**：先判断是 latency-bound 还是 bandwidth-bound（对比 DRAM% 与 compute%），再决定提高 occupancy（降寄存器、调 block size）或改善访问模式（合并、向量化、smem 复用）。

# Nsight Compute Profiling Guide — Extraction Report

## Summary

I extracted all content from the provided page relevant to your three topics: **(1) Occupancy analysis**, **(2) Memory Workload Analysis (global coalescing/sectors, shared memory bank conflicts)**, and **(3) corresponding ncu commands/sections/metrics**.

**Important finding on completeness:** The provided content is **truncated**. The Metrics Reference chapter (Section 2.4) cuts off after **2.4.2 Launch Metrics** ("[content truncated]"). This means detailed memory-metric tables and much of the Metrics Reference — where some of your requested exact metrics would normally live — are **not present** in the material given.

---

## 1. Occupancy Analysis

### Where the content appears in the page

The occupancy-relevant material is spread across **Section 2.2.2 (Sections and Rules)** and **Section 2.3.1 (Hardware Model → Compute Model / Streaming Multiprocessor)**. It **does not appear** as a dedicated "Occupancy" chapter; only the section descriptor and supporting hardware-model text are provided.

### Exact section descriptor (from the Available Sections table, 2.2.2)

| Identifier | Display Name | Description (verbatim) |
|---|---|---|
| `Occupancy` | Occupancy | "Occupancy is the ratio of the number of active warps per multiprocessor to the maximum number of possible active warps. Another way to view occupancy is the percentage of the hardware's ability to process warps that is actively in use. Higher occupancy does not always result in higher performance, however, low occupancy always reduces the ability to hide latencies, resulting in overall performance degradation. Large discrepancies between the theoretical and the achieved occupancy during execution typically indicates highly imbalanced workloads." |

This is the **only explicit theoretical vs. achieved occupancy** statement in the provided content (the "Large discrepancies between the theoretical and the achieved occupancy" sentence).

### Limiting factors (from Section 2.3.1, Compute Model + Streaming Multiprocessor)

The page describes occupancy limiters as physical resources required by the CTA:

- **"The number of CTAs that fit on each SM depends on the physical resources required by the CTA. These resource limiters include the number of threads and registers, shared memory utilization, and hardware barriers. The number CTAs per SM is referred to as the CTA *occupancy*, and these physical resources limit this occupancy."**
- **Warps per sub-partition pool:** "A sub partition manages a fixed size pool of warps. On Turing architectures the size of the pool is 8 warps."
- **Register control:** "The most important resource under the compiler's control is the number of registers used by a kernel. Each sub partition has a set of 32-bit registers, which are allocated by the HW in fixed-size chunks. The Launch Statistics section shows the kernel's register usage."
- **Wave definition:** "The total number of CTAs that can run concurrently on a given GPU is referred to as *Wave*. Consequently, the size of a Wave scales with the number of available SMs of a GPU, but also with the occupancy of the kernel."

### Related sections/metrics for occupancy

- `Occupancy` section → "Details on the kernel's occupancy are collected by the Occupancy section."
- `LaunchStats` (Launch Statistics) → register usage and launch config.
- `launch__*` metrics (Section 2.4.1) → **"collected per kernel launch, and do not require an additional replay pass… available as part of the kernel launch parameters (such as grid size, block size, …) or are computed using the CUDA Occupancy Calculator."** Note: `launch__occupancy_per_*` metrics are named here but **not** listed per-launch (they are excluded from per-launch instancing).

> **Note:** Exact individual occupancy metric names (e.g., the `sm__warps_active` / achieved-vs-theoretical occupancy metric strings) are **not given** in the provided text — they would fall in the truncated portion or the live Metrics Reference.

---

## 2. Memory Workload Analysis

### 2a. Global memory coalescing and sectors per request

**Section descriptor (2.2.2 table):**

| Identifier | Display Name | Description (verbatim) |
|---|---|---|
| `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis` | Memory Workload Analysis | "Detailed analysis of the memory resources of the GPU. Memory can become a limiting factor for the overall kernel performance when fully utilizing the involved hardware units (Mem Busy), exhausting the available communication bandwidth between those units (Max Bandwidth), or by reaching the maximum throughput of issuing memory instructions (Mem Pipes Busy)." |
| `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis_Chart` | Memory Workload Analysis Chart | "Detailed chart of the memory units." (extends `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis`) |
| `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis_Tables` | Memory Workload Analysis Tables | "Detailed tables with data for each memory unit." (extends `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis`) |

**Sectors / requests / wavefronts model (Section 2.3.7, Quantities):**

Definitions given verbatim:

- **`instruction`** — "An assembly (SASS) instruction. Each executed instruction may generate zero or more requests."
- **`request`** — "A command into a HW unit to perform some action, e.g. load data from some memory location. Each request accesses one or more sectors."
- **`sector`** — "Aligned 32 byte-chunk of memory in a cache line or device memory. An L1 or L2 cache line is four sectors, i.e. 128 bytes. Sector accesses are classified as hits if the tag is present and the sector-data is present within the cache line. Tag-misses and tag-hit-data-misses are all classified as misses."
- **`tag`** — "Unique key to a cache line. A request may look up multiple tags… The L1 and L2 both have 128 byte cache lines."
- **`wavefront`** — "Unique 'work package' generated at the end of the processing stage for requests. All work items of a wavefront are processed in parallel, while work items of different wavefronts are serialized… At least one wavefront is generated for each request."

**The L1TEX processing model (verbatim, key for coalescing):**

> "When an SM executes a global or local memory instruction for a warp, a single *request* is sent to L1TEX. This request communicates the information for all participating threads of this warp (up to 32). For local and global memory, based on the access pattern and the participating threads, the request requires to access a number of cache lines, and *sectors* within these cache lines."

And the key relationship:

> "A *wavefront* is the maximum unit that can pass through that pipeline stage per cycle. If not all cache lines or sectors can be accessed in a single wavefront, multiple wavefronts are created and sent for processing one by one, i.e. in a serialized manner… The given relationships of the three key values in this model are *requests:sectors is 1:N, wavefronts:sectors 1:N, and requests:wavefronts is 1:N*."

> "Wavefronts therefore represent the number of cycles required to process the requests, while the number of sectors per request is a property of the *access pattern* of the memory instruction for all participating threads. For example, it is possible to have a memory instruction that requires 4 sectors per request in 1 wavefront. However, you can also have a memory instruction having 4 sectors per request, but requiring 2 or more wavefronts."

**Global memory description (2.3.1 Memory):** Global memory is a 49-bit virtual address space mapped to device / pinned / peer memory, accessed through SM L1 and GPU L2. (No explicit "coalescing" metric name is given in the available text.)

> The word **"coalescing"** does not appear verbatim in the provided content; the concept is expressed through **requests → sectors → wavefronts** (access pattern → sectors-per-request → serialized wavefronts).

### 2b. Shared memory bank conflicts

**From Section 2.3.1 (Memory), verbatim:**

> "Shared memory has 32 banks that are organized such that successive 32-bit words map to successive banks that can be accessed simultaneously. Any 32-bit memory read or write request made of 32 addresses that fall in 32 distinct memory banks can therefore be serviced simultaneously, yielding an overall bandwidth that is 32 times as high as the bandwidth of a single request. However, if two addresses of a memory request fall in the same memory bank, there is a bank conflict and the access has to be serialized."

> "A shared memory request for a warp does not generate a bank conflict between two threads that access any address within the same 32-bit word (even though the two addresses fall in the same bank). When multiple threads make the same read access, one thread receives the data and then broadcasts it to the other threads. When multiple threads write to the same location, only one thread succeeds in the write; which thread that succeeds is undefined."

**Exact bank-conflict metric name present (from Section 2.3.2, Metrics Examples):**

l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.peak_sustained_elapsed
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.peak_sustained_elapsed.per_second
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.per_cycle_active
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.per_cycle_elapsed
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.per_second
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.pct_of_peak_sustained_active
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed
```

### 2c. Caches (L1TEX/L1/L2) context

- **L1/L2 cache lines are 128 bytes = 4 sectors** (see `sector`/`tag` definitions above).
- L1 receives global/local requests from the SM and texture/surface requests from TEX; L1 sends global-space ops through L2.
- L1 is "optimized for 2D spatial locality" for texture/surface; a cache hit "reduces DRAM bandwidth demand but not fetch latency."
- "Cache hit and miss rates as well as data transfers are reported in the Memory Workload Analysis section."

# Nsight Compute CLI (ncu) — Command-Line Reference Extraction

## Summary

The page is the **full Nsight Compute CLI User Guide** (chapter 5). It contains a dedicated **Command Line Options** section (§5.4) with all requested options. Content covers §5.1 through §5.6 plus legal notices. The page does **not** appear truncated — it ends with the Nvprof Transition Guide pointer and the complete NVIDIA Notices/Trademarks boilerplate.

**Where the reference content lives:**
- Starts: §5.4 "Command Line Options" and its subsections §5.4.1–§5.4.11
- Ends: §5.4.11 (MPS), followed by §5.5 Environment Variables and §5.6 Nvprof Transition Guide, then Notices.

---

## Requested Options — Exact Syntax, Defaults, Examples

### `--set` (Section Set)
- **Syntax:** `--set <identifier>`
- **Behavior:** Selects the section set to collect. If not specified, the `basic` set is collected. `--set full` collects the full set of sections. If not specified **and** `--section` or `--metrics` are used, **no sets are collected**.
- **Related:** `--list-sets` lists all sets found in searched section folders and exits (shows associated sections and estimated number of metrics — usable as a relative overhead estimate per kernel launch).
- Default: `basic` (when no `--set`, `--section`, or `--metrics` given).

### `--section`
- **Syntax (two forms):**
  - `<section identifier>` — exact match.
  - `regex:<expression>` — matches full section identifier (e.g., `.*Stats` matches all sections ending in "Stats"). On shells treating regex symbols as special chars, quote it: `--section "regex:.*Stats"`.
- **Behavior:**
  - If no `--section` given → sections associated with the `basic` set are collected. If no sets found, all sections are collected.
  - Ignored when used with `--import` and `--page raw` or `--page source`.
- **Related:** `--section-folder` (non-recursive search path for `.section` and `.py` rule files, default `sections` folder), `--section-folder-recursive`, `--list-sections`.

### `--metrics`
- **Syntax:** `--metrics <metric list>` (comma-separated)
- **Behavior:** If no `--section` given, only a temporary section containing the listed metrics is collected. If `--section` is also given, both sets of metrics are collected.
- **Supported prefixes:**
  - `regex:<expression>` — expands to all partially matching metrics (use `^…$` for full match).
  - `group:<name>` — all metrics of the named metric group.
  - `breakdown:<metric>` — input metrics of the high-level throughput metric.
  - `pmsampling:<metric>` — collect via PM sampling (single-pass, non-`_sass_` only; adds a timeline element to details page).
  - Combining prefixes is **not** supported.
  - When importing a report, `:group` and `:breakdown` are **not** supported. With `regex:`, expression must not include commas.
- Related: `--query-metrics`, `--query-metrics-mode`, `--query-metrics-collection`, `--list-metrics`, `--metric-distribution-groups` (default 1), `--disable-extra-suffixes`.

### `-k` / `--kernel-name`
- **Syntax:**
  - `<kernel name>` — exact match.
  - `regex:<expression>` — regex match (quote on shells e.g. Linux bash: `--kernel-name regex:".*Foo"`).
- **Behavior:** Non-matching kernels are ignored for profiling.
- **Examples:**
  - `-k foo` — match kernels named exactly "foo".
  - `-k regex:foo` — match kernels including "foo" (e.g., "foo", "fooBar").
  - `-k regex:"foo|bar"` — match kernels including "foo" or "bar".
- **Related:** `--kernel-name-base` (default `function`; options: `function`, `demangled`, `mangled`), `--kernel-id`.

### `-s` / `--launch-skip`
- **Syntax:** `--launch-skip <n>`
- **Behavior:** Number of kernel launches to skip before profiling starts. Counts **only** launches that match kernel filters.
- **Default:** `0`

### `-c` / `--launch-count`
- **Syntax:** `--launch-count <n>`
- **Behavior:** Limits number of profiled kernel launches. Count is incremented only for launches matching the kernel filters.
- **Default:** (not explicitly stated; effectively unlimited)
- **Related:** `--launch-skip-before-match` (default 0 — counts all launches regardless of filters), `--kill` (default `no` — terminate target app once requested `--launch-count` is profiled).

### `--replay-mode`
- **Syntax:** `--replay-mode <mode>`
- **Default:** `kernel`
- **Available modes:**
  - `kernel` — replay individual kernel launches transparently during execution.
  - `application` — relaunch the entire application multiple times (requires deterministic execution).
  - `range` — replay ranges of CUDA API calls/kernel launches; ranges defined via `cu(da)ProfilerStart/Stop` or NVTX expressions.
  - `app-range` — profile ranges without API capture by relaunching the app; ranges via `cu(da)ProfilerStart/Stop` or NVTX.
- **Related:** `--app-replay-buffer` (`file` default / `memory`), `--app-replay-match` (`grid` default; options `name`, `grid`, `all`), `--app-replay-mode` (`balanced` default; `strict`, `balanced`, `relaxed`), `--range-replay-options`, `--graph-profiling` (`node` default / `graph`).

### `--cache-control`
- **Syntax:** `--cache-control <all|none>`
- **Default:** `all`
- **Values:**
  - `all` — all GPU caches flushed before each kernel replay iteration (most reproducible results).
  - `none` — no cache flushing; can improve performance/better replicate behavior for single-pass collection but results can vary/be inconsistent.

### `--clock-control`
- **Syntax:** `--clock-control <base|boost|force-boost|none|reset>`
- **Default:** `boost`
- **Values:**
  - `base` — GPC/memory clocks locked to base (rated TDP) frequency.
  - `boost` — locked to turbo boost frequency (falls back to `base` if unsupported).
  - `force-boost` — locked to turbo boost (Ampere+ on driver 560, Turing+ on driver 580+).
  - `none` — no frequency changes.
  - `reset` — reset GPC/memory clocks for all/selected devices and exit (use if a prior killed ncu left clocks locked).
- **Related:** `--pipeline-boost-state` (default `stable`; values `stable`, `dynamic`).

### `--query-metrics`
- **Syntax:** `--query-metrics`
- **Behavior:** Queries available metrics for the system's devices. Use `--devices` and `--chips` to filter which devices to query. By default, listed metric names need a valid suffix to become valid metrics (see `--query-metrics-mode`).
- **Related:**
  - `--query-metrics-mode` (default `base`; implies `--query-metrics`): `base` (base names only), `suffix` (suffix names for base metrics — use `--metrics` to specify base metrics), `all` (full names for all base + suffix metrics).
  - `--query-metrics-collection` (default `profiling`): `device`, `groups`, `launch`, `numa`, `nvlink`, `occupancy`, `pmsampling`, `profiling`, `source`, `stats`, `warpsampling`.
  - `--list-metrics` lists all metrics from active sections (restricted by `--section`).
  - `--list-chips` lists supported chips; `--chips` selects chips (e.g., `--chips tu102,gh100`).

### `-o` / `--export`
- **Syntax:** `--export <file>` (alias `-o`)
- **Behavior:** Sets the output file for writing the profile report. If not set, a temporary file is used (removed afterward). Use with `--import` to save filtered results. Supports macro expansion. If `--export` is set and no `--page` is given, **no profile results are printed to console**.
- **File macros** (`%h` host name, `%q{ENV_NAME}` env var, `%p` process ID, `%i` lowest unused positive integer, `%%` literal %).
- **Related:** `-f` / `--force-overwrite` (default: won't overwrite existing files — errors instead), `--log-file`.

### `-i` / `--import`
- **Syntax:** `--import <file>`
- **Behavior:** Sets the input file for reading profile results. When using this flag, most other options are unavailable **except** certain result-filtering options (marked with footnote `[1]` in the Profile options table). Used together with `--export` for **Filtered Profile Export** (most filtering options supported except `--metrics` and `--section`).

---

## Selecting the Occupancy / MemoryWorkloadAnalysis Sections

The page **does not name "Occupancy" or "MemoryWorkloadAnalysis" as literal section identifiers**. However, the mechanism to select them is fully documented:

1. **Discover the exact identifiers** — run `--list-sections` to list all sections found in the searched section folders (default `sections` folder).
2. **Pass them via `--section`** — e.g.:
   ```
   ncu --section <SectionIdentifier> CuVectorAddMulti.exe
   ```
   Or match by regex, e.g. `--section "regex:.*Memory.*"` / `--section "regex:.*Occupancy.*"` (quote on bash).
3. **Confirm contents** — `--list-metrics` (optionally restricted by `--section`) lists all metrics from active sections; `--list-sets` shows sets and their associated sections + estimated metric counts.

**Direct evidence on the page that these sections exist:**

- The **Config File sample usage** explicitly references an **`Occupancy`** section as a `--section` value:
  ```
  [Launch-and-attach]
  -c = 1
  --section = LaunchStats, Occupancy
  [Import]
  --open-in-ui
  -c = 1
  --section = LaunchStats, Occupancy
  ```
- The config file "clubbing" example reuses the same:
  ```
  [Launch-and-attach, import]
  -c = 1
  --section = LaunchStats, Occupancy
  ```
- `--query-metrics-collection` includes an **`occupancy`** collection: "Query occupancy calculation metrics."
- **`MemoryWorkloadAnalysis` is not mentioned by name anywhere in this page.** It would be selected the same way (via `--section`) once its identifier is confirmed with `--list-sections`. (In practice it is a stock section file, but this page provides no literal string for it.)

So to collect Occupancy/MemoryWorkloadAnalysis: run `--list-sections` to get exact identifiers, then pass them via `--section` (or use a `--set` that bundles them). When importing, note `--section` is unavailable with `--page raw`/`--page source`, and unavailable in Filtered Profile Export.

---

## Additional Context (Supporting the Above)

- **Modes (§5.3.1):** `launch-and-attach` (default), `launch`, `attach`.
- **Quickstart example:** `ncu -o profile CuVectorAddMulti.exe` (collects `basic` set; output defaults to `profile.ncu-rep`; profiler lines prefixed `==PROF==`).
- **Customizing collection:** documented via `-c`, `-s`, `-k`, `--kernel-id`, `--section`, `--list-sets`, `--list-sections`, `--metrics`, `--query-metrics`.
- **Output pages (§5.3.3 / `--page`):** `details` (default), `raw`, `source`, `session`. `--csv` for comma-separated output.
- **Metric naming:** base name + suffix (e.g., `sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed`); use `--query-metrics-mode suffix --metrics <list>` to see full names.
- **Environment variables (§5.5)** include `NV_COMPUTE_PROFILER_DISABLE_STOCK_FILE_DEPLOYMENT`, `NV_COMPUTE_PROFILER_LOCAL_CONNECTION_OVERRIDE`, `NV_COMPUTE_PROFILER_DISABLE_SW_PRE_PASS`, `NV_COMPUTE_PROFILER_DISABLE_CONCURRENT_PROFILING`, `NV_COMPUTE_PROFILER_CUDA_LOG_LINES` (default 5), `NV_NSIGHT_PYTHON_ISOLATED`.

---

## Truncation Assessment

**No truncation detected.** The document flows completely through:
- §5.1 Introduction → §5.2 Quickstart → §5.3 Usage (with all subsections) → §5.4 Command Line Options (all 11 subsections, ending at §5.4.11 MPS) → §5.5 Environment Variables → §5.6 Nvprof Transition Guide → Notices → Trademarks.

All documented option tables appear complete (including default-value columns and the footnote list `[1]`–`[15]`). The only "missing" items are literal section identifiers for `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis` and `Occupancy`, which is by design — the guide directs users to discover identifiers via `--list-sections` rather than enumerating every stock section on this page.

# Analysis of CUDA Best Practices Guide Content

## Summary

The provided content is a **truncated extraction** of the NVIDIA CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide (v13.4). It covers memory optimizations extensively but **the content is cut off mid-sentence** in Section 10.2.3.2 (Shared Memory in Matrix Multiplication), ending at `cudaMemcpyHostGetDevicePointer` context — specifically after a code block.

**Critical finding regarding the user's request:** The three primary topics requested — **occupancy**, **memory coalescing details beyond what's shown**, and **shared memory bank conflicts (padding, broadcast, 32 banks)** — are only *partially* present or entirely *absent* in this excerpt:

| Requested Topic | Present in Excerpt? |
|---|---|
| Theoretical occupancy | ❌ **Not present** (no dedicated occupancy section) |
| Register usage limiting occupancy | ❌ Not present |
| Shared memory per block limiting occupancy | ❌ Not present |
| Block size limiting occupancy | ❌ Not present |
| CUDA occupancy calculator | ❌ Not present |
| Memory coalescing (access patterns) | ✅ **Present** (Section 10.2.1) |
| Strided vs sequential access | ✅ Present |
| How to improve coalescing | ✅ Present (partially) |
| Shared memory bank conflicts (32 banks, padding, broadcast) | ⚠️ **Partially present** (10.2.3.1 only; padding/broadcast details cut off) |

The page **appears truncated**, as indicated by the `[content truncated]` marker and the abrupt cutoff mid-section.

---

## 1. OCCUPANCY

### ⚠️ NOT PRESENT IN THIS EXCERPT

The provided content **does not contain** any dedicated discussion of:
- Theoretical occupancy
- How register usage limits occupancy
- How shared memory per block limits occupancy
- How block size limits occupancy
- The CUDA occupancy calculator

**Where it would normally appear:** In the full CUDA Best Practices Guide, occupancy is covered in **Section 11 ("Execution Configuration Optimizations")**, specifically subsections on "Occupancy," "Calculating Occupancy," and "Occupancy Calculator." This content is **beyond the truncated point** of the current extraction.

**Related partial mention:** The excerpt references thread limits in Section 3.1:
> "Modern NVIDIA GPUs can support up to **2048 active threads concurrently per multiprocessor**... On GPUs with 80 multiprocessors, this leads to more than **160,000 concurrently active threads.**"

This is the only occupancy-adjacent figure provided.

---

## 2. MEMORY OPTIMIZATION / MEMORY COALESCING

**Location:** Section 10.2.1 "Coalesced Access to Global Memory" through 10.2.1.4.

### 2.1 Core Principles (Section 10.2.1)

> **High Priority:** Ensure global memory accesses are coalesced whenever possible.

- Global memory loads/stores by threads of a **warp** are coalesced by the device into as few transactions as possible.
- **For compute capability 6.0+:** concurrent accesses of threads of a warp coalesce into a number of transactions equal to the number of **32-byte transactions** necessary to service all threads of the warp.
- **For certain compute capability 5.2 devices:** if L1-caching is enabled, the number of required transactions equals the number of required **128-byte aligned segments**.
- **Note (6.0+):** L1-caching is default, but the data access unit is **32-byte regardless** of whether global loads are cached in L1.
- On **GDDR memory with ECC on**, coalesced access matters more — scattered access increases ECC overhead.

### 2.2 Simple (Aligned) Access Pattern (Section 10.2.1.1)

- **k-th thread accesses k-th word** in a 32-byte aligned array.
- Adjacent 4-byte words (e.g., adjacent `float` values): **four coalesced 32-byte transactions** service the memory access.
- Key facts:
  - If only a subset of words in a 32-byte segment is requested, the **full segment is fetched anyway**.
  - If accesses are **permuted within or across the four segments**, still only **four 32-byte transactions** are performed (on compute capability 6.0+).
- *Figure 3: Coalesced access — four 32-byte transactions indicated by red rectangles.*

### 2.3 Misaligned Sequential Access (Section 10.2.1.2)

- If sequential threads access memory sequential but **not 32-byte aligned**, **five 32-byte segments** are requested.
- **Memory allocated via `cudaMalloc()` is guaranteed aligned to at least 256 bytes.**
- **Recommendation:** choose thread block sizes as **multiples of warp size (32)** to facilitate aligned warp accesses.

### 2.4 Effects of Misaligned Access — Code Example (Section 10.2.1.3)

**A copy kernel that illustrates misaligned accesses:**

```cpp
__global__ void offsetCopy(float *odata, float* idata, int offset)
{
    int xid = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x + offset;
    odata[xid] = idata[xid];
}
```

**Measured results (NVIDIA Tesla V100, compute capability 7.0):**
- Offsets that are 0 or **multiples of 8 words** → **four 32-byte transactions**, achieved bandwidth ≈ **790 GB/s**.
- Otherwise → **five 32-byte segments per warp**, expected ≈ **4/5** of throughput.
- **Actual observed:** ≈ **9/10** (90%) because adjacent warps reuse cache lines (not as large an impact as expected).

### 2.5 Strided Accesses (Section 10.2.1.4)

**A kernel to illustrate non-unit stride data copy:**

```cpp
__global__ void strideCopy(float *odata, float* idata, int stride)
{
    int xid = (blockIdx.x*blockDim.x + threadIdx.x)*stride;
    odata[xid] = idata[xid];
}
```

- **Stride of 2:** threads within a warp access memory with stride 2 → leads to **eight L2 cache segments per warp** on Tesla V100 (compute capability 7.0).
- **Stride of 2 → 50% load/store efficiency** (half the elements in the transaction are unused = wasted bandwidth).
- As stride increases, effective bandwidth decreases until **32 32-byte segments are loaded for the 32 threads in a warp**.
- **Key recommendation:** **Non-unit-stride global memory accesses should be avoided whenever possible.** One method uses **shared memory** (see Section 10.2.3).

### 2.6 How to Improve Coalescing (Summary)

1. Ensure global memory accesses are coalesced (High Priority).
2. Use thread block sizes that are multiples of warp size (32).
3. Rely on `cudaMalloc()` 256-byte alignment guarantees.
4. Avoid non-unit-stride accesses (e.g., strided matrix column access).
5. Use shared memory to stage/reorder data into coalesced patterns.
6. On GDDR+ECC, coalescing is even more critical.

---

## 3. SHARED MEMORY BANK CONFLICTS

**Location:** Section 10.2.3.1 "Shared Memory and Memory Banks" (the beginning of bank-conflict discussion).

### 3.1 Memory Banks (Section 10.2.3.1)

- Shared memory is **on-chip**, providing much higher bandwidth and lower latency than local/global memory — **provided there are no bank conflicts**.
- **Banks:** shared memory is divided into equally sized memory modules (*banks*) that can be accessed simultaneously.
- **Any memory load/store of n addresses spanning n distinct banks** is serviced simultaneously → effective bandwidth **n times** that of a single bank.
- **Bank conflict:** if multiple addresses of a request map to the **same bank**, accesses are **serialized**.
  - Hardware splits a conflicting request into as many separate conflict-free requests as necessary.
  - This decreases effective bandwidth by a factor **equal to the number of separate memory requests**.
- **Broadcast (the exception):** When multiple threads in a warp address the **same** shared memory location, this results in a **broadcast**.
  - Multiple broadcasts from different banks are coalesced into a **single multicast** from the requested locations to the threads.

### 3.2 Bank Architecture Numbers (Section 10.2.3.1)

- On **compute capability 5.x or newer:**
  - **Each bank has a bandwidth of 32 bits every clock cycle.**
  - **Successive 32-bit words are assigned to successive banks.**
  - **Warp size = 32 threads; number of banks = 32.**
  - Therefore bank conflicts can occur between **any threads in the warp**.
- Reference provided: "Compute Capability 5.x for further details."

### 3.3 Matrix Multiplication Case Study (Section 10.2.3.2) — truncated

**Setup:** C = AB, with A of dimension M×w, B of dimension w×N, C of dimension M×N. M and N are multiples of 32 (warp size w = 32).

- Block and tile size of **w×w threads**; grid of **N/w by M/w blocks**.
- Each block computes a tile of C from a single tile of A and a single tile of B.

**Unoptimized matrix multiplication:**

```cpp
__global__ void simpleMultiply(float *a, float* b, float *c, int N)
{
    int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    float sum = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < TILE_DIM; i++) {
        sum += a[row*TILE_DIM+i] * b[i*N+col];
    }
    c[row*N+col] = sum;
}
```

- **Effective bandwidth: 119.9 GB/s** on NVIDIA Tesla V100.
- Issue: for each iteration *i*, all threads in a warp read the **same value** from global memory for matrix A (index `row*TILE_DIM+i` is constant within a warp).
- Even on compute capability 2.0+, this needs only 1 transaction, but wastes bandwidth — **only one 4-byte word out of 8 words in a 32-byte cache segment is used.**
- Cache line could be reused across iterations, but with many warps on the same multiprocessor, the cache line **may be evicted between iterations i and i+1.**

**Using shared memory to improve global memory load efficiency:**

```cpp
__global__ void coalescedMultiply(float *a, float* b, float *c, int N)
{
    __shared__ float aTile[TILE_DIM][TILE_DIM];

    int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    float sum = 0.0f;
    aTile[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = a[row*TILE_DIM+threadIdx.x];
    __syncwarp();
    for (int i = 0; i < TILE_DIM; i++) {
        sum += aTile[threadIdx.y][i]* b[i*N+col];
    }
    c[row*N+col] = sum;
}
```

### 3.4 ⚠️ Padding & Broadcast (Full Details) — NOT COMPLETE

The excerpt **only mentions broadcast** (Section 10.2.3.1) but **does not contain**:
- Detailed **padding** techniques to avoid bank conflicts
- Code examples with padding for `aTile[TILE_DIM][TILE_DIM+1]`
- The full C=AB / C=AAT shared memory matrix multiply analysis where padding is demonstrated

**Note:** The page's table of contents explicitly lists these as subsections that follow:

- 10.2.3.4. Asynchronous Copy from Global Memory to Shared Memory

These are **NOT included** in the provided truncated content — the content cuts off inside Section 10.2.3.2 (the `coalescedMultiply` example), right after the code block.

---

## 4. ADDITIONAL RELEVANT MEMORY CONTENT PRESENT

The following sections (also memory-related) are included and may be useful:

### 4.1 Data Transfer Between Host and Device (Section 10.1)
- **Key numbers:** Device memory↔GPU peak bandwidth = **898 GB/s** (Tesla V100); Host↔device (PCIe x16 Gen3) = **16 GB/s**; pinned memory ≈ **12 GB/s** on PCIe x16 Gen3.
- **High Priority:** Minimize data transfer between host and device.
- Pinned memory: `cudaHostAlloc()`, `cudaHostRegister()`; do not overuse (scarce resource, heavyweight operation).
- Async transfers: `cudaMemcpyAsync()` requires pinned memory; overlap via non-default streams.

### 4.2 Zero Copy (Section 10.1.3)
- GPU threads directly access host memory via mapped pinned memory.
- **Low Priority** for integrated GPUs (CUDA Toolkit 2.2+).
- Requires `cudaHostAlloc(..., cudaHostAllocMapped)`, `cudaSetDeviceFlags(cudaDeviceMapHost)`, `cudaHostGetDevicePointer()`.

### 4.3 Unified Virtual Addressing (10.1.4)
- Compute capability 2.0+, 64-bit Linux/Windows.
- `cudaPointerGetAttributes()` to inspect physical memory space.

### 4.4 L2 Cache Persistence (Section 10.2.2)
- CUDA 11.0+, compute capability 8.0+.
- Set-aside via `cudaDeviceSetLimit(cudaLimitPersistingL2CacheSize, ...)`.
- Access policy window: `hitRatio`, `num_bytes`, `hitProp`, `missProp`.
- Tesla A100 has **40 MB total L2 cache**; benchmark used **30 MB set-aside**.
- **Observed up to 50% performance increase** when persistent data fits in set-aside; **≈10% drop** when it exceeds (cache thrashing).

# CUDA Programming Guide[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-programming-guide/index.html#cuda-programming-guide "Link to this heading")

**CUDA and the CUDA Programming Guide**

CUDA is a parallel computing platform and programming model developed by NVIDIA that enables dramatic increases in computing performance by harnessing the power of the GPU. It allows developers to accelerate compute-intensive applications and is widely used in fields such as deep learning, scientific computing, and high-performance computing (HPC).

This CUDA Programming Guide is the official, comprehensive resource on the CUDA programming model and how to write code that executes on the GPU using the CUDA platform. This guide covers everything from the CUDA programming model and the CUDA platform to the details of language extensions and covers how to make use of specific hardware and software features. This guide provides a pathway for developers to learn CUDA if they are new, and also provides an essential resource for developers as they build applications using CUDA.

**Organization of This Guide**

Even for developers who primarily use libraries, frameworks, or DSLs, an understanding of the CUDA programming model and how GPUs execute code is valuable in knowing what is happening behind the layers of abstraction. This guide starts with a chapter on the [CUDA programming model](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-programming-guide/01-introduction/programming-model.html#programming-model) outside of any specific programming language which is applicable to anyone interested in understanding how CUDA works, even non-developers.

The guide is broken down into five primary parts:

- Part 1: Introduction and Programming Model Abstract
  
  - A language agnostic overview of the CUDA programming model as well as a brief tour of the CUDA platform.
  - This section is meant to be read by anyone wanting to understand GPUs and the concepts of executing code on GPUs, even if they are not developers.
- Part 2: Programming GPUs in CUDA
  
  - The basics of programming GPUs in C++ and Python.
  - This section is meant to be read by anyone wanting to get started in GPU programming.
  - This section is meant to be instructional, not complete, and teaches the most important and common parts of CUDA programming, including some common performance considerations.
- Part 3: Advanced CUDA
  
  - Introduces some more advance features of CUDA that enable both fine-grained control and more opportunities to maximize performance, including the use of multiple GPUs in a single application.
  - This section concludes with a [tour of the features covered in part 4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-programming-guide/03-advanced/feature-survey.html#tour-of-features) with a brief introduction to the purpose and function of each, sorted by when and why a developer may find each feature useful.
- Part 4: CUDA Features
  
  - This section contains complete coverage of specific CUDA features such as CUDA graphs, dynamic parallelism, interoperability with graphics APIs, and unified memory.
  - This section should be consulted when knowing the complete picture of a specific CUDA feature is needed. Where possible, care has been taken to introduce and motivate the features covered in this section in earlier sections.
- Part 5: Technical Appendices
  
  - The technical appendices provide some reference documentation on CUDA’s C++ high-level language support, hardware-specific specifications, and other technical specifications.
  - This section is meant as technical reference for specific description of syntax, semantics, and technical behavior of elements of CUDA.

Parts 1-3 provide a guided learning experience for developers new to CUDA, though they also provide insight and updated information useful for CUDA developers of any experience level.

Parts 4 and 5 provide a wealth of information about specific features and detailed topics, and are intended to provide a curated, well-organized reference for developers needing to know more details as they write CUDA applications.

# 用 Nsight Compute 分析并优化低 occupancy / 访存受限的 CUDA kernel

下面分「总体工作流 → 逐项分析（coalescing / shared memory / occupancy calculator / bank conflict）→ 可执行命令与代码 → 版本与未核实处」。**凡标注“未在本次抓取正文中核实”的，均为先验知识或需自行核对，不作为已取证结论。**

---

## 0. 总体工作流

1. 先判瓶颈类型：是 **latency-bound（occupancy 不足、stall 多）** 还是 **bandwidth-bound（DRAM/访存吞吐接近峰值）**。
2. 抓取报告：`ncu` CLI 采集 → `ncu-ui` 打开逐 section 分析。
3. 按 `Memory Workload Analysis`（访存模式/吞吐）与 `Occupancy`（并行度）定位，再回到源码/SASS 修改（合并访问、向量化、shared memory、padding、调 block size / 寄存器）。

---

## 1. 采集命令与参数

**基础采集（官方 CLI 指南 §5.3.1 Quickstart）**：
```
ncu -o profile.ncu-rep ./app
```
- 不指定 `--set`/`--section`/`--metrics` 时默认采集 `basic` set。
- `--export`（`-o`）设置输出文件；若只设 `-o` 且无 `--page`，则不向控制台打印结果。
- `-f` / `--force-overwrite` 允许覆盖已存在文件（默认会报错不覆盖）。

**只采集成相关 section（CLI §5.4.1 `--section`）**：
```
ncu --section MemoryWorkloadAnalysis --section Occupancy --section LaunchStats --section SchedulerStats ./app
```
- 官方正文（ProfilingGuide §2.2.2）确认存在 section 标识符：`Occupancy`、`MemoryWorkloadAnalysis`、`MemoryWorkloadAnalysis_Chart`、`MemoryWorkloadAnalysis_Tables`、`LaunchStats`、`SchedulerStats`、`WarpStateStats`、`SourceCounters`。
- CLI 指南的配置样例直接使用：`--section = LaunchStats, Occupancy`。

**按 kernel 过滤与范围回放（CLI §5.4）**：
```
ncu --kernel-name regex:"myKernel" --launch-skip 5 --launch-count 1 ./app
```
- `-k/--kernel-name` 精确名或 `regex:`；`--kernel-name-base` 默认 `function`（可选 `demangled`/`mangled`）。
- `-s/--launch-skip` 默认 `0`；`-c/--launch-count` 计数只对匹配过滤器的 launch 递增。
- `--kill` 默认 `no`。

**replay / cache / clock（影响访存类指标，务必注意）**：
- `--replay-mode` 默认 `kernel`（可选 `application`/`range`/`app-range`）。
- `--cache-control` 默认 `all`：**每次 kernel replay 前 flush 所有 GPU cache**（可复现性最高）；`none` 为不 flush。测量访存命中/复用时需明确你用的是哪种。
- `--clock-control` 默认 `boost`（可选 `base`/`force-boost`/`none`/`reset`）。官方在 Duration 讨论中建议 `--replay-mode application` + `--cache-control none`，并用 `--clock-control none` 配合锁频对比 Nsight Systems。

**发现 section/指标（CLI §5.4）**：
```
ncu --list-sections
ncu --list-sets
ncu --list-metrics --section Occupancy
ncu --query-metrics
ncu --query-metrics-collection occupancy
ncu --query-metrics-mode suffix --metrics sm__inst_executed --chip ga100
```
- `--query-metrics-collection` 可选值包含 `occupancy`（原文：“Query occupancy calculation metrics”）。
- `--query-metrics-mode` 默认 `base`；`suffix` 用于列某 base metric 的全部后缀；`all` 列所有全名。
- `--metrics` 支持前缀 `regex:`、`group:`、`breakdown:`、`pmsampling:`（不可混合）；`breakdown:<throughput-metric>` 可列高层的分解项。

**UI**：`ncu-ui profile.ncu-rep`（本项来自先验，文档未在抓取正文中重现该命令）。

---

## 2. 判瓶颈：Memory Workload Analysis

**已核实的官方正文（ProfilingGuide §2.2.2 section 描述）**：

> `MemoryWorkloadAnalysis`: “Detailed analysis of the memory resources of the GPU. Memory can become a limiting factor for the overall kernel performance when fully utilizing the involved hardware units (Mem Busy), exhausting the available communication bandwidth between those units (Max Bandwidth), or by reaching the maximum throughput of issuing memory instructions (Mem Pipes Busy).”

即看 **Mem Busy / Max Bandwidth / Mem Pipes Busy** 三类信号。配合 SpeedOfLight 的 DRAM 吞吐与 compute 吞吐百分比对比：DRAM% 高、compute% 低 → 偏向 memory bound。DRAM 峰值占比指标先验为 `dram__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed`（**未在抓取正文中核实**）。

---

## 3. Memory coalescing（合并访问）

**已核实的官方模型（ProfilingGuide §2.3.7 Quantities + L1TEX 处理模型）**：
- `sector` = “Aligned 32 byte-chunk of memory”；L1/L2 cache line = 4 sectors = 128 bytes。
- 一条 warp 的 global/local 访存 → 一个 `request` → 访问若干 cache line 与 `sectors`。
- 关系：“requests:sectors is 1:N, wavefronts:sectors 1:N, and requests:wavefronts is 1:N”；`wavefronts` 代表处理这些 request 所需的周期数。
- 原文：“For example, it is possible to have a memory instruction that requires 4 sectors per request in 1 wavefront.” → **32 线程 × 4B = 128B = 4 sectors 即理想情况。**

**待核实的指标名（metrics reference 被抓取截断，未取得原文）**：常见为
`l1tex__average_t_sectors_per_request_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld.ratio`（理想≈4）——**请用 `ncu --query-metrics` 在你的版本上确认**。

**已核实的官方优化建议与量化数据（CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide §10.2.1）**：
- 高优先级：尽量合并 global 访存；compute capability 6.0+ 下，一个 warp 的并发访问合并成 **32-byte 事务**数。
- 对齐顺序访问（第 k 线程访问第 k 个 word，32B 对齐）：**4 个 32-byte 事务**。
- 每 32B 段只要被部分用到也会整段取回；对齐良好的情况下置换访问仍是 4 个事务。
- 非 32B 对齐的顺序访问：**5 个 32-byte 段**；`cudaMalloc()` 返回至少 256B 对齐；建议 block size 取 32 的倍数。
- 代码与实测（Tesla V100, CC 7.0）：
```cpp
__global__ void offsetCopy(float *odata, float* idata, int offset) {
    int xid = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x + offset;
    odata[xid] = idata[xid];
}
```
  offset 为 0 或 8 words 的倍数 → 4 个 32B 事务，≈790 GB/s；否则 5 段/ warp，理论 4/5，实测约 9/10（相邻 warp 复用缓存行）。
- stride 访问：
```cpp
__global__ void strideCopy(float *odata, float* idata, int stride) {
    int xid = (blockIdx.x*blockDim.x + threadIdx.x)*stride;
    odata[xid] = idata[xid];
}
```
  stride=2 → 每 warp **8 个 L2 段**，load/store 效率 **50%**；stride 越大越差，直至 32 个 32B 段。原文：“Non-unit-stride global memory accesses should be avoided whenever possible.”，可用 shared memory 重排。
- 补充：GDDR + ECC 开启时，分散访问会更放大开销。

---

## 4. Shared memory / bank conflict

**已核实的官方正文（ProfilingGuide §2.3.1 Memory）**：

> “Shared memory has 32 banks … successive 32-bit words map to successive banks … Any 32-bit memory read or write request made of 32 addresses that fall in 32 distinct memory banks can therefore be serviced simultaneously … However, if two addresses of a memory request fall in the same memory bank, there is a bank conflict and the access has to be serialized.”

> “A shared memory request for a warp does not generate a bank conflict between two threads that access any address within the same 32-bit word … When multiple threads make the same read access, one thread receives the data and then broadcasts it to the other threads.”

**已核实的 bank conflict 指标名（ProfilingGuide §2.3.2 Metrics Examples）**：
```
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.per_cycle_active
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.per_cycle_elapsed
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.pct_of_peak_sustained_active
l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed
```
（另有 `.sum.peak_sustained*`、`.sum.per_second` 等同族后缀。）

**CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide §10.2.3.1 补充（已核实）**：
- CC 5.x 及更新：**每 bank 每周期带宽 32 bits；相邻 32-bit word 分配到相邻 bank；warp=32 线程、bank=32 个。**
- 冲突时硬件把请求拆成多个无冲突请求，有效带宽按拆分数成比例下降；**同一地址的广播/多播例外**。

**优化手段（padding 等）**：本次抓取的 Best Practices Guide 在 §10.2.3.2 的 `coalescedMultiply` 后**被截断**，`10.2.3.3 (C=AAT)`、`10.2.3.4 (异步拷贝)` 及 **padding 的正文与代码示例未取得**（原文有 `[content truncated]`）。因此“`__shared__ float tile[TILE][TILE+1]` 加 1 列 padding 消冲突”这一做法属**先验/常识，未在本次官方正文中核实**。已核实的相邻示例：
```cpp
__global__ void coalescedMultiply(float *a, float* b, float *c, int N) {
    __shared__ float aTile[TILE_DIM][TILE_DIM];
    int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    float sum = 0.0f;
    aTile[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = a[row*TILE_DIM+threadIdx.x];
    __syncwarp();
    for (int i = 0; i < TILE_DIM; i++)
        sum += aTile[threadIdx.y][i]* b[i*N+col];
    c[row*N+col] = sum;
}
```
（原文未优化版 `simpleMultiply` 在 V100 上有效带宽 119.9 GB/s。）

---

## 5. Occupancy 与 occupancy calculator

**已核实的官方定义与限制因素**：
- ProfilingGuide §2.2.2 `Occupancy` section 描述：
  > “Occupancy is the ratio of the number of active warps per multiprocessor to the maximum number of possible active warps … Higher occupancy does not always result in higher performance, however, low occupancy always reduces the ability to hide latencies … Large discrepancies between the theoretical and the achieved occupancy during execution typically indicates highly imbalanced workloads.”
- ProfilingGuide §2.3.1（Compute Model / SM）限制因素原文：
  > “The number of CTAs that fit on each SM depends on the physical resources required by the CTA. These resource limiters include the number of threads and registers, shared memory utilization, and hardware barriers.”
  > “The most important resource under the compiler’s control is the number of registers used by a kernel. Each sub partition has a set of 32-bit registers, which are allocated by the HW in fixed-size chunks. The Launch Statistics section shows the kernel’s register usage.”
  > 并给出 `Wave` 定义：“The total number of CTAs that can run concurrently on a given GPU is referred to as Wave … the size of a Wave scales with the number of available SMs … but also with the occupancy of the kernel.”
- 静态 `launch__*` 指标“collected per kernel launch, and do not require an additional replay pass … computed using the CUDA Occupancy Calculator”（含 `launch__occupancy_per_*`）。

**Nsight Compute 的 Occupancy Calculator（已核实存在，细节未取得）**：
- Nsight Compute UI 文档（§4.3 Start Activity Dialog）把 **Occupancy Calculator** 列为可启动活动之一；§4.7.1 Report Header → Tools group：“Occupancy Calculator opens the Occupancy Calculator in a new document.”
- 但该页在 §4.7.2 Summary Page 处**被截断**，**Details 页中的 Occupancy section 内部细节（theoretical vs achieved、各 limit 分解、计算器输入表单）未取得**。

**CUDA Runtime 侧 occupancy calculator API（已核实，Runtime API §6.9 Occupancy）**：
```cpp
__host__ __device__ cudaError_t
cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(int* numBlocks, const void* func,
                                              int blockSize, size_t dynamicSMemSize);
__host__ cudaError_t
cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessorWithFlags(int* numBlocks, const void* func,
                                              int blockSize, size_t dynamicSMemSize,
                                              unsigned int flags);
__host__ cudaError_t
cudaOccupancyAvailableDynamicSMemPerBlock(size_t* dynamicSmemSize, const void* func,
                                          int numBlocks, int blockSize);
__host__ cudaError_t
cudaOccupancyMaxActiveClusters(int* numClusters, const void* func,
                               const cudaLaunchConfig_t* launchConfig);
__host__ cudaError_t
cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialClusterSize(int* clusterSize, const void* func,
                                     const cudaLaunchConfig_t* launchConfig);
```
- `cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor`：返回 `*numBlocks` = 该 device function 每个 SM 的最大 active blocks；参数 `blockSize`、`dynamicSmemSize`（每 block 动态 shared memory，字节）。
- 返回值：`cudaSuccess, cudaErrorInvalidDevice, cudaErrorInvalidDeviceFunction, cudaErrorInvalidValue, cudaErrorUnknown`。
- `...WithFlags` 的 `flags` 可取 `cudaOccupancyDefault`、`cudaOccupancyDisableCachingOverride`（后者抑制“全局缓存影响 occupancy”平台的默认修正，遇零 occupancy 时返回 0）。
- C++ 侧另有 `cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize`、`cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSizeVariableSMem`（含 WithFlags 版本）——**其参数与示例正文未在抓取范围内**。
- 注意：`cudaOccupancyMaxActiveClusters` 原文：“Runtime environment may affect how the hardware schedules the clusters, so the calculated occupancy is not guaranteed to be achievable.”

**优化方向**：降寄存器（`__launch_bounds__` / `maxrregcount` 未在抓取正文中核实）、降 shared memory/block、调 block size（取 32 的倍数）、减小同步/barrier 依赖。

---

## 6. 版本相关（M4/M9 范围：Nsight Compute 与目标 GPU）

- 本次抓取的 **Profiling Guide**、**Nsight Compute CLI**、**Nsight Compute UI** 三份官方文档，正文中**未出现具体的 Nsight Compute 版本号**；Profiling Guide 示例使用 `--chip ga100`（Ampere）。

仅凭已有知识，我可以给出如下回答（不检索）：

## 核心概念
- **CUDA Stream**：一个按顺序执行的操作队列。不同 stream 之间的操作可以重叠（并发执行）。默认 stream（stream 0，legacy default）有隐式同步语义，会阻塞其他 stream，应避免；推荐使用 non-blocking stream（`cudaStreamNonBlocking` 或 per-thread default stream）。
- **异步内存拷贝**：`cudaMemcpyAsync(dst, src, count, kind, stream)`。它只在 **page-locked（pinned）host memory** 上才真正异步；若 host 侧是普通 pageable memory，驱动会退化为同步分块拷贝（staging），无法与 kernel 重叠。
- **Event**：`cudaEvent_t` 用于计时（`cudaEventRecord` / `cudaEventSynchronize` / `cudaEventElapsedTime`）或流间同步（`cudaStreamWaitEvent`）。

## 典型重叠流程（分块 pipeline）
1. 分配 pinned host buffer：`cudaHostAlloc(&h, bytes, cudaHostAllocDefault)`。
2. 分配 device buffer：`cudaMalloc`。
3. 创建 stream（可用多个）与 event（可选）。
4. 对每个 chunk i：
   - H2D：`cudaMemcpyAsync(d_in[i], h_in[i], sz, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream)`（可选先 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(stream, copy_done[i-1])` 保证复用安全）。
   - kernel：`myKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(...)`。
   - D2H：`cudaMemcpyAsync(h_out[i], d_out[i], sz, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream)`。
5. 用两个或多个 stream 交替 chunk（double buffering），使 stream A 做 D2H 时 stream B 做 H2D/计算。
6. 结束：`cudaStreamSynchronize(stream)` 或 `cudaDeviceSynchronize()`。
7. 计时：`cudaEventRecord(start, stream)` 与 stop，`cudaEventSynchronize(stop)`，`cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, start, stop)`。
8. 释放：`cudaFree`、`cudaFreeHost`、`cudaStreamDestroy`、`cudaEventDestroy`。

## 关键参数与约束（记忆）
- `cudaHostAlloc` flags：`cudaHostAllocDefault`、`cudaHostAllocPortable`、`cudaHostAllocMapped`、`cudaHostAllocWriteCombined`。
- non-blocking stream 标志：`cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&s, cudaStreamNonBlocking)`。
- pinned 内存过多会拖慢系统（占用物理页），需权衡。
- `cudaMemcpyAsync` 的 kind：`cudaMemcpyHostToDevice`、`cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost`、`cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice`。
- 计算能力需 ≥ 1.1 才支持 async；overlap copy/compute 需要 ≥ 2.0（旧架构）。

## 不确定处
1. 具体 API 签名、新版本是否引入 `cudaStreamCreateWithPriority` / `cudaMemcpyAsync` 的精确参数顺序与文档链接，我记忆清晰但需要官方核对。
2. `cudaMallocAsync` / memory pool（`cudaMemPool`）在现代 CUDA（≥11.2）中与 stream 的交互细节。
3. 版本关系：CUDA Toolkit 版本与对应 driver 版本、`cudaMemcpyAsync` 何时真正异步的官方措辞。
4. write-combined pinned memory 对 D2H 的性能影响方向（记忆中是 H2D 有利，D2H 不利，但需核对）。
5. 官方文档的确切 URL 与章节。

以上为检索前知识，未接触任何检索内容。

**标题**: 如何在 CUDA C/C++ 中实现数据传输的重叠 - NVIDIA 技术博客
**发布时间**: 2012年 12月 13日

# 如何在 CUDA C/C++ 中实现数据传输的重叠

作者：[Mark Harris](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/author/mark-harris/ "Posts by Mark Harris")

![](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/CUDA_Cube_1K-300x298.jpg)在[上一期的 C / C ++ 文章](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/parallelforall/how-optimize-data-transfers-cuda-cc/ "How to Optimize Data Transfers in CUDA C/C++") 中，我们讨论了如何在主机和设备之间高效地传输数据。在这篇文章中，我们讨论了如何将数据传输与主机上的计算、设备上的计算相重叠，在某些情况下，主机和设备之间的其他数据传输。实现数据传输和其他操作之间的重叠需要使用 CUDA 流，所以首先让我们了解一下流。

# CUDA 流

CUDA 中的 *stream* 是按照主机代码发出的顺序在设备上执行的操作序列。虽然流中的操作被保证按规定的顺序执行，但是不同流中的操作可以被交错，并且在可能的情况下，它们甚至可以并发运行。

## 默认流[](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/how-overlap-data-transfers-cuda-cc/#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E6%B5%81)

CUDA 中的所有设备操作（内核和数据传输）都在一个流中运行。如果没有指定流，则使用默认流（也称为“空流”）。默认流与其他流不同，因为它是关于设备上操作的同步流：在所有先前发出的操作 *在设备上的任何流中* 完成之前，默认流中的任何操作都不会开始，并且默认流中的操作必须在任何其他操作（在设备上的任何流中）之前完成就要开始了。

请注意， 2015 年发布的 CUDA 7 引入了一个新的选项，即每个主机线程使用单独的默认流，并将每个线程的默认流视为常规流（即它们不与其他流中的操作同步）。在文章 [GPU 专业提示： CUDA 7 流简化并发](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/parallelforall/gpu-pro-tip-cuda-7-streams-simplify-concurrency/) 中阅读更多关于这种新行为的信息。

让我们看一些使用默认流的简单代码示例，并从主机和设备的角度讨论操作是如何进行的。

```
cudaMemcpy(d_a, a, numBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
increment<<<1,N>>>(d_a)
cudaMemcpy(a, d_a, numBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
```

在上面的代码中，从设备的角度来看，所有三个操作都被发布到同一个（默认）流中，并将按照它们发出的顺序执行。

从主机的角度看，隐式数据传输是阻塞或同步传输，而内核启动是异步的。由于第一行上的主机到设备的数据传输是同步的， CPU 线程在主机到设备的传输完成之前不会到达第二行的内核调用。一旦内核被发出， CPU 线程将移动到第三行，但由于设备端的执行顺序，该行上的传输无法开始。

内核从主机的角度启动的异步行为使得重叠的设备和主机计算非常简单。我们可以修改代码以添加一些独立的 CPU 计算，如下所示。

```
cudaMemcpy(d_a, a, numBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
increment<<<1,N>>>(d_a)
myCpuFunction(b)
cudaMemcpy(a, d_a, numBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
```

在上面的代码中，一旦 `increment()` 内核在设备上启动， CPU 线程就执行 `myCpuFunction()` ，它在 CPU 上的执行与在 GPU 上的内核执行重叠。无论是主机功能还是设备内核先完成，都不会影响后续的设备到主机的传输，只有在内核完成后才会开始，从设备的角度来看，上一个例子没有什么变化，设备完全不知道 `myCpuFunction()` 。

## 非默认流[](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/how-overlap-data-transfers-cuda-cc/#%E9%9D%9E%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E6%B5%81)

在下面的代码中， CUDA C / C ++的非默认流被声明、创建和销毁。

```
cudaStream_t stream1;
cudaError_t result;
result = cudaStreamCreate(&stream1)
result = cudaStreamDestroy(stream1)
```

为了向非默认流发出数据传输，我们使用了 `cudaMemcpyAsync()` 函数，它类似于前一篇文章中讨论的 `cudaMemcpy()` 函数，但将流标识符作为第五个参数。

```
result = cudaMemcpyAsync(d_a, a, N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream1)
```

`cudaMemcpyAsync()` 在主机上是非阻塞的，因此在发出传输之后，控制权立即返回到主机线程。此例程有 `cudaMemcpy2DAsync()` 和 `cudaMemcpy3DAsync()` 变体，它们可以在指定的流中异步传输 2D 和 3D 数组部分。

为了向非默认流发出内核，我们将流标识符指定为第四个执行配置参数（第三个执行配置参数分配共享设备内存，我们将在后面讨论；现在使用 0 ）。

```
increment<<<1,N,0,stream1>>>(d_a)
```

## 与流同步[](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/how-overlap-data-transfers-cuda-cc/#%E4%B8%8E%E6%B5%81%E5%90%8C%E6%AD%A5)

由于非默认流中的所有操作相对于宿主代码都是非阻塞的，因此您将遇到需要将宿主代码与流中的操作同步的情况。“重锤”的方法是使用 `cudaDeviceSynchronize()` ，它会阻止主机代码，直到之前在设备上发出的所有操作都完成为止。在大多数情况下，这是一种过度杀戮，并且会由于整个设备和主机线程的暂停而影响性能。

CUDA 流 API 有多种不太严格的同步主机与流的方法。函数 `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream)` 可用于阻止主机线程，直到指定流中以前发出的所有操作都已完成。函数 `cudaStreamQuery(stream)` 测试向指定流发出的所有操作是否已完成，而不阻止主机执行。函数 `cudaEventSynchronize(event)` 和 `cudaEventQuery(event)` 的行为与它们的流对应项相似，只是它们的结果基于是否记录了指定的事件，而不是基于指定的流是否空闲。您还可以使用 [cudaStreamWaitEvent](http://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-runtime-api/index.html#group__CUDART__STREAM_1g80c62c379f0c3ed8afe31fd0a31ad8a2) （ event ）在单个流中同步特定事件的操作（即使事件记录在不同的流中，或者记录在不同的设备上）。

# 重叠的内核执行和数据传输

前面我们演示了如何将默认流中的内核执行与主机上的代码执行重叠。但我们在这篇文章中的主要目标是向您展示如何将内核执行与数据传输重叠。要做到这一点有几个要求。

- 设备必须能够“并发复制和执行”。这可以从 `cudaDeviceProp` 结构的 `deviceOverlap` 字段或从 CUDA SDK / Toolkit 附带的 `deviceQuery` 示例的输出中进行查询。几乎所有具有计算能力 1 . 1 及更高版本的设备都具有此功能。
- 要重叠的内核执行和数据传输必须同时发生在 *different* 、 *non-default* 流中。
- 数据传输所涉及的主机内存必须是 [pinned](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/parallelforall/how-optimize-data-transfers-cuda-cc/ "How to Optimize Data Transfers in CUDA C/C++") 内存。

因此，让我们从上面修改我们的简单主机代码，以使用多个流，看看是否可以实现任何重叠。这个例子的完整代码是 [在 Github 上提供](https://github.com/parallel-forall/code-samples/blob/master/series/cuda-cpp/overlap-data-transfers/async.cu) 。在修改后的代码中，我们将大小为 `N` 的数组分解为 `streamSize` 元素的块。由于内核对所有元素都是独立操作的，因此每个块都可以独立处理。使用的（非默认）流数为 `nStreams=N/streamSize` 。有多种方法可以实现数据的域分解和处理；一种方法是循环使用数组中每个块的所有操作，如本示例代码所示。

```
for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
  int offset = i * streamSize;
  cudaMemcpyAsync(&d_a[offset], &a[offset], streamBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[i]);
  kernel<<<streamSize/blockSize, blockSize, 0, stream[i]>>>(d_a, offset);
  cudaMemcpyAsync(&a[offset], &d_a[offset], streamBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[i]);
}
```

另一种方法是将类似的操作批处理在一起，首先发出所有主机到设备的传输，然后是所有的内核启动，然后是所有设备到主机的传输，如下面的代码所示。

```
for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
  int offset = i * streamSize;
  cudaMemcpyAsync(&d_a[offset], &a[offset],
                  streamBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[i]);
}

for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
  int offset = i * streamSize;
  kernel<<<streamSize/blockSize, blockSize, 0, stream[i]>>>(d_a, offset);
}

for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
  int offset = i * streamSize;
  cudaMemcpyAsync(&a[offset], &d_a[offset],
                  streamBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[i]);
}
```

上面显示的两个异步方法都会产生正确的结果，并且在这两种情况下，依赖操作都会按照它们需要执行的顺序发布到同一个流。但根据所使用的 GPU 的特定代数，这两种方法的性能截然不同。在 Tesla C1060 （计算能力 1 . 3 ）上运行测试代码（来自 Github ）给出以下结果。

```
Device : Tesla C1060

Time for sequential transfer and execute (ms ): 12.92381
  max error : 2.3841858E -07
Time for asynchronous V1 transfer and execute (ms ): 13.63690
  max error : 2.3841858E -07
Time for asynchronous V2 transfer and execute (ms ): 8.84588
  max error : 2.3841858E -07
```

在 Tesla C2050 （计算能力 2 . 0 ）上，我们得到以下结果。

```
Device : Tesla C2050

Time for sequential transfer and execute (ms ): 9.984512
  max error : 1.1920929e -07
Time for asynchronous V1 transfer and execute (ms ): 5.735584
  max error : 1.1920929e -07
Time for asynchronous V2 transfer and execute (ms ): 7.597984
  max error : 1.1920929e -07
```

这里第一次报告的是使用阻塞传输的顺序传输和内核执行，我们将其作为异步加速比较的基线。为什么这两种异步策略在不同的体系结构上表现不同？要破解这些结果，我们需要更多地了解 CUDA 设备如何调度和执行任务。 CUDA 设备包含用于各种任务的引擎，这些引擎在发出操作时对操作进行排队。不同引擎中的任务之间的依赖关系得到维护，但是在任何引擎中，所有外部依赖关系都会丢失；每个引擎队列中的任务将按照它们的发出顺序执行。 C1060 有一个拷贝引擎和一个内核引擎。在 C1060 上执行示例代码的时间线如下图所示。

在这个示意图中，我们假设主机到设备传输、内核执行和设备到主机传输所需的时间大致相同（选择内核代码是为了实现这一点）。正如顺序内核所期望的那样，任何操作中都没有重叠。对于我们代码的第一个异步版本，复制引擎中的执行顺序是： H2D stream （ 1 ）、 D2H stream （ 1 ）、 H2D stream （ 2 ）、 D2H stream （ 2 ）等等。这就是为什么我们在 C1060 上使用第一个异步版本时看不到任何加速：任务是按照排除内核执行和数据传输重叠的顺序被发送到复制引擎的。然而，对于版本 2 ，在所有主机到设备的传输在任何设备到主机的传输之前发出，重叠是可能的，如较低的执行时间所示。根据我们的示意图，我们期望异步版本 2 的执行时间是顺序版本的 8 / 12 ，或者 8 . 7ms ，这在前面给出的计时结果中得到了确认。

在 C2050 上，两个功能相互作用导致与 C1060 不同的行为。 C2050 有两个复制引擎，一个用于主机到设备的传输，另一个用于设备到主机的传输，以及一个内核引擎。下图说明了我们的示例在 C2050 上的执行。

有两个复制引擎解释了为什么异步版本 1 在 C2050 上实现了很好的加速：流[i] 不阻止流中数据的主机到设备传输 [i + 1]中数据的主机到设备的传输，因为 C2050 上的每个复制方向都有一个单独的引擎。示意图预测了执行情况相对于顺序版本，时间被缩短一半，这大致就是我们的计时结果显示的。

但是在 C2050 上的异步版本 2 中观察到的性能下降呢？这与 C2050 并发运行多个内核的能力有关。当多个内核在不同（非默认）流中背靠背地发出时，调度程序尝试启用这些内核的并发执行，结果会延迟通常在每个内核完成后出现的信号（这负责启动设备到主机的传输），直到所有内核完成。因此，虽然在第二个版本的异步代码中，主机到设备的传输和内核的执行之间有重叠，但是内核执行和设备到主机的传输之间没有重叠。示意图预测异步版本 2 的总时间是顺序版本的 9 / 12 ，即 7 . 5 毫秒，这一点由我们的计时结果证实。

[CUDA Fortran 异步数据传输](http://www.pgroup.com/lit/articles/insider/v3n1a4.htm) 中提供了关于本文中使用的示例的更详细的描述，好消息是对于具有计算能力 3 . 5 （ K20 系列）的设备， Hyper-Q 特性消除了定制发布顺序的需要，因此上述任何一种方法都可以工作。我们将在以后的文章中讨论使用开普勒特性，但是现在，这里是在 Tesla K20c GPU 上运行示例代码的结果。如您所见，这两个异步方法在同步代码上实现了相同的加速。

```
Device : Tesla K20c
Time for sequential transfer and execute (ms): 7.101760
  max error : 1.1920929e -07
Time for asynchronous V1 transfer and execute (ms): 3.974144
  max error : 1.1920929e -07
Time for asynchronous V2 transfer and execute (ms): 3.967616
  max error : 1.1920929e -07
```

# 概括

这篇文章和 [上一个](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/parallelforall/how-optimize-data-transfers-cuda-cc/ "How to Optimize Data Transfers in CUDA C/C++") 讨论了如何优化主机和设备之间的数据传输。上一篇文章集中讨论了如何最小化执行这种传输的时间，这篇文章介绍了流，以及如何使用流通过并发执行副本和内核来屏蔽数据传输时间。

在一篇关于流的文章中，我应该提到，虽然使用默认流可以方便地开发代码，但同步代码更简单，最终您的代码应该使用非默认流或 CUDA 7 对每线程默认流的支持（读 [GPU 专业提示： CUDA 7 流简化并发](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/parallelforall/gpu-pro-tip-cuda-7-streams-simplify-concurrency/) ）。这在编写库时尤其重要。如果库中的代码使用默认流，那么最终用户就没有机会将数据传输与库内核执行重叠。

现在您已经知道如何在主机和设备之间高效地移动数据，所以我们将研究如何在 [下一篇文章](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/parallelforall/how-access-global-memory-efficiently-cuda-c-kernels/ "How to Access Global Memory Efficiently in CUDA C/C++ Kernels") 中的内核中高效地访问数据。

<answer>

# CUDA Streams + `cudaMemcpyAsync` 实现 H2D/D2H 与 Kernel 重叠

## 一、原理（来自官方文档）

CUDA Programming Guide（本页版本 **v13.4.2**，更新日期 2026-09-10，章节 2.5.1–2.5.10）说明：CUDA 允许 host 计算、device 计算、H2D 传输、D2H 传输并发执行，并发通过**异步接口**表达——调用立即返回：

> "The concurrency is expressed via an asynchronous interface, where a dispatching function call or kernel launch returns immediately. Asynchronous calls usually return before the dispatched operation has completed and may return before the asynchronous operation has started."

核心抽象是 **CUDA Streams** 与 **CUDA Events**。

### 关键约束（官方原文，务必遵守）

1. **必须用 pinned（page-locked）host memory** 才能真异步：
   > "In order for memory copies involving CPU memory to be carried out asynchronously, the host buffers must be pinned and page-locked. `cudaMemcpyAsync()` will function correctly if host memory which is not pinned and page-locked is used, but it will revert to a synchronous behavior which will not overlap with other work... It is recommended programs use `cudaMallocHost()` to allocate buffers which will be used to send or receive data from GPUs."

   即：用 pageable `malloc` 时 `cudaMemcpyAsync` **退化为同步**，不会重叠。

2. **不同 stream 才可能重叠**；默认流（NULL/stream 0）是 blocking stream，会与其他 blocking stream 互相串行化：
   > "kernel2 will wait for kernel1 to complete, and kernel3 will wait for kernel2 to complete, even if in principle all three kernels could execute concurrently."

   用 `cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&s, cudaStreamNonBlocking)` 消除这种同步。

3. **同一 stream 内按入队顺序串行执行**（in-order streams），所以 H2D → kernel → D2H 放在同一 stream 即可保证依赖顺序，无需 event。
   > "CUDA streams are what are known as in-order streams. This means that the order of execution of the operations in a stream is the same as the order in which those operations were enqueued."

4. **硬件/版本前提**：实际并发取决于 CUDA 版本与 compute capability；官方博客给出可查条件——设备需支持 concurrent copy and execute（`cudaDeviceProp.deviceOverlap`，compute capability ≥ 1.1），且要重叠的内核与传输必须位于**不同且非默认**流中；自 compute capability 3.5（K20，Hyper-Q）起不再需要精心安排发射顺序。

5. 默认流行为可用 per-thread default stream 消除（**CUDA-7 起**）：`--default-stream per-thread` 编译选项或宏 `CUDA_API_PER_THREAD_DEFAULT_STREAM`。

## 二、完整可运行示例（double-buffer / 多流流水线）

```cuda
// overlap.cu  — H2D / kernel / D2H overlap with streams + pinned memory
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#define CHECK(x) do { cudaError_t e = (x); if (e != cudaSuccess) {                  \
    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,                  \
            cudaGetErrorString(e)); std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE); } } while (0)

__global__ void kernel(const float* __restrict__ in,
                       float* __restrict__ out, int n) {
    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (i < n) out[i] = in[i] * 2.0f + 1.0f;
}

int main() {
    const size_t total   = 1u << 24;          // total floats
    const int    nStreams = 4;                // chunks / streams
    const size_t chunk   = total / nStreams;  // floats per chunk
    const size_t hBytes  = total * sizeof(float);
    const size_t cBytes  = chunk * sizeof(float);

    // (1) pinned (page-locked) host buffers  -> required for true async
    float *h_in = nullptr, *h_out = nullptr;
    CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_in , hBytes));    // == cudaHostAlloc(...,cudaHostAllocDefault)
    CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_out, hBytes));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < total; ++i) h_in[i] = 1.0f;

    // (2) device buffers
    float *d_in = nullptr, *d_out = nullptr;
    CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_in , hBytes));
    CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_out, hBytes));

    // (3) non-blocking streams + per-stream events
    cudaStream_t stream[nStreams];
    cudaEvent_t  done[nStreams];
    for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
        CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream[i], cudaStreamNonBlocking));
        CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&done[i], cudaEventDisableTiming));
    }

    cudaEvent_t t0, t1;
    CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&t0));
    CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&t1));

    const int threads = 256;
    CHECK(cudaEventRecord(t0, stream[0]));    // start timing

    for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
        size_t off = (size_t)i * chunk;

        // H2D async (only async if h_in is pinned)
        CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_in + off, h_in + off, cBytes,
                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[i]));

        // kernel in the SAME stream -> runs after that chunk's H2D copy
        int blocks = (int)((chunk + threads - 1) / threads);
        kernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream[i]>>>(d_in + off, d_out + off, (int)chunk);
        CHECK(cudaGetLastError());

        // D2H async
        CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_out + off, d_out + off, cBytes,
                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[i]));

        CHECK(cudaEventRecord(done[i], stream[i]));   // mark chunk done
    }

    // (4) sync + stop timing
    for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[i]));
    CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    CHECK(cudaEventRecord(t1, stream[0]));
    CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(t1));
    float ms = 0.f;
    CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, t0, t1));
    printf("elapsed: %.3f ms\n", ms);

    // (5) verify + cleanup
    for (size_t i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
        if (h_out[i] != 3.0f) { printf("mismatch at %zu: %f\n", i, h_out[i]); break; }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < nStreams; ++i) {
        CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(done[i]));
        CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream[i]));
    }
    CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(t0)); CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(t1));
    CHECK(cudaFree(d_in));  CHECK(cudaFree(d_out));
    CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_in)); CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_out));
    return 0;
}
```

# 查 compute capability / deviceOverlap：

```

## 三、要真正重叠的要点

- **pinned memory 是硬前提**：`cudaMallocHost` / `cudaHostAlloc`。pageable `malloc` 会让 `cudaMemcpyAsync` 变同步、零重叠。
- **一个 chunk 的三步放同一 stream**：H2D → kernel → D2H 自动按序，不同 stream 的 chunk 之间才并发。这样 stream[i] 做 D2H 时，stream[j] 可做 H2D/kernel。
- **double buffering（乒乓）**：若在循环中复用同一段 device/host buffer，需用 `cudaStreamWaitEvent(next_stream, done[prev])` 保证上一轮用完再覆写。
- **吞吐关键**：device 需支持同时 copy+execute；H2D 与 D2H 是否共享/独立 copy engine 决定 H2D 与 D2H 能否彼此重叠（官方博客 C1060 单拷贝引擎 vs C2050 双拷贝引擎的对比）。
- **避免默认流**：库代码用默认流会阻止调用方把传输与 kernel 重叠；用 non-blocking stream 或 per-thread default stream。
- **计时**：`cudaEventRecord(start, stream)` / `cudaEventRecord(stop, stream)` + `cudaEventSynchronize` + `cudaEventElapsedTime`（官方示例）。

| pinned 分配 | 官方推荐 `cudaMallocHost()` |

仅凭已有知识，我可以给出如下回答（未经检索核对，标注不确定处）：

**核心思路**：昇腾 AscendCL 的运行时接口是异步的。要让"数据传输与计算重叠"，需要把拷贝和 kernel 执行放到不同的 stream 上，并通过 event 做依赖同步，避免用 `aclrtSynchronizeStream` 之类的全局同步把重叠打断。

**我记忆中涉及的接口**：
- Stream：`aclrtCreateStream(aclrtStream *stream)`、`aclrtCreateStreamWithConfig(aclrtStream *stream, uint32_t priority, uint32_t flag)`、`aclrtDestroyStream`、`aclrtSynchronizeStream`、`aclrtSynchronizeStreamWithTimeout`。
- 异步拷贝：`aclrtMemcpyAsync(void *dst, size_t destMax, const void *src, size_t count, aclrtMemcpyKind kind, aclrtStream stream)`。`kind` 取值如 `ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_DEVICE`、`ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST`、`ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_DEVICE`、`ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_HOST`。异步拷贝必须绑定一个 stream，拷贝会以流序方式执行。
- Event：`aclrtCreateEvent(aclrtEvent *event)`、`aclrtCreateEventWithFlag(aclrtEvent *event, uint32_t flag)`（flag 如 `ACL_EVENT_BLOCKING_SYNC`）、`aclrtRecordEvent(event, stream)`、`aclrtStreamWaitEvent(stream, event)`、`aclrtSynchronizeEvent`、`aclrtDestroyEvent`。record 把事件插入 stream 队列，wait 让另一个 stream 等待该事件，从而建立跨流依赖。
- 内存：需要 `aclrtMalloc`/`aclrtMallocHost` 分配，Host 侧要能真正异步拷贝通常需要 pinned memory（`aclrtMallocHost` 或 `ACL_MEM_MALLOC_HUGE_FIRST` 之类）。

**典型模式（我记忆中的做法）**：
1. 创建两条（或更多）stream。
2. 把输入分块（double buffering）。
3. 在 stream A 上 `aclrtMemcpyAsync` 拷贝第 i 块 H2D；record event e_i。
4. 计算 kernel 所在 stream B `aclrtStreamWaitEvent(B, e_i)`，再执行 kernel。
5. 反向 D2H 同理用 event 同步。
6. 最后对相关 stream 做 `aclrtSynchronizeStream`。

**我不确定 / 需要检索核对的地方**：
- `aclrtMemcpyAsync` 的精确参数顺序和返回类型（是否 `aclError`）。
- 在哪些硬件/版本上 H2D 异步拷贝是否真的能与其他 stream 的计算并发（是否受 copy engine 数量、SDMA vs 计算流影响）。
- 是否有 `aclrtMemcpyAsyncWithCondition` / `aclrtStreamWaitEvent` 的准确语义和版本引入。
- 创建 stream 时 flag（如 `ACL_STREAM_NON_BLOCKING`）是否存在、名称是否准确。
- event 复用（`aclrtCreateEventWithFlag` + `aclrtRecordEvent` 重置语义）细节。
- 是否需要 `aclrtSetDevice`、context 前置，以及多 stream 是否共享同一 context。
- CANN 具体版本号与 soc_version（如 310P/910B）对重叠能力的影响。
- 官方文档的确切章节与 URL。

**标题**: aclrtMemcpyAsync-内存管理-运行时管理-AscendCL API（C&C++）-应用开发接口-CANN商用版8.0.RC1开发文档-昇腾社区

# aclrtMemcpyAsync

#### 函数功能

实现内存复制，异步接口。

#### 约束说明

- 调用本接口进行内存复制时，源地址和目的地址都必须64字节对齐。
- 该接口是异步接口，调用接口成功仅表示任务下发成功，不表示任务执行成功。调用该接口后，需调用同步等待接口（例如，[aclrtSynchronizeStream](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0070.html)）确保内存复制的任务已执行完成，否则可能会导致训练或推理等业务异常、Device断链掉卡等未知情况。
- 若调用本接口传入的kind为ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_DEVICE或ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST，并且Host内存不是通过aclrtMallocHost申请得到的，本接口不会报错，但是在实际执行到该任务时会发生不可预知的错误。
- 本接口不支持异步Host内的内存复制功能，因此传入的kind为ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_HOST时，任务下发成功，但系统内部处理该任务时会返回失败。
- 在Atlas 200/300/500 推理产品上：
  
  Ascend RC形态下，在板端运行应用时，选择涉及Host的内存复制类型后，系统内部会默认使用Device内的内存复制。
- 在Atlas 推理系列产品上：
  
  如果执行Device间的内存复制，需先调用[aclrtDeviceCanAccessPeer](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0102.html)接口查询两个Device间是否支持内存复制、调用[aclrtDeviceEnablePeerAccess](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0103.html)接口使用两个Device间的内存复制，再调用本接口进行内存复制。
- 在Atlas 训练系列产品上，如果执行Device间的内存复制，需先调用[aclrtDeviceCanAccessPeer](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0102.html)接口查询两个Device间是否支持内存复制、调用[aclrtDeviceEnablePeerAccess](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0103.html)接口使用两个Device间的内存复制，再调用本接口进行内存复制。
- 在Atlas A2训练系列产品/Atlas 800I A2推理产品上，如果执行Device间的内存复制，需先调用[aclrtDeviceCanAccessPeer](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0102.html)接口查询两个Device间是否支持内存复制、调用[aclrtDeviceEnablePeerAccess](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0103.html)接口使用两个Device间的内存复制，再调用本接口进行内存复制。

#### 函数原型

**[aclError](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_1276.html) aclrtMemcpyAsync(void *dst, size_t destMax, const void *src, size_t count, aclrtMemcpyKind kind, [aclrtStream](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_1286.html) stream)**

#### 参数说明

参数名

输入/输出

说明

dst

输入

目的内存地址指针。

destMax

输入

目的内存地址的最大内存长度，单位Byte。

src

输入

源内存地址指针。

count

输入

内存复制的长度，单位Byte。

kind

输入

内存复制的类型。

```
typedef enum aclrtMemcpyKind {
ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_HOST, // Host内的内存复制
ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_DEVICE, // Host到Device的内存复制
ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST, // Device到Host的内存复制
ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_DEVICE, // Device内或Device间的内存复制
} aclrtMemcpyKind;
```

stream

输入

指定stream。

#### 返回值说明

返回0表示成功，返回其它值表示失败。

#### 参考资源

接口调用示例，参见[数据传输](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/80RC1/developmentguide/appdevg/aclcppdevg/aclcppdevg_000010.html)。

# aclrtCreateEvent

#### 函数功能

创建一个Event，创建出来的Event可用于统计两个Event之间的耗时、多Stream场景下的同步等待等场景。

#### 约束说明

调用本接口创建Event后，后续调用[aclrtRecordEvent](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0083.html)接口时，系统内部才会申请Event资源，因此会受Event数量的限制，Event达到上限后，系统内部会等待资源释放。

不同型号的硬件支持的Event数量不同，如下表所示：

型号

单个Device支持的Event最大数

Atlas 200/300/500 推理产品

Atlas 推理系列产品

1023

Atlas 200I/500 A2 推理产品

Atlas 训练系列产品

Atlas A2 训练系列产品/Atlas 800I A2 推理产品

65535

#### 函数原型

**[aclError](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_1345.html) aclrtCreateEvent([aclrtEvent](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_1356.html) *event)**

#### 参数说明

参数名

输入/输出

说明

event

输出

Event的指针。

#### 返回值说明

返回0表示成功，返回其他值表示失败。

#### 相关接口

您也可以使用[aclrtCreateEventWithFlag](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0080.html)或[aclrtCreateEventExWithFlag](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/apiref/appdevgapi/aclcppdevg_03_0081.html)接口创建一个带标识的Event，不同标识的Event用于不同的功能。

#### 参考资源

接口调用流程及调用示例，参见[Event的同步等待示例代码](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/devguide/appdevg/aclcppdevg/aclcppdevg_000013.html#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002115676480__section6442154118396)、[Stream间任务的同步等待接口调用流程及示例代码](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/800alpha003/devguide/appdevg/aclcppdevg/aclcppdevg_000013.html#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002115676480__section4124501625)。
