**标题**: Installing the NVIDIA Container Toolkit — NVIDIA Container Toolkit

Back to top

# Installing the NVIDIA Container Toolkit[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#installing-the-nvidia-container-toolkit "Permalink to this headline")

## Installation[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#installation "Permalink to this headline")

### Prerequisites[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#prerequisites "Permalink to this headline")

1. Review the [platform support documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/supported-platforms.html).
2. Install the NVIDIA GPU driver for your Linux distribution. NVIDIA recommends installing the driver by using the package manager for your distribution. For information about installing the driver with a package manager, refer to the [*NVIDIA Driver Installation Quickstart Guide*](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/tesla-installation-notes/index.html). Alternatively, you can install the driver by [downloading](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/) a `.run` installer.

Note

There is a [known issue](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/troubleshooting.html#containers-losing-access-to-gpus-with-error-failed-to-initialize-nvml-unknown-error) on systems where `systemd` cgroup drivers are used that cause containers to lose access to requested GPUs when `systemctl daemon reload` is run. Refer to the troubleshooting documentation for more information.

### With `apt`: Ubuntu, Debian[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#with-apt-ubuntu-debian "Permalink to this headline")

Note

These instructions [should work](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/supported-platforms.html) for any Debian-derived distribution.

1. Install the prerequisites for the instructions below:
   
   ```
   $ sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates \
      curl \
      gnupg2
   ```
2. Configure the production repository:
   
   ```
   $ curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg \
     && curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | \
       sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | \
       sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list
   ```
   
   Optionally, configure the repository to use experimental packages:
   
   ```
   $ sudo sed -i -e '/experimental/ s/^#//g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list
   ```
3. Update the packages list from the repository:
   
   ```
   $ sudo apt-get update
   ```
4. Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit packages:
   
   ```
   $ export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
     sudo apt-get install -y \
         nvidia-container-toolkit=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-base=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container-tools=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container1=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
   ```

### With `dnf`: RHEL/CentOS, Fedora, Amazon Linux[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#with-dnf-rhel-centos-fedora-amazon-linux "Permalink to this headline")

Note

These instructions [should work](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/supported-platforms.html) for many RPM-based distributions.

1. Install the prerequisites for the instructions below:
   
   ```
   $ sudo dnf install -y \
      curl
   ```
2. Configure the production repository:
   
   ```
   $ curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo | \
     sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo
   ```
   
   Optionally, configure the repository to use experimental packages:
   
   ```
   $ sudo dnf config-manager --enable nvidia-container-toolkit-experimental
   ```
3. Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit packages:
   
   ```
   $ export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
     sudo dnf install -y \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-base-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container-tools-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container1-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
   ```

### With `zypper`: OpenSUSE, SLE[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#with-zypper-opensuse-sle "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the production repository:
   
   ```
   $ sudo zypper ar https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo
   ```
   
   Optionally, configure the repository to use experimental packages:
   
   ```
   $ sudo zypper modifyrepo --enable nvidia-container-toolkit-experimental
   ```
2. Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit packages:
   
   ```
   $  export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
      sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys install -y \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         nvidia-container-toolkit-base-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container-tools-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
         libnvidia-container1-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
   ```

## Configuration[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuration "Permalink to this headline")

### Prerequisites[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#id1 "Permalink to this headline")

- You installed a supported container engine (Docker, Containerd, CRI-O, Podman).
- You installed the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

### Managing `config.toml`[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#managing-config-toml "Permalink to this headline")

The `nvidia-ctk config` command reads `/etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml` by default. Without `--in-place` or `--output`, the command writes the updated configuration to standard output and does not change the source file.

Preview a change before you write it to the host:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.log-level=debug
```

Review the output. Then, add `--in-place` to update the source file:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config --in-place \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.log-level=debug
```

You can specify `--set` more than once. The following command configures a log level and a log file in one update:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config --in-place \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.log-level=debug \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.debug=/var/log/nvidia-container-runtime.log
```

For a list setting, separate elements with a colon. The following command makes `crun` the first low-level runtime candidate and retains `runc` as a fallback:

```
$ sudo nvidia-ctk config --in-place \
    --set nvidia-container-runtime.runtimes=crun:runc
```

When the same key appears more than once, the last value takes effect. The command preserves existing settings when you change a different setting. Review the preview before every production update, especially when you use a custom file with `--config-file`.

### Configuring Docker[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-docker "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker
   ```
   
   The `nvidia-ctk` command modifies the `/etc/docker/daemon.json` file on the host. The file is updated so that Docker can use the NVIDIA Container Runtime.
2. Restart the Docker daemon:
   
   ```
   $ sudo systemctl restart docker
   ```

#### Rootless Mode[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#rootless-mode "Permalink to this headline")

To configure the container runtime for Docker running in [Rootless mode](https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/rootless/), follow these steps:

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker --config=$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json
   ```
2. Restart the Rootless Docker daemon:
   
   ```
   $ systemctl --user restart docker
   ```
3. Configure `/etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml` by using the `sudo nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk config --set nvidia-container-cli.no-cgroups --in-place
   ```

### Configuring containerd (for Kubernetes)[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-containerd-for-kubernetes "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=containerd
   ```
   
   By default, the `nvidia-ctk` command creates a `/etc/containerd/conf.d/99-nvidia.toml` drop-in config file and modifies (or creates) the `/etc/containerd/config.toml` file to ensure that the `imports` config option is updated accordingly. The drop-in file ensures that containerd can use the NVIDIA Container Runtime.
2. Restart containerd:
   
   ```
   $ sudo systemctl restart containerd
   ```

### Configuring containerd (for nerdctl)[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-containerd-for-nerdctl "Permalink to this headline")

No additional configuration is needed. You can run `nerdctl run --gpus=all`, with or without root. You do not need to run the `nvidia-ctk` command mentioned above for Kubernetes.

Refer to the [nerdctl documentation](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/blob/main/docs/gpu.md) for more information.

### Configuring CRI-O[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-cri-o "Permalink to this headline")

1. Configure the container runtime by using the `nvidia-ctk` command:
   
   ```
   $ sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=crio
   ```
   
   By default, the `nvidia-ctk` command creates a `/etc/crio/conf.d/99-nvidia.toml` drop-in config file. The drop-in file ensures that CRI-O can use the NVIDIA Container Runtime.
2. Restart the CRI-O daemon:
   
   ```
   $ sudo systemctl restart crio
   ```

### Configuring Podman[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#configuring-podman "Permalink to this headline")

For Podman, NVIDIA recommends using [CDI](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/cdi-support.html) for accessing NVIDIA devices in containers.

## Next Steps[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html#next-steps "Permalink to this headline")

## PyTorch

PyTorch is an optimized tensor library for deep learning using GPUs and CPUs. Automatic differentiation is done with a tape-based system at both a functional and neural network layer level. This functionality brings a high level of flexibility and speed as a deep learning framework and provides accelerated NumPy-like functionality. NGC Containers are the easiest way to get started with PyTorch. The PyTorch NGC Container comes with all dependencies included, providing an easy place to start developing common applications, such as conversational AI, natural language processing (NLP), recommenders, and computer vision.

The PyTorch NGC Container is optimized for GPU acceleration, and contains a validated set of libraries that enable and optimize GPU performance. This container also contains software for accelerating ETL (DALI, Training (cuDNN, NCCL), and Inference (TensorRT) workloads.

### Prerequisites

Using the PyTorch NGC Container requires the host system to have the following installed:

- Docker Engine
- NVIDIA GPU Drivers
- NVIDIA Container Toolkit

For supported versions, see the Framework Containers Support Matrix and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit Documentation.

No other installation, compilation, or dependency management is required. *It is not necessary to install the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit.*

The PyTorch NGC Container is optimized to run on NVIDIA DGX Foundry and NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD managed by NVIDIA Base Command Platform. Please refer to the Base Command Platform User Guide to learn more about running workloads on BCP clusters.

### Running PyTorch Using Docker

To run a container, issue the appropriate command as explained in the Running A Container chapter in the *NVIDIA Containers For Deep Learning Frameworks User’s Guide* and specify the registry, repository, and tags. For more information about using NGC, refer to the NGC Container User Guide.

If you have Docker 19.03 or later, a typical command to launch the container is:

```
docker run --gpus all -it --rm nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3
```

If you have Docker 19.02 or earlier, a typical command to launch the container is:

```
nvidia-docker run -it --rm -v nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3
```

Where:

- `xx.xx` is the container version. For example, `22.01`.

PyTorch is run by importing it as a Python module:

```
$ python
>>> import torch
>>> print(torch.cuda.is_available())
True
```

See **`/workspace/README.md`** inside the container for information on getting started and customizing your PyTorch image.

You might want to pull in data and model descriptions from locations outside the container for use by PyTorch. To accomplish this, the easiest method is to mount one or more host directories as Docker bind mounts. For example:

```
docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v local_dir:container_dir nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:xx.xx-py3
```

### Running PyTorch Using Base Command Platform

Jobs using the Pytorch NGC Container on Base Command Platform clusters can be launched either by using the NGC CLI tool or by using the Base Command Platform Web UI. To use the NGC CLI tool, configure the Base Command Platform user, team, organization, and cluster information using the `ngc config` command as described here.

An example command to launch the container on a single-GPU instance is:

```
ngc batch run --name "My-1-GPU-pytorch-job" --instance dgxa100.80g.1.norm --commandline "sleep infinity" --result /results --image "nvidia/pytorch:22.08-py3"
```

An example command to launch a two-node distributed job with a total runtime of 10 minutes (600 seconds) is:

```
ngc batch run --name "My-2-node-pytorch-job" --preempt RUNONCE --total-runtime 600s --instance dgxa100.80g.8.norm --commandline "sleep infinity" --result /results --array-type "PYTORCH" --replicas "2" --image "nvidia/pytorch:22.08-py3"
```

The PyTorch container includes JupyterLab in it and can be invoked as part of the job command for easy access to the container and exploring the capabilities of the container. Example to invoke JupyterLab as part of the job run on a single DGX node is:

```
ngc batch run --name "My-1-node-pytorch-jupyterlab-job" --instance dgxa100.80g.8.norm --commandline "jupyter lab --allow-root --ip=* --port=8888 --no-browser --NotebookApp.token='' --NotebookApp.allow_origin='*' --notebook-dir=/ & sleep infinity" --result /results --image "nvidia/pytorch:22.08-py3"
```

### What Is In This Container?

For the full list of contents, see the PyTorch Container Release Notes.

This container image contains the complete source of the version of PyTorch in /opt/pytorch. It is pre-built and installed in Conda default environment (/opt/conda/lib/python3.8/site-packages/torch/) in the container image. Visit pytorch.org to learn more about PyTorch.

The NVIDIA PyTorch Container is optimized for use with NVIDIA GPUs, and contains the following software for GPU acceleration:

- CUDA
- cuBLAS
- NVIDIA cuDNN
- NVIDIA NCCL (optimized for NVLink)
- NVIDIA Data Loading Library (DALI)
- TensorRT
- Torch-TensorRT

The software stack in this container has been validated for compatibility, and does not require any additional installation or compilation from the end user. This container can help accelerate your deep learning workflow from end to end.

Link to Open Source Code

For the latest Release Notes, see the PyTorch Release Notes.

For a full list of the supported software and specific versions that come packaged with this framework based on the container image, see the Frameworks Support Matrix.

For more information about PyTorch, including tutorials, documentation, and examples, see:

- PyTorch website
- PyTorch project

> *"For comprehensive and up-to-date driver compatibility information, please refer to: the NVIDIA CUDA Compatibility Guide, CUDA Toolkit Release Notes, and NVIDIA Drivers Download."*

Verify the exact minimum build number in the [CUDA Toolkit Release Notes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html) before deployment, as it is not printed on this support matrix page.

# 用 NGC 镜像跑带 GPU 的 PyTorch 容器

## 前提（宿主侧）
需要已安装：Docker Engine、NVIDIA GPU 驱动、nvidia-container-toolkit。**不需要在宿主安装 CUDA Toolkit**（NGC 镜像内已含完整 CUDA 栈）。（来源：NGC PyTorch 页 Prerequisites）

## 1. 安装 nvidia-container-toolkit（Ubuntu/Debian，apt）

`nvidia-docker2` 旧包已被 nvidia-container-toolkit 取代。官方步骤（docs.nvidia.com install-guide）：

```bash
# 1. 前置包
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  ca-certificates curl gnupg2

# 2. 配置仓库
curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg \
  && curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | \
    sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | \
    sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list

# 3. 安装（官方当前版本 1.20.1-1）
sudo apt-get update
export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.20.1-1
sudo apt-get install -y \
    nvidia-container-toolkit=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
    nvidia-container-toolkit-base=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
    libnvidia-container-tools=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
    libnvidia-container1=${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
```

## 2. 配置 Docker 运行时

```bash
sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker   # 修改 /etc/docker/daemon.json
sudo systemctl restart docker
```

## 3. 运行 NGC PyTorch 容器（需要 `--gpus`）

Docker 19.03+ 用原生 `--gpus` 标志（不再需要 `nvidia-docker` wrapper）：

```bash
docker run --gpus all -it --rm nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.08-py3
```

- `26.08-py3` 为 NGC 目录当前 latest tag（抓取时）
- 指定设备：`--gpus '"device=0,1"'`
- 挂载数据：`-v local_dir:container_dir`
- Docker ≤ 19.02 才用旧的 `nvidia-docker run ...`

容器内验证：

```bash
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"   # 应输出 True
nvidia-smi
```

## 版本对应关系
- nvidia-container-toolkit：官方安装文档锁定 `1.20.1-1`
- NGC PyTorch 最新镜像 `26.08-py3`：PyTorch `2.14.0a0+4fdf77b940`，基于 **CUDA 13.4.1**（cuDNN 9.25、NCCL 2.30.7、TensorRT 11.2.1.2，容器内 Ubuntu 24.04）

## 来源
- https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html
- https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/orgs/nvidia/containers/pytorch

prior.text:
仅凭已有知识，我可以这样回答"自定义 CUDA 算子结果与 CPU/PyTorch 参考不一致，如何逐层/逐元素比对定位数值精度问题"：

**通用定位流程（无需检索即可给出）：**
1. **确认输入一致**：保证 CUDA 与 CPU 路径喂入完全相同的张量（相同 dtype、shape、contiguity、随机种子），先用 `.clone()` 固定输入。
2. **逐元素比对**：把两边输出放到同一设备比较，如 `torch.testing.assert_close(cuda_out, cpu_out, rtol=..., atol=...)`（旧版用 `torch.allclose`）。失败时用 `diff = (a-b).abs()`、`torch.isclose(a, b, rtol, atol)` 得到布尔掩码，配合 `torch.nonzero(~mask)` 找到第一处不一致的索引，打印该位置的输入与中间值。
3. **缩小范围（逐层/逐算子分解）**：对复合算子逐个子操作（如 dequant→GEMM→激活）分别与 PyTorch 原语对比，用二分法定位首个发散的子算子；对单个 kernel，在 kernel 内部加 `printf` 或把中间结果写回全局内存比对。
4. **常见精度根因**：浮点累加顺序（归约顺序不同导致非位级一致，属正常，应设容差而非要求 bitwise 相等）、TF32（Ampere+ 默认对 FP32 matmul 启用，`torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False` 关闭）、cuDNN benchmark 选到不同算法（`torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True`）、half/bf16 与 fp32 混用、非确定性原子加（atomicAdd 顺序）、越界读写/竞态（用 `compute-sanitizer` 工具，含 memcheck/racecheck/initcheck/synccheck 子工具）、未同步就读结果。
5. **Ulp 级分析**：`torch.testing` 的报错会给出 max abs/rel diff；也可用 numpy `float32` 位级比较。

**不确定处**：
- `torch.testing.assert_close` 各 dtype 的默认 rtol/atol 精确数值表（记得 fp32 约 rtol=1.3e-6, atol=1e-5，但不完全确定）。
- `compute-sanitizer` 的完整命令行参数与输出解读细节。
- TF32 在新版本 PyTorch 中 API 是否有变动（如 `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision` 新接口）。
- PyTorch 官方关于数值精度/确定性的文档具体章节与 URL。

接下来按协议执行检索核实。

**标题**: torch.testing — PyTorch 2.14 documentation

# torch.testing#

# torch.testing#
Created On: May 07, 2021 | Last Updated On: Jun 10, 2025

torch.testing.assert_close(*actual*, *expected*, ***, *allow_subclasses=True*, *rtol=None*, *atol=None*, *equal_nan=False*, *check_device=True*, *check_dtype=True*, *check_layout=True*, *check_stride=False*, *msg=None*)[[source]](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/v2.14.0/torch/testing/_comparison.py#L1415)#

Asserts that `actual` and `expected` are close.

If `actual` and `expected` are strided, non-quantized, real-valued, and finite, they are considered close if

∣actual−expected∣≤atol+rtol⋅∣expected∣\lvert \text{actual} - \text{expected} \rvert \le \texttt{atol} + \texttt{rtol} \cdot \lvert \text{expected} \rvert

Non-finite values (`-inf` and `inf`) are only considered close if and only if they are equal. `NaN`’s are only considered equal to each other if `equal_nan` is `True`.

In addition, they are only considered close if they have the same

- `device` (if `check_device` is `True`),
- `dtype` (if `check_dtype` is `True`),
- `layout` (if `check_layout` is `True`), and
- stride (if `check_stride` is `True`).

If either `actual` or `expected` is a meta tensor, only the attribute checks will be performed.

If `actual` and `expected` are sparse (either having COO, CSR, CSC, BSR, or BSC layout), their strided members are checked individually. Indices, namely `indices` for COO, `crow_indices` and `col_indices` for CSR and BSR, or `ccol_indices` and `row_indices` for CSC and BSC layouts, respectively, are always checked for equality whereas the values are checked for closeness according to the definition above.

# torch.testing#
If `actual` and `expected` are quantized, they are considered close if they have the same `qscheme()` and the result of `dequantize()` is close according to the definition above.

`actual` and `expected` can be `Tensor`’s or any tensor-or-scalar-likes from which `torch.Tensor`’s can be constructed with `torch.as_tensor()`. Except for Python scalars the input types have to be directly related. In addition, `actual` and `expected` can be `Sequence`")’s or `Mapping`")’s in which case they are considered close if their structure matches and all their elements are considered close according to the above definition.

Note

Python scalars are an exception to the type relation requirement, because their `type()`, i.e. `int`"), `float`"), and `complex`"), is equivalent to the `dtype` of a tensor-like. Thus, Python scalars of different types can be checked, but require `check_dtype=False`.

Parameters:

# torch.testing#
- **actual** (*Any*) – Actual input.
- **expected** (*Any*) – Expected input.
- **allow_subclasses** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default) and except for Python scalars, inputs of directly related types are allowed. Otherwise type equality is required.
- **rtol** (*Optional*[*float*")*]*) – Relative tolerance. If specified `atol` must also be specified. If omitted, default values based on the `dtype` are selected with the below table.
- **atol** (*Optional*[*float*")*]*) – Absolute tolerance. If specified `rtol` must also be specified. If omitted, default values based on the `dtype` are selected with the below table.
- **equal_nan** (*Union*[*bool*")*,* *str*")*]*) – If `True`, two `NaN` values will be considered equal.
- **check_device** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default), asserts that corresponding tensors are on the same `device`. If this check is disabled, tensors on different `device`’s are moved to the CPU before being compared.

# torch.testing#
- **check_dtype** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default), asserts that corresponding tensors have the same `dtype`. If this check is disabled, tensors with different `dtype`’s are promoted to a common `dtype` (according to `torch.promote_types()`) before being compared.
- **check_layout** (*bool*")) – If `True` (default), asserts that corresponding tensors have the same `layout`. If this check is disabled, tensors with different `layout`’s are converted to strided tensors before being compared.
- **check_stride** (*bool*")) – If `True` and corresponding tensors are strided, asserts that they have the same stride.
- **msg** (*OptionalUnion[*[*str*")*, Callable[*[*str*")*],* *str*")*]]]*) – Optional error message to use in case a failure occurs during the comparison. Can also passed as callable in which case it will be called with the generated message and should return the new message.

# torch.testing#
Raises:

# torch.testing#
- **ValueError**") – If no `torch.Tensor` can be constructed from an input.
- **ValueError**") – If only `rtol` or `atol` is specified.
- **AssertionError**") – If corresponding inputs are not Python scalars and are not directly related.
- **AssertionError**") – If `allow_subclasses` is `False`, but corresponding inputs are not Python scalars and have different types.
- **AssertionError**") – If the inputs are `Sequence`")’s, but their length does not match.
- **AssertionError**") – If the inputs are `Mapping`")’s, but their set of keys do not match.
- **AssertionError**") – If corresponding tensors do not have the same `shape`.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_layout` is `True`, but corresponding tensors do not have the same `layout`.

# torch.testing#
- **AssertionError**") – If only one of corresponding tensors is quantized.
- **AssertionError**") – If corresponding tensors are quantized, but have different `qscheme()`’s.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_device` is `True`, but corresponding tensors are not on the same `device`.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_dtype` is `True`, but corresponding tensors do not have the same `dtype`.
- **AssertionError**") – If `check_stride` is `True`, but corresponding strided tensors do not have the same stride.
- **AssertionError**") – If the values of corresponding tensors are not close according to the definition above.

# torch.testing#
The following table displays the default `rtol` and `atol` for different `dtype`’s. In case of mismatching `dtype`’s, the maximum of both tolerances is used.

Note

`assert_close()` is highly configurable with strict default settings. Users are encouraged to `partial()`") it to fit their use case. For example, if an equality check is needed, one might define an `assert_equal` that uses zero tolerances for every `dtype` by default:

```
>>> importfunctools
>>> assert_equal = functools.partial(torch.testing.assert_close, rtol=0, atol=0)
>>> assert_equal(1e-9, 1e-10)
Traceback (most recent call last):
...
AssertionError: Scalars are not equal!

Expected 1e-10 but got 1e-09.
Absolute difference: 9.000000000000001e-10
Relative difference: 9.0
```

Examples

```
>>> # tensor to tensor comparison
>>> expected = torch.tensor([1e0, 1e-1, 1e-2])
>>> actual = torch.acos(torch.cos(expected))
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
```

```
>>> # scalar to scalar comparison
>>> importmath
>>> expected = math.sqrt(2.0)
>>> actual = 2.0 / math.sqrt(2.0)
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
```

```
>>> # numpy array to numpy array comparison
>>> importnumpyasnp
>>> expected = np.array([1e0, 1e-1, 1e-2])
>>> actual = np.arccos(np.cos(expected))
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
```

# torch.testing#
```
>>> # sequence to sequence comparison
>>> importnumpyasnp
>>> # The types of the sequences do not have to match. They only have to have the same
>>> # length and their elements have to match.
>>> expected = [torch.tensor([1.0]), 2.0, np.array(3.0)]
>>> actual = tuple(expected)
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
```

```
>>> # mapping to mapping comparison
>>> fromcollectionsimport OrderedDict
>>> importnumpyasnp
>>> foo = torch.tensor(1.0)
>>> bar = 2.0
>>> baz = np.array(3.0)
>>> # The types and a possible ordering of mappings do not have to match. They only
>>> # have to have the same set of keys and their elements have to match.
>>> expected = OrderedDict([("foo", foo), ("bar", bar), ("baz", baz)])
>>> actual = {"baz": baz, "bar": bar, "foo": foo}
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
```

```
>>> expected = torch.tensor([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
>>> actual = expected.clone()
>>> # By default, directly related instances can be compared
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(torch.nn.Parameter(actual), expected)
>>> # This check can be made more strict with allow_subclasses=False
>>> torch.testing.assert_close(
...     torch.nn.Parameter(actual), expected, allow_subclasses=False
... )

...
TypeError: No comparison pair was able to handle inputs of type
<class 'torch.nn.parameter.Parameter'> and <class 'torch.Tensor'>.

>>> torch.testing.assert_close(actual.numpy(), expected)

TypeError: No comparison pair was able to handle inputs of type <class 'numpy.ndarray'>
and <class 'torch.Tensor'>.
>>> # Exceptions to these rules are Python scalars. They can be checked regardless of
```

# Compute Sanitizer 完整说明（内容提取）

> **截断说明**：⚠️ 原始网页内容在文末"Compute Sanitizer Tool Examples → Example Use of Memcheck → memcheck_demo Output with Memcheck (Release Build)"一节中途被截断（该节描述不完整，后续示例内容缺失）。其余章节内容完整。

---

## 一、简介（Introduction）

### 1.1 关于 Compute Sanitizer
Compute Sanitizer 是包含在 **CUDA toolkit** 中的功能正确性检查套件（functional correctness checking suite），包含多个可执行不同类型检查的工具：

| 子工具 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| **Memcheck** | 精确检测并定位 CUDA 应用中的越界（out of bounds）和未对齐（misaligned）内存访问错误；还可报告 GPU 硬件异常；内存泄漏检测 |
| **Racecheck** | 报告可能导致数据竞争（data races）的共享内存数据访问冒险（hazards） |
| **Initcheck** | 报告 GPU 对全局内存的未初始化访问 |
| **Synccheck** | 报告应用对同步原语（synchronization primitives）的非法使用 |

### 1.2 为什么需要 Compute Sanitizer
CUDA 应用常并行运行数千个线程，内存访问错误和线程排序冒险难以检测、调试耗时。线程数越多，此类错误越多。Compute Sanitizer 套件专为检测这些问题而设计。

### 1.3 如何获取
随 CUDA toolkit 一同安装。

---

## 二、命令行用法

### 2.1 基本调用方式

```bash
compute-sanitizer [options] app_name [app_options]
```

各子工具的典型用法：

```bash
# Memcheck（默认工具，可省略 --tool）
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]

# Racecheck
compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]

# Initcheck
compute-sanitizer --tool initcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]

# Synccheck
compute-sanitizer --tool synccheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

### 2.2 通用命令行选项（Table 1，主要选项）

选项形式通常为 `--option value`；用 `--` 可终止选项列表，其后内容视为被测应用及其参数。部分选项有单字符短形式（用单连字符，如 `-h`），短形式选项不接受值。

| 选项 | 取值 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `check-device-heap` | yes, no | yes | 启用设备堆分配检查（错误检查和泄漏检查均适用） |
| `check-bulk-copy` | yes, no | yes | 启用 Hopper 上 PTX `cp.async.bulk` 指令相关检查 |
| `check-exit-code` | yes, no | yes | 检查应用退出码，非 0 时报错 |
| `check-optix-leaks` | N/A | disabled | 检测并报告在 `OptixDeviceContextDestroy` 时创建但未销毁的 OptiX 资源 |
| `check-warpgroup-mma` | yes, no | yes | 启用对 PTX `wgmma` 指令的 memcheck 和 synccheck 支持（需要 sm_90a） |
| `coredump-behavior` | full, exit | full | 生成 CUDA coredump 后目标应用的行为：full=中止并生成 CPU coredump；exit=退出但不生成 CPU coredump |
| `coredump-name` | {filename} | N/A | 指定生成的 coredump 文件名 |
| `demangle` | full, simple, no | full | 启用设备函数名反修饰（demangling） |
| `destroy-on-device-error` | context, kernel | context | 控制遇到内存访问错误时应用如何继续（见 Error Actions） |
| `dump-kernel-launches` | N/A | disabled | 转储所有 kernel launch 信息（名称、启动序号、维度、流、主机回溯），含过滤状态 |
| `error-exitcode` | {number} | 0 | 应用成功但工具检测到错误时 Compute Sanitizer 返回的退出码，便于集成自动化测试 |
| `force-blocking-launches` | N/A | disabled | 强制所有主机端 kernel launch 串行执行；启用后报告的错误数量和精度会下降 |
| `force-synchronization-limit` | {number} | 0 | 流达到指定数量的 launch 未同步时强制同步，可降低工具内存占用但影响性能 |
| `generate-coredump` | N/A | disabled | 遇到第一个错误时生成 coredump 并停止程序执行 |

## 三、Memcheck 工具

### 3.1 功能定义
运行时错误检测工具，可精确检测并报告 CUDA 应用中对全局（global）、局部（local）和共享（shared）内存的越界和未对齐访问；可检测设备硬件报告的错误信息；可检测并报告应用中的内存泄漏。

### 3.2 可检测的错误类型（Table 7）

| 错误名称 | 描述 | 位置 | 精度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Memory access error** | 全局、局部、共享或全局原子访问的越界或未对齐访问 | Device | 精确（Precise） |
| **Hardware exception** | 硬件错误报告机制报告的错误 | Device | 不精确（Imprecise） |
| **Malloc/Free errors** | CUDA kernel 中错误使用 `malloc()/free()` | Device | 精确 |
| **CUDA API errors** | 应用中 CUDA API 调用返回失败 | Host | 精确 |
| **cudaMalloc memory leaks** | 使用 `cudaMalloc()` 分配但未释放的设备内存 | Host | 精确 |
| **Device Heap Memory Leaks** | 设备代码中用 `malloc()` 分配但未释放的内存 | Device | 不精确 |

**精度说明**：
- **精确错误**：工具可唯一标识并收集全部信息——报告出错线程的 block/thread 坐标、执行访问指令的 PC、访问地址及其大小和类型；若有行号信息还会打印源文件和行号
- **不精确错误**：由硬件错误报告机制报告，无法精确归属到特定线程，很多情况下无法回溯到源文件和行

### 3.3 使用方法
Memcheck 是**默认启用**的工具，也可用 `--tool memcheck` 显式启用。默认查找精确、不精确、malloc/free 和 CUDA API 错误；**设备泄漏报告必须显式启用**（`--leak-check full`）。错误在应用执行完毕后显示。

### 3.4 错误报告解读（Understanding Memcheck Errors）

**1）内存访问错误示例**：

```
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at unaligned_kernel():0x160 in memcheck_demo.cu:6
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x7f6510c00001 is misaligned
```

- 第 1 行：内存段（`__global__`/`__shared__`/`__local__`）、访问类型（read/write）、访问大小（字节）
- 第 2 行：kernel 名、指令偏移、源文件和行号（如可用）
- 第 3 行：出错线程的 thread/block 索引
- 第 4 行：访问的内存地址和错误类型（out of bounds 或 misaligned）

**2）Malloc/Free 错误示例**：

```
========= Malloc/Free error encountered : Double free
```

错误类型包括：
- **Double free**：对已释放的分配再次调用 `free()`
- **Invalid pointer to free**：对非 `malloc()` 返回的指针调用 `free()`
- **Heap corruption**：堆损坏或以意外方式修改堆状态

**3）泄漏错误示例**：

```
========= Leaked 64 bytes at 0x400200200
========= Leaked 16 bytes at 0x4012ffff6 on the device heap
```

在 context 销毁（程序退出、`cudaDeviceReset()`、`cuCtxDestroy()`）时报告未释放的 cudaMalloc 分配和设备堆分配。

**4）CUDA API 错误示例**：

```
========= Program hit invalid copy direction for memcpy (error 21) on CUDA API call to cudaMemcpy.
```

包含 API 调用返回值和 API 函数名。

### 3.5 CUDA API 错误检查
- 支持 CUDA runtime 和 driver API；非零返回值即打印错误消息
- API 错误报告**不会终止应用**，仅提供额外信息

**报告模式**（`--report-api-errors`）：
- **all**：报告所有 CUDA API 错误（含 runtime 隐式调用、内部日志捕获的扩展错误、用户显式调用）
- **extended**（默认）：用户显式调用 + 内部 CUDA 错误日志捕获的扩展错误（类似 `CUDA_LOG_FILE` 行为）
- **explicit**：仅用户显式调用
- **no**：禁用

**不报告的错误**（常用于轮询/状态检查）：
- `cudaErrorNotReady`（`cudaEventQuery`、`cudaStreamQuery`）
- `cudaErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled`（`cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess`）
- `cudaErrorPeerAccessNotEnabled`（`cudaDeviceDisablePeerAccess`）

### 3.6 设备端分配检查
- 检查 kernel 内 `malloc()` 创建的设备堆分配，默认隐式启用，可用 `--check-device-heap no` 禁用
- 报告重复 free、非法指针 free；`malloc()` 失败默认报警告（可用 `--report-device-side-allocation-failure no` 禁用）
- 注意查看设备端回溯以定位 `malloc()/free()` 调用位置

### 3.7 泄漏检查（Leak Checking）
需指定 `--leak-check full` 启用。跟踪通过 CUDA driver 或 runtime API 创建的设备内存分配。

### 3.8 填充（Padding）
- 问题：全局内存缓冲区可能在虚拟地址空间中背靠背分配，第一个缓冲区的溢出访问会落在第二个缓冲区中而未被检测为越界
- `--padding {number}` 自动扩展分配大小，在每个分配后创建填充缓冲区，对填充区域的访问始终视为非法
- 支持 `cudaMalloc` API、`cudaHostAlloc`、`cudaMallocHost`
- **不支持** `cudaHostRegister` 或 CUDA 虚拟内存管理 API
- 注意：会增加设备内存压力，可能导致额外的 CUDA 内存不足错误

### 3.9 流序竞争检测（Stream-ordered race detection）
用 `--track-stream-ordered-races all` 检测流序分配竞争，报告超出生命周期的流序分配访问。两类竞争：
- **Use-before-alloc**（`use-before-alloc`）：分配在被使用前不可用——`cudaMallocAsync` 在流上创建的分配不能在没有先验同步事件的情况下在另一流上使用；也包括分配在可用前被 `cudaFreeAsync` 释放
- **Use-after-free**（`use-after-free`）：释放后使用——`cudaFreeAsync` 在流上释放的分配不能在没有后续同步事件的情况下在另一流上使用

### 3.10 Tensor Core MMA guardrails
在 Blackwell GPU 上，使用 PTX 第 5 代 Tensor Core 指令族（`tcgen05.*`）时，可用 PTXAS 标志 `-g-tmem-access-check` 让汇编器在 TCMMA 指令周围插入 guardrails。在 memcheck 下运行此类程序可报告非法 TCMMA 操作（如 tensor memory 的越界/未对齐访问、relinquish 调用后的分配）。示例报告：

```
========= Tensor Memory column 32 being accessed by instruction tcgen05.ld is not allocated. Columns allocated are: 0-31.
```

## 四、Racecheck 工具

### 4.1 功能定义
运行时共享内存数据访问冒险检测器，主要用于识别使用共享内存（`__shared__`）的 CUDA 应用中的内存访问竞争条件。当前**仅支持检测片上共享内存访问**。

### 4.2 什么是冒险（Hazards）
两个线程访问同一内存位置导致基于访问相对顺序的非确定性行为。竞争条件表现为间歇性应用故障，或在不同 GPU 上运行时故障。三种典型冒险：

- **WAW（Write-After-Write）**：两线程写同一位置，结果值取决于两访问的相对顺序
- **WAR（Write-After-Read）**：一个读一个写，写线程排在读线程之前，读线程未读到原始值
- **RAW（Read-After-Write）**：一个读一个写，读线程在写线程提交前读取了值

### 4.3 使用方法

```bash
compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

消除建议：
- WAW：修改程序使同一位置不发生多重写入
- RAW/WAR：使读写位置确定性排序，CUDA kernel 中可在两次访问间插入 `__syncthreads()`；warp 内线程间竞争可用 `__syncwarp()`

> ⚠️ 注意：racecheck **不执行任何内存访问错误检查**，建议先运行 memcheck 确保应用无错误。

### 4.4 报告模式（`--racecheck-report`）
- **Hazard reports（冒险报告）**：单个冒险的详细信息，字节级精确，表示影响该共享内存字节的两线程冲突访问
- **Analysis reports（分析报告）**（默认）：事后分析报告集，通过分析多个冒险报告和检查设备状态生成

### 4.5 分析报告解读
示例：

```
========= WARNING: Race reported between Write access at RAW()+0xf0 in raceGroupBasic.cu:40
=========     and Read access at RAW()+0x280 in raceGroupBasic:46 [4 hazards]
```

- 首个词为严重级别（此例 WARNING）
- 包含访问类型（Read/Write）、kernel 名与偏移、文件名行号（如有）、参与竞争的其他位置、该竞争的 hazard 数量
- 每份分析报告至少包含一行写访问

### 4.6 冒险报告解读
示例：

```
========= ERROR: Potential WAW hazard detected at __shared__ 0x0 in block (0,0,0) :
=========     Write Thread (0,0,0) at WAW()+0x2f0 in raceWAW.cu:20
=========     Write Thread (1,0,0) at WAW()+0x2f0 in raceWAW.cu:20
=========     Current Value : 1, Incoming Value : 2
```

- 第 1 行：严重级别、冒险类型（WAW/WAR/RAW）、共享内存地址（字节级精确）、block 索引
- 第 2、3 行：两个竞争线程的详细信息（按时间顺序排列：先发生的在前）
- 第 4 行（部分类型有）：WAW 或 WAR 时显示 Current Value（第一线程写入后的值）和 Incoming Value（第二线程将写入的值）

### 4.7 严重级别（Severity Levels）
默认只显示 WARNING 和 ERROR 级别，可用 `--print-level` 设置最低报告级别：

- **INFO**：最低级别，对程序执行无影响的 hazard，仍建议消除
- **WARNING**：编程模型冒险，但可能是程序员有意为之（如基于线程成组推进假设的 warp 级编程）；初学者遇到应视为冒险源
- **ERROR**：最高级别，极可能导致数据访问竞争，务必检查

> ⚠️ 重要提示：在现代 GPU 架构上，不能无条件假设 warp 内线程锁步执行（该假设仅适用于 Volta 之前的 Kepler/Maxwell/Pascal）。从旧架构移植应用时必须修复无显式同步的 warp 同步编程警告，可使用 `__syncwarp()` 内建函数或 Cooperative Groups API。

### 4.8 其他 Racecheck 能力
- **`cuda::barrier` 支持**：Ampere 及更新 GPU。若编译器少报 barrier 数量，会警告 "Detected overflow of tracked cuda::barrier structures"，可用 `--num-cuda-barriers` 解决
- **异步拷贝支持**：支持 compute capability 8.0 引入的全局到共享内存异步拷贝（`cuda::memcpy_async` / PTX `cp.async`）竞争检测，可检测在必需的 commit/wait 前访问异步拷贝目标的情况（hazard 报告带 `(invalid memcpy_async synchronization)` 标记）；可用 `--racecheck-memcpy-async no` 禁用
- **Cluster 进入/退出竞争检测**：检测无适当 cluster 范围同步的远程共享内存访问：
  1. **Late entry race**：目标 block 尚未进入时访问其共享内存（报告 "Address ... is located in a block that might not have entered yet"）
  2. **Early exit race**：目标 block 退出前无适当同步即访问（报告 "might have already exited"）
- **同步跟踪**：`--racecheck-trace-sync yes` 记录同步操作日志（自动设置级别为 INFO），支持 `syncwarp`、`barrier`、`cuda::barrier`、`cluster barrier`、`asynchronous bulk copy`。`syncwarp` 还会打印每个线程的掩码，便于调试掩码错误或线程缺失导致的挂起
- **死锁检测**：`--racecheck-deadlock-timeout n`（毫秒，默认 0=禁用；过小值可能误报），当前支持 `cuda::barriers` 死锁；配合 `--racecheck-continue-on-deadlock no` 可在死锁时终止应用

---

## 五、Initcheck 工具

### 5.1 功能定义
运行时未初始化设备内存访问检测器，可识别未经设备端写入或 CUDA memcpy/memset API 初始化即被访问的设备内存。

### 5.2 使用方法

```bash
compute-sanitizer --tool initcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

> ⚠️ 注意：initcheck **不执行任何内存访问错误检查**，建议先运行 memcheck。

### 5.3 地址空间选择
- 默认只检查设备**全局内存**的未初始化访问
- `--initcheck-address-space shared`：改查共享内存
- `--initcheck-address-space all`：两种地址空间都查

共享内存未初始化读取报告示例：

```
========= Uninitialized __shared__ memory read of size 4 bytes
=========     at KernelSharedError()+0x1a0 in uninitialized_shared.cu:7
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x0
```

### 5.4 未使用内存检测
用 `--track-unused-memory` 启用。报告示例：

```
=========  Unused __shared__ memory in allocation of size 100 bytes in block (0,0,0)
=========     Not written 80 bytes at offset 0x14 (0x14)
=========     These unused bytes represent 80% of the shared memory.
```

报告包含分配地址和大小、未使用字节数及位置（不连续时为范围）。调节选项：
- `--unused-memory-threshold`：报告的最低百分比阈值（如设为 81 以上可抑制上面示例）
- `--unused-shared-memory-report-limit`：每次 launch 的未使用共享内存报告上限，默认 32

> ⚠️ 注意填充（padding）：分配大小可能大于 kernel 中指定的大小，可能导致无法据以行动的未使用内存报告。

---

## 六、Synccheck 工具

### 6.1 功能定义
运行时工具，识别 CUDA 应用是否正确使用同步原语，特别是 `__syncthreads()` 和 `__syncwarp()` 内建函数及其 Cooperative Groups API 对应物。

### 6.2 使用方法

```bash
compute-sanitizer --tool synccheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

> ⚠️ 注意：synccheck **不执行任何内存访问错误检查**，建议先运行 memcheck。

### 6.3 报告解读
每个违规生成一份报告，标识违规源位置和分类。示例：

```
========= Barrier error detected. Divergent thread(s) in warp
=========     at ThreadDivergence(int *, int)+0xf0 in divergence.cu:79
=========     by thread (37,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
```

报告以 "Barrier error detected." 开头，后接错误分类：

- **Divergent thread(s) in block**：对当前架构上不支持发散的 barrier，检测到 block 内线程发散（如在条件代码中使用 `__syncthreads()` 但条件在 block 内所有线程上求值不一致）
- **Divergent thread(s) in warp**：对不支持的 barrier，检测到单个 warp 内线程发散
- **Invalid arguments**：barrier 指令/原语使用非法参数（如并非所有到达 `__syncwarp()` 的线程都在 mask 参数中声明自己；但 synccheck **不会**检测 mask 中声明的线程未全部到达的情况）

后续行包含函数内偏移、文件名行号（如有）、kernel 名、违规线程和 block 信息。

### 6.4 其他 Synccheck 能力
- **`cuda::barrier` 支持**：Ampere 及更新 GPU；barrier 数量溢出时警告并可用 `--num-cuda-barriers` 解决
- **`wgmma` 支持**（Hopper sm_90a）：warpgroup 中每个 warp 应以相同顺序、相同 predicate 执行相同 `wgmma` 指令，且全部线程活跃或全不活跃。违规时报告以 "Warpgroup MMA sequence error detected" 开头（而非 "Barrier error detected"），每个遇到错误的 warp 报告一次，并退出整个 warpgroup。用 `--check-warpgroup-mma` 启用/禁用

---

## 七、Compute Sanitizer 特性（Features）

### 7.1 非阻塞模式（Nonblocking Mode）
默认以非阻塞模式启动 kernel，支持并发 kernel 应用的错误报告。`--force-blocking-launches` 强制串行执行（副作用：阻塞模式下只报告 kernel 中第一个出错的线程）。使用 `--force-blocking-launches` 或 `--force-synchronization-limit` 会禁用 CUDA 精简 API 序列化。

### 7.2 栈回溯（Stack Backtraces）
`--show-backtrace` 生成回溯，通常含主机回溯（至 CUDA driver 调用点）和出错时的设备回溯两部分。

| 输出类型 | 主机回溯 | 设备回溯 |
|---|---|---|
| Memory access error | 主机端 kernel launch | 精确设备回溯 |
| Hardware exception | 主机端 kernel launch | 不精确设备回溯（某些情况下可能无设备回溯） |
| Malloc/Free error | 主机端 kernel launch | 精确设备回溯 |
| cudaMalloc allocation leak | cudaMalloc 调用点 | N/A |
| CUDA API error | CUDA API 调用点 | N/A |
| Compute Sanitizer internal error | 导致内部错误的调用点 | N/A |
| Device heap allocation leak | N/A | N/A |
| Shared memory hazard | 主机端 kernel launch | N/A |

注：OptiX 应用中 OptiX 内部设备函数名显示为 "NVIDIA Internal"。

### 7.3 名称反修饰（Name Demangling）
默认显示完全反修饰名（含 kernel 名和原型信息）；simple 模式只显示名称第一部分；禁用则显示完整修饰名。

### 7.4 动态并行（Dynamic Parallelism）
支持动态并行。memcheck 支持全局/局部/共享内存访问及全局原子指令的越界和未对齐精确错误报告，硬件异常不精确报告也完全支持。动态并行应用的错误检测需要更多设备内存，内存受限环境中 memcheck 可能因内部内存不足而初始化失败。

### 7.5 错误动作（Error Actions，Table 9）

| 错误类型 | 位置 | 动作 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Memory access error | Device | 终止 CUDA context | 用户可选择改为终止 kernel |
| Hardware exception | Device | 终止 CUDA context | 后续该 context 上的调用将失败 |
| Malloc/Free error | Device | 终止 CUDA context | 用户可选择改为终止 kernel |
| cudaMalloc allocation leak | Host | 继续应用 | 仅报告错误 |
| CUDA API error | Host | 继续应用 | 仅报告错误 |
| Device heap allocation leak | Device | 继续应用 | 仅报告错误 |
| Shared memory hazard | Device | 继续应用 | 仅报告错误 |
| Synchronization error | Device | 终止 CUDA context | 用户可选择改为终止 kernel |
| Compute Sanitizer internal error | Host | 未定义 | 应用行为可能未定义 |

说明：
- 默认行为：纯主机端错误继续执行；硬件异常销毁 CUDA context；精确错误（内存访问、malloc/free）终止 kernel（不执行后续指令，应用继续在 context 中启动其他 kernel）
- 可用 `--destroy-on-device-error` 改变 memcheck 检测到的内存访问和 malloc/free 错误的处理
- racecheck 检测到的 hazard 只报告，不影响执行
- ⚠️ kernel 提前终止时数据计算可能未完成，依赖该数据的后续 kernel 行为未定义

### 7.6 转义序列（Escape Sequences）
`--save` 和 `--log-file` 文件名支持：
- `%%`：字面量 %
- `%p`：Compute Sanitizer 前端应用的 PID
- `%q{ENVVAR}`：环境变量 ENVVAR 的内容（不存在则为空字符串）
- % 后接其他字符会报错

### 7.7 指定过滤器（Specifying Filters）
`--kernel-name` 和 `--kernel-name-exclude` 控制检查哪些 kernel（默认全部检查）。两者都可多次指定；kernel 满足任一过滤器即被检查。过滤规范为逗号分隔的 `key=value` 对，所有组件都满足才算匹配；任何组件指定错误则整个过滤器被忽略。

过滤器键（Table 10）：

| 名称 | 键字符串 | 值 |
|---|---|---|
| Kernel Name | `kernel_name`, `kne` | 完整修饰 kernel 名 |
| Kernel Substring | `kernel_substring`, `kns` | 修饰名中任意子串 |
| Regex | `regex` | 可匹配修饰名子串的正则表达式（多个键值对需通过多次使用该选项指定） |

使用注意：
- 使用 `kernel-name` 过滤器时，工具检查 kernel 发起的所有 `device` 函数调用
- CUDA 动态并行（CDP）中，被检查 kernel 启动的子 kernel 除非匹配过滤器否则不被检查
- 不匹配过滤器的 GPU 启动 kernel 若调用了可从匹配过滤器的 kernel 到达的设备函数，该设备函数视为被检查（某些工具中可能导致未定义行为）

**过滤器示例**（假设三个 kernel：`gamma`/`delta`/`epsilon`，修饰名分别为 `_Z5gammaPi`/`_Z5deltaPi`/`_Z7epsilonPi`，只想检查 epsilon）：

```bash
compute-sanitizer --kernel-name kne=_Z7epsilonPi ./app        # 完整修饰名匹配
compute-sanitizer --kernel-name kns=epsilon ./app             # 子串匹配
compute-sanitizer --kernel-name-exclude kns=delta,kne=_Z5gammaPi ./app   # 排除法（逗号分隔多过滤器）
compute-sanitizer --kernel-name-exclude kns=delta --kernel-name-exclude kne=_Z5gammaPi ./app  # 多次使用选项
compute-sanitizer --kernel-name regex='[a-z]{7}' ./app        # 正则：匹配 7 个连续小写字母
```

### 7.8 Coredump 支持
- CUDA 11.6 起，`--generate-coredump` 在检测到错误时生成 CUDA coredump，之后目标应用中止
- Linux：在 cuda-gdb 中用 `target cudacore core.name.nvcudmp` 加载
- Windows：在 NVIDIA Nsight Visual Studio Edition 中通过 **File > Open** 或拖放加载
- `--coredump-name` 指定文件名
- 限制：只有遇到错误的线程可在 coredump 中检查；**不支持 racecheck 工具**

### 7.9 错误抑制（Error Suppression）
- 用 `--xml` 对目标应用运行生成 suppression 文件（XML），可手工编辑使其更通用
- 后续用 `--suppressions` 选项提供该文件以抑制误报
- 抑制匹配规则：报告类型必须匹配；整数字段精确匹配；字符串字段可为正则；栈帧数须小于等于报告的栈帧数；栈帧比较字段包括函数名、文件名、模块名（如提供）
- 可抑制的错误类型：CUDA API 错误、initcheck 未初始化内存访问、racecheck 分析报告

### 7.10 OptiX 支持
- CUDA 11.6 起支持 OptiX 7 应用的 memcheck 和 initcheck；initcheck 跟踪 OptiX launch 需 `--check-optix`
- 完整设备回溯需 OptiX 模块以 `OPTIX_COMPILE_DEBUG_LEVEL_FULL` 编译（`OptixModuleCompileOptions` 的 `debugLevel` 字段）
- 若 `--initcheck-address-space` 指定非 `global` 值，`--check-optix` 被忽略（不支持共享内存地址空间）
- OptiX 内部代码帧显示为 "NVIDIA Internal"
- CUDA 11.7 起可用 `--check-optix-leaks` 检测 `OptixModule`、`optixPipeline`、`optixProgramGroup`、`optixDenoiser` 泄漏（仅在 `OptixDeviceContextDestroy` 销毁 context 时报告）
- OptiX API 7.0–9.0：kernel 检查和资源泄漏检查均支持

### 7.11 编译期插桩（Compile-time patching）
- 作为默认运行时二进制插桩的替代，集成于 NVCC 和 PTXAS；**目前仅 memcheck 支持**，racecheck/initcheck/synccheck 仍需运行时二进制插桩
- **优势**：base-and-bounds 分析可检测更多错误（尤其相邻分配访问）；显著的性能提升
- **Base-and-bounds 分析**：CUDA 分配 API 不保证两个分配间的局部性，编译器插桩跟踪指针所指分配，报告通过该指针对相邻分配的非法访问；共享内存的基址为分配的首指针，大小为当前共享内存变量大小；分析失败时回退到常规分配边界检查
- **要求**：PTX 编译器与 compute-sanitizer 必须来自同一 CUDA toolkit 版本（含独立 PTX 编译器库）
- **用法**：

```bash
# 方式一：NVCC
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -o myapp myapp.cu

# 方式二：直接使用 PTXAS
ptxas -arch=sm_75 -sanitize=memcheck myapp.ptx

# 运行（工具自动检测编译期插桩）
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck myapp
```

- **混合插桩（Hybrid instrumentation）**：同一应用中不同编译单元可有不同插桩状态，工具对未编译期插桩的代码用二进制插桩，对编译期插桩的代码用编译期插桩，支持大型代码库增量采用

---

## 八、使用指南（Usage Guide）

### 内存占用（Memory Footprint）
工具因跟踪数据可能有很大内存占用，大量并发 kernel launch 的应用可能出现内存不足错误：

```
========= Internal Sanitizer Error: The Sanitizer encountered an error while launching kernel_name ...
```

或导致主机内存分配失败使应用崩溃。解决方案：
- `--force-synchronization-limit {number}`：流达到指定数量未同步的 launch 后强制同步
- `--force-blocking-launches`：串行化每个 kernel launch（等价于 `--force-synchronization-limit 1`）
- 使用 CUDA 惰性模块加载（lazy module loading）也可降低主机和设备内存占用

---

## 九、操作系统特定行为

### Windows
- **调试接口**：注册表键 `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\NVIDIA Corporation\GPUDebugger\EnableInterface` 必须设为 `(DWORD) 1`
- **TDR（Timeout Detection and Recovery）**：GPU 应用超过阈值（默认 2 秒）会被 OS 杀死；工具会增加 kernel 运行时间，可能触发 TDR。可修改注册表 `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers` 下的 DWORD 键 `TdrDelay`（秒）调整

### Jetson 和 Tegra 设备
默认仅 **debug** 组成员启动 `compute-sanitizer` 才支持 GPU 调试。将当前用户加入 debug 组：

```bash
sudo usermod -a -G debug $USER
```

---

## 十、CUDA Fortran 支持

- 默认错误报告中 thread 索引（threadIdx）和 block 索引（blockIdx）为 0 基 C 风格；用 `--language fortran` 切换为 Fortran 风格 1 基偏移
- CUDA Fortran 编译器可能在共享内存中插入额外填充，命中该填充的访问可能不作为错误报告

---

## 十一、工具示例（⚠️ 本节内容被截断）

原文档包含 "Example Use of Memcheck" 一节，演示在示例应用 `memcheck_demo`（可从 [compute-sanitizer GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/NVIDIA/compute-sanitizer-samples/tree/master/Memcheck) 获取，用 `make` 编译）上运行 memcheck 工具：

- **memcheck_demo 直接运行输出**（完整）：应用产生两次失败但无法定位未对齐地址访问的原因，第二个 kernel 也无法运行：

```
$ ./memcheck_demo
Mallocing memory
Running unaligned_kernel: misaligned address
Running out_of_bounds_kernel: misaligned address
```

- **memcheck_demo 带 Memcheck（Release Build）的输出**：⚠️ **此节在描述中途被截断**。已提供的内容说明：Release 模式下编译时，Compute Sanitizer 输出只包含引起访问违规的 kernel 名；能检测 kernel 名和错误类型，但没有失败 kernel 的行号信息；输出还包括函数启动调用点的主机和设备回溯。（后续示例输出内容缺失）

**标题**: Numerical accuracy — PyTorch 2.14 documentation
**发布时间**: Created On: May 13, 2026 | Last Updated On: Jun 01, 2026

# Numerical accuracy[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#numerical-accuracy "Link to this heading")

In modern computers, floating point numbers are represented using IEEE 754 standard. For more details on floating point arithmetic and IEEE 754 standard, please see [Floating point arithmetic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floating-point_arithmetic). In particular, note that floating point provides limited accuracy (about 7 decimal digits for single precision floating point numbers, about 16 decimal digits for double precision floating point numbers) and that floating point addition and multiplication are not associative, so the order of the operations affects the results. Because of this, PyTorch is not guaranteed to produce bitwise identical results for floating point computations that are mathematically identical. Similarly, bitwise identical results are not guaranteed across PyTorch releases, individual commits, or different platforms. In particular, CPU and GPU results can be different even for bitwise-identical inputs and even after controlling for the sources of randomness.

## Batched computations or slice computations[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#batched-computations-or-slice-computations "Link to this heading")

Many operations in PyTorch support batched computation, where the same operation is performed for the elements of the batches of inputs. An example of this is [`torch.mm()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.mm.html#torch.mm "torch.mm") and [`torch.bmm()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.bmm.html#torch.bmm "torch.bmm"). It is possible to implement batched computation as a loop over batch elements, and apply the necessary math operations to the individual batch elements, for efficiency reasons we are not doing that, and typically perform computation for the whole batch. The mathematical libraries that we are calling, and PyTorch internal implementations of operations can produce slightly different results in this case, compared to non-batched computations. In particular, let `A` and `B` be 3D tensors with the dimensions suitable for batched matrix multiplication. Then `(A@B)[0]` (the first element of the batched result) is not guaranteed to be bitwise identical to `A[0]@B[0]` (the matrix product of the first elements of the input batches) even though mathematically it’s an identical computation.

Similarly, an operation applied to a tensor slice is not guaranteed to produce results that are identical to the slice of the result of the same operation applied to the full tensor. E.g. let `A` be a 2-dimensional tensor. `A.sum(-1)[0]` is not guaranteed to be bitwise equal to `A[:,0].sum()`.

## Extremal values[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#extremal-values "Link to this heading")

When inputs contain large values such that intermediate results may overflow the range of the used datatype, the end result may overflow too, even though it is representable in the original datatype. E.g.:

```
import torch
a = torch.tensor([1e20, 1e20])  # fp32 type by default
a.norm()  # produces tensor(inf)
a.double().norm()  # produces tensor(1.4142e+20, dtype=torch.float64), representable in fp32
```

Different backends may use different algorithms, reduction orders, or accumulation precision for the same operation. As a result, finite inputs near the limits of a dtype may produce finite results on one backend and non-finite results, such as `inf` or `NaN`, on another backend, such as when moving a computation between CPU and CUDA. A value being representable in a dtype does not guarantee that all intermediate or output values of an operation will remain finite. For workflows that are sensitive to non-finite values, consider normalizing or clamping extremal inputs and using [`torch.isfinite()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.isfinite.html#torch.isfinite "torch.isfinite") to detect them.

## Linear algebra (`torch.linalg`)[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#linear-algebra-torch-linalg "Link to this heading")

### Non-finite values[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#non-finite-values "Link to this heading")

The external libraries (backends) that `torch.linalg` uses provide no guarantees on their behaviour when the inputs have non-finite values like `inf` or `NaN`. As such, neither does PyTorch. The operations may return a tensor with non-finite values, or raise an exception, or even segfault.

Consider using [`torch.isfinite()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.isfinite.html#torch.isfinite "torch.isfinite") before calling these functions to detect this situation.

### Extremal values in linalg[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#extremal-values-in-linalg "Link to this heading")

Functions within `torch.linalg` have more [extremal values](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#extremal-values) than other PyTorch functions.

[linalg solvers](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/linalg.html#linalg-solvers) and [linalg inverses](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/linalg.html#linalg-inverses) assume that the input matrix `A` is invertible. If it is close to being non-invertible (for example, if it has a very small singular value), then these algorithms may silently return incorrect results. These matrices are said to be [ill-conditioned](https://nhigham.com/2020/03/19/what-is-a-condition-number/). If provided with ill-conditioned inputs, the result of these functions they may vary when using the same inputs on different devices or when using different backends via the keyword `driver`.

Spectral operations like `svd`, `eig`, and `eigh` may also return incorrect results (and their gradients may be infinite) when their inputs have singular values that are close to each other. This is because the algorithms used to compute these decompositions struggle to converge for these inputs.

Running the computation in `float64` (as NumPy does by default) often helps, but it does not solve these issues in all cases. Analyzing the spectrum of the inputs via [`torch.linalg.svdvals()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.linalg.svdvals.html#torch.linalg.svdvals "torch.linalg.svdvals") or their condition number via [`torch.linalg.cond()`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.linalg.cond.html#torch.linalg.cond "torch.linalg.cond") may help to detect these issues.

## TensorFloat-32 (TF32) on Nvidia Ampere (and later) devices[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#tensorfloat-32-tf32-on-nvidia-ampere-and-later-devices "Link to this heading")

On Ampere (and later) Nvidia GPUs, PyTorch can use TensorFloat32 (TF32) to speed up mathematically intensive operations, in particular matrix multiplications and convolutions. When an operation is performed using TF32 tensor cores, only the first 10 bits of the input mantissa are read. This may reduce accuracy and produce surprising results (e.g., multiplying a matrix by the identity matrix may produce results that are different from the input). By default, TF32 tensor cores are disabled for matrix multiplications and enabled for convolutions, although most neural network workloads have the same convergence behavior when using TF32 as they have with fp32. We recommend enabling TF32 tensor cores for matrix multiplications with `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = "tf32"` (`torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True` is going to be deprecated) if your network does not need full float32 precision. If your network needs full float32 precision for both matrix multiplications and convolutions, then TF32 tensor cores can also be disabled for convolutions with `torch.backends.cudnn.conv.fp32_precision = "ieee"` (`torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False` is going to be deprecated).

For more information see [TensorFloat32](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/cuda.html#tf32-on-ampere).

## Reduced Precision Reduction for FP16 and BF16 GEMMs[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#reduced-precision-reduction-for-fp16-and-bf16-gemms "Link to this heading")

Half-precision GEMM operations are typically done with intermediate accumulations (reduction) in single-precision for numerical accuracy and improved resilience to overflow. For performance, certain GPU architectures, especially more recent ones, allow a few truncations of the intermediate accumulation results to the reduced precision (e.g., half-precision). This change is often benign from the perspective of model convergence, though it may lead to unexpected results (e.g., `inf` values when the final result should be representable in half-precision). If reduced-precision reductions are problematic, they can be turned off with `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_fp16_reduced_precision_reduction = False`. This sets `allow_splitk` to `True`. To disable both reduced-precision reductions and split-k reductions, use `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_fp16_reduced_precision_reduction = (False, False)`.

A similar flag exists for BF16 GEMM operations and is turned on by default. If BF16 reduced-precision reductions are problematic, they can be turned off with `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = False`. This sets `allow_splitk` to `True`. To disable both reduced-precision reductions and split-k reductions, use `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = (False, False)`.

For more information see [allow_fp16_reduced_precision_reduction](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/cuda.html#fp16reducedprecision) and [allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/cuda.html#bf16reducedprecision).

## Reduced Precision Reduction for FP16 and BF16 in Scaled Dot Product Attention (SDPA)[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#reduced-precision-reduction-for-fp16-and-bf16-in-scaled-dot-product-attention-sdpa "Link to this heading")

A naive SDPA math backend, when using FP16/BF16 inputs, can accumulate significant numerical errors due to the usage of low-precision intermediate buffers. To mitigate this issue, the default behavior now involves upcasting FP16/BF16 inputs to FP32. Computations are performed in FP32/TF32, and the final FP32 results are then downcasted back to FP16/BF16. This will improve numerical accuracy of the final output for the math backend with FP16/BF16 inputs, but increases memory usage and may cause performance regressions in the math backend as computations shift from FP16/BF16 BMM to FP32/TF32 BMM/Matmul.

For scenarios where reduced-precision reductions are preferred for speed, they can be enabled with the following setting: `torch.backends.cuda.allow_fp16_bf16_reduction_math_sdp(True)`.

## Reduced Precision FP16 and BF16 GEMMs and Convolutions on AMD Instinct MI200 devices[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#reduced-precision-fp16-and-bf16-gemms-and-convolutions-on-amd-instinct-mi200-devices "Link to this heading")

On AMD Instinct MI200 GPUs, the FP16 and BF16 V_DOT2 and MFMA matrix instructions flush input and output denormal values to zero. FP32 and FP64 MFMA matrix instructions do not flush input and output denormal values to zero. The affected instructions are only used by rocBLAS (GEMM) and MIOpen (convolution) kernels; all other PyTorch operations will not encounter this behavior. All other supported AMD GPUs will not encounter this behavior.

rocBLAS and MIOpen provide alternate implementations for affected FP16 operations. Alternate implementations for BF16 operations are not provided; BF16 numbers have a larger dynamic range than FP16 numbers and are less likely to encounter denormal values. For the FP16 alternate implementations, FP16 input values are cast to an intermediate BF16 value and then cast back to FP16 output after the accumulate FP32 operations. In this way, the input and output types are unchanged.

When training using FP16 precision, some models may fail to converge with FP16 denorms flushed to zero. Denormal values more frequently occur in the backward pass of training during gradient calculation. PyTorch by default will use the rocBLAS and MIOpen alternate implementations during the backward pass. The default behavior can be overridden using environment variables, `ROCBLAS_INTERNAL_FP16_ALT_IMPL` and `MIOPEN_DEBUG_CONVOLUTION_ATTRIB_FP16_ALT_IMPL`. The behavior of these environment variables is as follows:

forward

backward

Env unset

original

alternate

Env set to 1

alternate

alternate

Env set to 0

original

original

The following is the list of operations where rocBLAS may be used:

- `torch.addbmm`
- `torch.addmm`
- `torch.baddbmm`
- `torch.bmm`
- `torch.mm`
- `torch.nn.GRUCell`
- `torch.nn.LSTMCell`
- `torch.nn.Linear`
- `torch.sparse.addmm`
- the following `torch._C._ConvBackend` implementations:
  
  - `slowNd`
  - `slowNd_transposed`
  - `slowNd_dilated`
  - `slowNd_dilated_transposed`

The following is the list of operations where MIOpen may be used:

- `torch.nn.Conv[Transpose]Nd`
- the following `torch._C._ConvBackend` implementations:
  
  - `ConvBackend::Miopen`
  - `ConvBackend::MiopenDepthwise`
  - `ConvBackend::MiopenTranspose`

## TensorFloat-32 (TF32) on AMD Instinct MI300 devices[#](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html#tensorfloat-32-tf32-on-amd-instinct-mi300-devices "Link to this heading")

On AMD Instinct MI300 GPUs (gfx942, CDNA3), the `v_mfma_f32_*_xf32` matrix instructions used by hipBLASLt’s TF32 path perform round-down accumulation. This is a documented property of the CDNA3 hardware. NVIDIA’s TF32 implementation rounds to nearest, so a TF32 GEMM exhibits a small negative-biased error on MI300 that is absent on NVIDIA. The bias scales with `sqrt(K) * 2^-10 * |A|_inf` and reaches the low single-digit milli-units for typical random inputs; the corresponding error on NVIDIA TF32 is roughly half to a third of that.

Only operations that dispatch through hipBLASLt with TF32 enabled are affected. To run a block of code in full IEEE FP32:

```
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = "ieee"
```

To enable TF32 on supported hardware:

```
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = "tf32"
```

For a per-shape characterization of the MI300 vs NVIDIA-TF32 numerical gap, see https://github.com/jeffdaily/tf32_analysis.

# 定位自定义 CUDA 算子与 CPU/PyTorch 参考不一致的数值精度问题

## 第一步：先判断是"真错误"还是"正常浮点差异"

PyTorch 官方 Numerical accuracy 文档明确：浮点加法/乘法不满足结合律，归约顺序不同结果就不同，**PyTorch 不保证数学上等价的浮点计算产生逐位（bitwise）一致的结果，CPU 与 GPU 即使输入逐位相同、控制住随机源，结果也可能不同**（https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html）。所以先用容差比对，而不是要求完全相等：

```python
import torch

cpu_out = ref_op(x_cpu)                      # PyTorch 参考（CPU，fp64 更稳）
gpu_out = my_cuda_op(x_cpu.cuda()).cpu()     # 移回 CPU 再比，排除设备检查干扰

torch.testing.assert_close(gpu_out, cpu_out, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
```

`torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, *, rtol=None, atol=None, equal_nan=False, check_device=True, check_dtype=True, check_stride=False, msg=None)`，判据为 `|actual-expected| ≤ atol + rtol·|expected|`（https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/testing.html）。默认容差表：float32 rtol=1.3e-6/atol=1e-5，float16 rtol=1e-3/atol=1e-5，bfloat16 rtol=1.6e-2/atol=1e-5，float64 rtol=1e-7/atol=1e-7。失败时报错会给出 mismatched 元素数、最大绝对/相对误差及位置。注意 `torch.testing.assert_allclose` 自 1.12 起已废弃。

## 第二步：逐元素定位第一个不一致点

```python
diff = (gpu_out - cpu_out).abs()
mask = torch.isclose(gpu_out, cpu_out, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
bad_idx = torch.nonzero(~mask)
print("mismatch count:", bad_idx.shape[0])
i = tuple(bad_idx[0].tolist())
print("first mismatch at", i, "gpu:", gpu_out[i], "cpu:", cpu_out[i])
# 打印该位置对应的输入切片，缩小到具体输入元素
```

观察错误分布模式能快速定性：全部元素都有微小偏差 → 累加顺序/TF32 问题；只有个别位置（如某些行/列、边缘）出错 → 索引/边界条件/越界 bug；随机出现且每次不同 → 竞态或未同步；块边界位置出错 → shared memory 同步或 tile 边界问题。

## 第三步：逐层/逐子算子分解（二分定位）

对复合算子，把每个子步骤的中间结果都拷回，与 PyTorch 原语逐一比对：

```python
# 例：算子 = dequant -> matmul -> bias -> gelu
q   = my_dequant(w_q).cpu()
ref = x @ q.T + b
torch.testing.assert_close(my_stage1_out.cpu(), ref, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)  # 逐段比对
```

第一个发散的子步骤就是问题所在。对单个 kernel 内部，可用 `printf`（device 端）或将中间结果写入 debug buffer 拷回比对。

## 第四步：排除已知数值陷阱（GPU 特有默认行为）

按官方文档逐一关闭再比对，哪一项关掉后误差消失就是根因：

1. **TF32**（Ampere+）：matmul 默认禁用、conv 默认启用；它只读尾数前 10 位。关闭：
   ```python
   torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = "ieee"   # 旧接口 allow_tf32=False 将废弃
   torch.backends.cudnn.conv.fp32_precision = "ieee"    # 旧接口 cudnn.allow_tf32=False
   ```
2. **FP16/BF16 reduced precision reduction**（部分新架构默认开）：
   ```python
   torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_fp16_reduced_precision_reduction = False
   torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = False
   ```
3. **确定性**：`torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)`、`torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True`；kernel 内 `atomicAdd` 的累加顺序不确定，会导致逐次运行结果不同——CPU 串行参考无法复现。
4. **归约顺序**：并行归约（block/tree reduction）与 CPU 串行顺序不同，小偏差属正常；必要时 CPU 参考用 float64 计算作为"真值"。
5. **极值溢出**：不同后端中间结果可能一侧 inf/NaN，用 `torch.isfinite()` 检查。

## 第五步：若差异是 bug（越界/竞态/未初始化），用 compute-sanitizer

随 CUDA Toolkit 安装，四个子工具（https://docs.nvidia.com/compute-sanitizer/ComputeSanitizer/index.html）：

```bash
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck  python test_op.py   # 越界/未对齐访问（默认工具）
compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck python test_op.py   # shared memory 数据竞争（WAW/WAR/RAW）
compute-sanitizer --tool initcheck python test_op.py   # 未初始化全局内存读取
compute-sanitizer --tool synccheck python test_op.py   # __syncthreads/__syncwarp 非法使用
```

注意：racecheck/initcheck/synccheck 不做内存访问错误检查，官方建议**先跑 memcheck**。编译加 `-lineinfo`（不影响优化）或 `-G` 可获得源码行号；memcheck 还支持编译期插桩 `nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo`。memcheck 报告精确到 thread/block 坐标和指令 PC；泄漏检查需 `--leak-check full`；可用 `--kernel-name kns=<子串>` 只检查你的 kernel。

另记得比对前 `torch.cuda.synchronize()`，确保 kernel 真正完成且错误（如非法访问）在启动处暴露——可用 `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 python test_op.py` 让报错同步定位。

## 典型结论判读

- 关掉 TF32 / reduced-precision reduction 后通过 → 正常精度行为，按 dtype 设合理容差即可，不算 bug。
- 每次运行结果不同 → atomicAdd 顺序或竞态（racecheck 确认）。
- 固定位置大偏差 → 索引/边界/类型转换 bug（memcheck + 逐元素定位）。
- 全元素均匀小偏差且随 K 增大 → 归约累加顺序，用 fp64 参考定容差。

**来源**：
- torch.testing 文档：https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/testing.html
- Numerical accuracy：https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/numerical_accuracy.html
- Compute Sanitizer：https://docs.nvidia.com/compute-sanitizer/ComputeSanitizer/index.html

**版本说明**：以上 API 依据 PyTorch 2.14 文档；`fp32_precision` 为当前推荐接口，旧 `allow_tf32` 仍可用但将废弃。Compute Sanitizer 随 CUDA Toolkit 版本发布，文档页为当前主线版本（文中未标注单一版本号，个别特性标注 CUDA 11.6/11.7 起支持）。

**未核实处**：用户具体环境（GPU 架构、CUDA/PyTorch 版本）未知，容差数值需按实际 dtype 和算子特性调整；compute-sanitizer 文档示例章节在获取时被截断（不影响上述用法）。

仅凭已有知识（不检索）我能给出的回答：

昇腾（Ascend CANN）精度比对的典型流程是：
1. 打开 dump：通过 `aclInit` + `aclmdlSetDump` 接口，或配置 `dump` 相关环境（老版本用 `atc --dump_mode`，推理/训练场景常用 `ACL_DUMP_DATA=1` 或在 acl.json / ge 配置里设置 dump 开关，ge.exec.dump 等），把算子（kernel）的输入输出 tensor 落盘为 `.npy`/bin 文件。
2. 生成标杆数据（golden）：在 GPU/CPU（如 ONNX Runtime、TensorFlow、PyTorch）跑同一输入，保存标杆输出（通常 `.npy`）。
3. 用 `msaccucmp.py` 比对：大致命令形式为
   `python3 $ASCEND_HOME/.../msaccucmp.py compare -m my_dump_file -g golden_file -f my_op_dump -o result.csv`
   参数包括 `-m`(my output)、`-g`(golden)、`-f`(算子 dump 目录)、`-o`(输出 csv)、还有比对算法（如 cosine_similarity、max_relative_error 等，通过 `-alg` 或比对配置）。
4. 结果解读：msaccucmp 输出 csv，按算子逐行给出 cosine 相似度、最大相对误差等指标，找出第一个指标不达标的算子，再回溯其输入确认是算子本身问题还是上游传导。

不确定处（需要检索核实）：
- msaccucmp.py 的确切路径和完整参数列表（不同 CANN 版本可能不同，如 toolkit 安装路径下 `tools/msaccucmp/` 或 `opp/tools`）
- 当前版本推荐的 dump 方式（acl.json 的 dump 字段名、环境变量名）
- 比对算法名称、默认阈值、csv 字段的确切名称
- 是否有新工具替代（如 ptdbg_ascend、msprobe）与 msaccucmp 的适用关系
- 具体 CANN 版本对应关系

**标题**: 命令格式说明-附录-精度比对工具-开发工具-CANN8.0.RC3.alpha003开发文档-昇腾社区

[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html)[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html)

# 命令格式说明

#### 通用参数

精度比对命令行格式如下：

```
python3 msaccucmp.py compare -m my_dump_path -g golden_dump_path [-f fusion_rule_file] [-cf close_fusion_rule_file] [-q quant_fusion_rule_file] [-out output] [-map] [-c custom_script_path] [-alg algorithm] [-v version] [-r range] [-overflow_detection] [-max]
```

命令行参数说明如[表1](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002023022604__table23391841181914)所示。

精度比对工具保存在$HOME/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/tools/operator_cmp/compare目录下。

[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html)[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html)

**表1** 精度比对命令行参数说明

**参数名**

**参数说明**

**是否必选**

-m

--my_dump_path

基于昇腾AI处理器运行生成的数据文件所在目录。

由于dump数据文件是多个二进制文件，故须指定dump数据文件所在的父目录。如：*$HOME/MyApp_mind/resnet50，*其中*resnet50*文件夹下直接保存dump数据文件。

训练场景下：

- 支持TensorFlow为原始训练网络的比对。
- 单个数据文件比对时，需指定数据文件所在的具体目录。
- 支持多个dump数据文件的批量比对，可指定固定路径为**dump_path/time/**，仅支持TensorFlow为原始训练网络的比对。指定的路径下可以存放多个dump数据文件，但要求每个dump数据文件拥有唯一路径，且路径命名规则为***dump_path/time/device_id/model_name/model_id/dump_step/dump文件*。**

是

-g

--golden_dump_path

基于GPU/CPU运行生成的原始网络数据文件所在目录。

由于npy数据文件是多个npy文件，故须指定npy数据文件所在的父目录。如：*$HOME/Standard_caffe/resnet50 ，*其中*resnet50*文件夹下直接保存npy数据文件。

当指定-cf参数时，该参数指定的就是模型转换关闭算子融合下dump数据文件的目录。

是

-f

--fusion_rule_file

全网层信息文件。

推理场景：

- 通过使用ATC转换.om模型文件生成的json文件，文件包含整网算子的映射关系。
- 该参数指定的是默认开启算子融合情况下进行模型转换时生成的json文件；指定关闭算子融合情况下进行模型转换时生成的json文件使用-cf参数。

训练场景：

- 通过使用ATC转换.txt图文件生成的json文件。
- 单个数据文件比对时，该参数需指定具体的json文件；批量比对时，该参数可指定为多个json文件所在的目录。

否

-cf

--close_fusion_rule_file

全网层信息文件（通过使用ATC转换.om模型文件生成的json文件，文件包含关闭算子融合功能情况下整网算子的映射关系）。

本参数详细使用指导请参见[比对操作和分析](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0035.html)。

仅推理场景支持本参数。

否

-q

--quant_fusion_rule_file

量化信息文件（昇腾模型压缩输出的json文件）。

通过AMCT量化生成的量化信息文件（*.json），文件包含整网量化算子映射关系，用于精度比对时算子匹配。

Caffe非量化原始模型 vs 量化离线模型场景时，与-f参数二选一；Caffe非量化原始模型 vs 量化原始模型场景时，仅使用本参数。

仅推理场景支持本参数。

否

-out

--output

比对数据结果存放路径，默认为当前路径。

训练场景下：

- 单个数据文件比对时，结果文件名格式为result_{timestamp}.csv。
- 多个数据文件比对时，结果文件名格式为{device_id}_{model_name}_{dump_step}_result_{timestamp}.csv，批量比对将生成多个csv结果文件。

否

-map

--mapping

输出GPU/NPU的映射表。

一般情况下GPU/NPU的映射表需要在完成精度比对之后，才能从csv中获取。本参数实现在精度比对前，直接提取GPU/NPU的映射表。建议在比对数据量太大，需要提前获取GPU/NPU的映射表的场景下使用。详细操作请参见[获取GPU/NPU的映射表](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0055.html)。

否

-c

--custom_script_path

用户自定义脚本文件存放路径，包括自定义算法.py文件和自定义Format转换.py文件，需指定到脚本目录的上一层目录。指定本参数时判断是否存在以下文件目录：

- 存在自定义算法.py文件目录，目录格式为“algorithm”，则读取“algorithm”目录下的自定义算法.py文件，生成自定义算法，可通过-alg参数指定为比对算法。自定义算法.py文件相关要求参见[准备自定义算法.py文件](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0056.html)。
- 存在自定义Format转换.py文件目录，目录格式为“format_convert”，则读取“format_convert”目录下的自定义Format转换.py文件。自定义Format转换.py文件相关要求参见[准备自定义Format转换.py文件](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0057.html#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002022864352__zh-cn_topic_0244646216_section6833162804213)。

不建议调用与当前用户不一致的其它用户目录下的自定义脚本文件，避免提权风险。

否

-alg

--algorithm

比对算法维度，取值为：

- 0：CosineSimilarity，表示余弦相似度算法。
- 1：MaxAbsoluteError，表示最大绝对误差算法。
- 2：AccumulatedRelativeError，表示累积相对误差算法。
- 3：RelativeEuclideanDistance，表示欧氏相对距离算法。
- 4：KullbackLeiblerDivergence，表示KL散度算法。
- 5：StandardDeviation，表示标准差算法。
- 6：MeanAbsoluteError，表示平均绝对误差。
- 7：RootMeanSquareError，表示均方根误差。
- 8：MaxRelativeError，表示最大相对误差。
- 9：MeanRelativeError，表示平均相对误差。
- all：比对全部算法（包含自定义和内置算法），all为默认值。
- 自定义算法名（algorithm_name）。具体算法名由自定义算法文件确定，例如自定义算法文件名为alg_RelativeError.py，则自定义算法名为RelativeError。须同时配置-c参数。

可多选，配置格式为各取值间用逗号分隔，可配置为数字或算法名，例如0,1,2,RelativeError。

若只选择比对部分维度，则比对结果同样只展示对应维度。

否

-a

--algorithm_options

比对算法的高级选项，可为指定的算法设置参数，指定的算法必须是**-alg**参数的内置算法或者**-c**参数的自定义算法，被本参数设置后的算法以本参数设置的值执行运算。

输入格式为：算法名:参数名=值,参数名=值;算法名:参数名=值,参数名=值。参数之间是逗号分隔，不同算法是分号分隔，例如："CosineSimilarity:max=1,min=0;aa:max=1,min=0"。其中算法名与-c参数自定义算法.py文件的algorithm_name（参见[准备自定义算法.py文件](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0056.html)）一致。

否

-v

--*version*

dump文件类型，1代表protobuf序列化后的数据文件，2代表自定义格式的数据文件。默认取2。

否

-r

--range

设定算子比对范围。配置方式如下：

- start：第一个比对的算子，取值范围为[1, 参与计算的算子个数]，默认值为1。
- end：最后一个比对的算子，取值范围为-1或[start, 参与计算的算子个数]，默认值为-1（动态获取网络模型中最后一个参与计算的算子）。
- step：第start+step*n个比对的算子，step取值范围为[1, 参与计算的算子个数)，默认值为1，n为从1开始的正整数。

配置格式为：“start,end,step”。比如：-r 1,101,20，表示算子1,21,41,61,81,101的Tensor参与比对。

不配置本参数时，比对网络模型中的所有参与计算的算子。

Caffe非量化原始模型 vs 量化原始模型和Ascend vs Ascend精度比对场景不支持配置本参数。

须先配置-f或-cf参数指定离线模型全网层信息文件。

-s参数与-r参数二者只能选择一个配置。

否

-s

--select

设定算子比对范围。通过指定算子的索引（网络模型中算子的ID）来选择需要比对的算子，格式为：-s 1,2,3（数值之间以逗号隔开，取值与网络模型中算子的ID有关）。

须先配置-f或-cf参数指定离线模型全网层信息文件。

-s参数与-r参数二者只能选择一个配置。

否

-max

--max_cmp_size

设置每个dump数据比对的最大字节数，用于精度比对过程提速，默认0（表示全量比较），单位Byte。当模型中算子的输出存在较大Shape时、比较过于耗时，可以尝试配置。

否

-overflow_detection

整网算子溢出检测。进行整网比对时可检测溢出算子。

默认未开启算子溢出检测。

当算子的Tensor数据类型是fp16时，tensor中的任意一个数值的绝对值 >= 65504，认为算子溢出。

Caffe非量化原始模型 vs 量化原始模型场景配置本参数不生效。

否

#### 单算子比对

单算子比对命令行格式如下:

```
python3 msaccucmp.py compare -m my_dump_path -g golden_dump_path [-f fusion_rule_file] [-cf close_fusion_rule_file] [-q quant_fusion_rule_file] [-out output] [-op op_name] [-o output_tensor] [-i input_tensor] [-c custom_script_path] [-v version] [-n topn] [--ignore_single_op_result] [-ml max_line] [-overflow_detection]
```

命令行参数说明如[表2](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002023022604__table119712036123312)所示。

精度比对工具保存在$HOME/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/tools/operator_cmp/compare目录下。

[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html)[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/80RC3alpha003/devaids/auxiliarydevtool/atlasaccuracy_16_0063.html)

**表2** 单算子比对命令行参数说明

**参数名**

**参数说明**

是否必选

-op

--op_name

单算子比对的算子名。输入待比对算子名，算子名获取方式有：

- 推理场景：
  
  - 从.om模型中获取。
  - 从使用ATC转换.om模型文件生成的json文件中获取。
  - 从整网比对结果文件中的NPUDump字段获取。
- 训练场景：
  
  - 直接从训练模型中获取。
  - 从计算图文件（*.txt）中获取。
  - 从整网比对结果文件中的NPUDump字段获取。

是

-o

--output_tensor

比对指定Index的output数据。

配置格式：-o *Index*，其中*Index*可以从整网比对结果文件中的TensorIndex字段的output取值获取，例如TensorIndex为trans_Cast_0:input:0，则*Index*为0。

当-o与-i均未配置时，默认比对output数据的Index为0的数据。

配置-op时有效，与-i参数互斥。

否

-i

--input_tensor

比对指定Index的input数据。

配置格式：-i *Index*，其中*Index*可以从整网比对结果文件中的TensorIndex字段的input取值获取，例如TensorIndex为trans_Cast_0:input:0，则*Index*为0。

配置-op时有效，与-o参数互斥。

否

-n

--topn

仅展示绝对误差和相对误差的前n条数据，比对完成后打屏展示并生成csv结果文件，取值范围为[1,10000]，默认值为20。配置-op时有效。

生成的csv结果文件名分别为：

- 绝对误差：{op_name}_{input/output}_{index}_absolute_error_topn.csv
- 相对误差：{op_name}_{input/output}_{index}_relative_error_topn.csv

否

--ignore_single_op_result

csv结果文件中不生成单算子比对的完整比对数据，即不生成完整比对结果的csv文件。配置-op时有效。

不配置本参数时，生成完整比对结果。

否

-ml

--max_line

单算子比对时生成的单个csv文件所包含最大的文件条数，取值范围为[10000,1000000]，默认值为1000000。

文件中单算子的比对结果数据条数较大时，配置本参数可以将csv文件拆分为多个文件。比如数据条数为100000条，配置本参数为10000，那么比对结果则输出10个csv文件。

配置-op时有效，但配置--ignore_single_op_result时，本参数不生效。

否

**标题**: 数据格式要求-附录-精度调试工具-开发工具-CANN8.2.RC1.alpha002开发文档-昇腾社区

[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/82RC1alpha002/devaids/ModelAccuracyAnalyzer/atlasaccuracy_16_0062.html)[](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/82RC1alpha002/devaids/ModelAccuracyAnalyzer/atlasaccuracy_16_0062.html)

# 数据格式要求

**msaccucmp.py**脚本精度比对工具支持多种比对方式，因此dump、npy数据文件命名需满足以下要求：

**表1** 数据文件命名规则

数据类型

数据命名格式

备注

非量化离线模型在昇腾AI处理器上运行生成的dump数据文件

*{op_type}.{op_name}.{task_id}.{stream_id}.{timestamp}*

当前包含如下三种文件名格式：

- *{op_type}.{op_name}.{task_id}.{stream_id}.{timestamp}*
- *{op_type}.{op_name_lxsliceX}.({stream_id}.){task_id}.{timestamp}.{task_type}.{context_id}.{thread_id}.{device_id}*
- *{op_type}.{op_name}.({stream_id}.){task_id}.{timestamp}.{task_type}.{context_id}.{thread_id}.{device_id}*

命名格式说明：

- op_type（算子类型）、op_name（算子名）对应的名称需满足“A-Za-z0-9_-”正则表达式规则。
- timestamp为16位时间戳。
- task_id（任务ID）、stream_id（Stream ID）、output_index（第N个输出）、task_type（任务类型）、context_id（Context ID）、thread_id（线程ID）、device_id（运行卡的Device ID）为0~9数字组成。

如果op_type、op_name出现了“.”、“/”、“\”、空格时，转换为下划线表示。

量化离线模型在昇腾AI处理器上运行生成的dump数据文件

npy数据文件（Caffe、TensorFlow或ONNX）

*{op_name}.{output_index}.{timestamp}*.npy
